item.properties|d.gsc_vip: C O M P L I M E N T A R Y\n\nBecause you are a key casino patron, we are pleased to offer you membership free of charge.

item.properties|f.vial_curse_super: A glass vial containing concentrated fiend essence. It can be used to inflict enemies with Curse.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and give your foes 10 years of bad luck\!
prologue.properties|m.helmsman_warning: Captain\! Energy signatures are shifting\! I've never seen anything like-

item.properties|f.power_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.
conversation.properties|m.mission_resear: Don't know how long before our forcefield gives out...
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_short_or: A short, elegant street lamp that emits an orange glow with a gentle hiss.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_1_8a: Perhaps gremlins are trying to steal our technology?
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_4: Once you reach the elevator, the mineral you are carrying gets deposited in your arsenal for use later. Everyone in your party gets everyone else's minerals, so no need to fight over who gets the best one\!
exchange.properties|m.preview_purchasing: Purchasing is disabled on this server.  Please use the normal Spiral Knights client to purchase energy.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Very good, {0}. You will find a new set of missions for you under Operations. These new missions will be grouped according to their overall objective and can be tackled in parallel to each other. This should allow you maximum flexibility in order to respond to each new threat as they come up. Farewell, {0}, 'Guardian of Cradle'.
item.properties|f.frostbreaker_armor: Armor with a hacked elemental core aimed at resisting freeze. However, this non-standard modification creates other elemental weaknesses.

conversation.properties|m.casino_yesman_: I'm sorry, you missed Happy Hour by a minute. Next time.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_mat_4: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.gorgomega: A terrifying shield that combines the dual-crushing power of a gorgo and the mythical tortomega. Crushing enemies has never been more fiendishly fun.
projectx.properties|e.name_too_short: Sorry, valid names must be at least 4 letters long.
item.properties|f.corrosive_acid: A caustic substance characteristic of corrosive creatures.
item.properties|f.elite_orb: A rare, encapsulated element used in alchemical transmutation. Orbs like these are used by elite knights to craft items of exceptional quality and power.
item.properties|f.black_chaingun: A highly advanced machine gun designed to output hundreds of rounds of shadow bolts in a very short time. Controlling one of these requires skilled hands.
item.properties|f.vial_stun: An ornate glass vial containing shimmering flash pellets. It can be used to inflict enemies with Stun.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and your foes will be too stupefied to give chase\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_volcanic: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Volcanic style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|m.tier_done: Well met, {0}.  Having achieved the required rank, you are authorized to explore deeper depths of the Clockworks.  Good luck to you.
uplink.properties|m.ignite_reward: Hail, {0}\! As part of a special promotion with Ignite, you're entitled to receive a bonus pack of items designed to give you a head start on the great adventure before you\! Attached is a special suit of armor and an array of fiery weapons. \n\nSee you in the Clockworks\!
mission.properties|r.apocrea_2_3a: I will try. Tell me what to do.
item.properties|f.vile_striker: A sneaky saber that stores a payload of poison. Its serrated edge is not meant for cutting bread\!
helptips.properties|m.tut_ghost: Ghost blocks will destroy any blocks connected to them, even unbreakable blocks\!
projectx.properties|m.some_options_resta: Some options may require a client restart to take effect.
conversation.properties|r.tier_accept: Roger that, I'm on my way.
item.properties|f.scintillating_sun_shar: A large chunk of solar-charged Luminite primed with a potent explosive. The pyrotechnic show upon detonation is positively stunning.
mission.properties|o.p_apocrea_r4: Investigate the area of the Clockworks where several knights have gone missing.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_2a:
Re\: Resource allocation request, Amu-Sol 

You are receiving this mail as a result of an incorrect/cryptic entry in your recent resource allocation request.  Please provide a detailed summary of your projected use of the following requested resources\: 
- 999 'Open minded' devilites 
- 50 barrels of 'whatever frostifurs eat' 
- A 'towering pillar' of everfrost and 'all the frozen souls it brings forth'
mission.properties|m.new_threat_5a: {0}, something big is going down at the Lab.  You need to get here immediately\!
item.properties|f.rock_salt: A small amount of Clockworks mineral that's been infused with absolutely nothing. It hungrily draws at nearby essences and flavors, making it a staple in cooking, and the bane of jellies everywhere.
item.properties|f.static_edge: A modified Proto Sword capable of generating a low-intensity electrical charge.
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research
dungeon.properties|m.emberlight_desc: A village of outcasts, Emberlight serves as a refuge for gremlins who were banished from the Great Colony. Now they live humble lives, selling wares and repairs to passing travelers, always fearful that one day the gremlin king Tinkinzar would see fit to wipe them out entirely.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Biotech Hahn is attempting to further his research of construct and gremlin family monsters and is requesting samples from your recent missions.  He has once again specifically requested that you be reminded of his 'other very informative lecture' that was given to you 'free of charge for the second time' when making your decision as to whether or not to comply.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Battlepod \nThese immobile automatons hide a small arsenal beneath their double plated armor. Each Battlepod has a unique combination of attacks and defenses sure to keep you guessing.
mission.properties|r.pioneers_4a: Tell me about Squad Leader Euclid.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_3b: Each battle sprite will learn three skills that you can use in combat. Skills are learned automatically at certain levels as the sprite levels up. \n\nCombat skills become stronger with skill points.
item.properties|f.onesie: One size fits all. Machine washable, heavy duty cycle. Air dry only.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_mat_0: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
help.properties|m.support_4: To report a bug in the game, press F2. Keep in mind that bug reports are not answered, but they include non-personal debug information that helps track down the root of the problem. If you need assistance from a GM, please file an in-game support request.
item.properties|f.shogun_helmet: A grand helmet worn by warriors who long ago united a land under the banner of the rising sun.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_5a: I'll stay here and protect these sprites. Some of these sprite transport crates are empty. I think someone or something is after them. \n\nYou go on ahead and clear the area of hostiles so that a rescue squad can arrive safely.
item.properties|f.fuel_canister: A small receptacle once used to hold fuel for a complex machine.
item.properties|f.lockdown_striker_shiel: A speed-enhancing device used by Strikers, the hard-hitting shock troopers of the Spiral Order.
item.properties|f.capsule_remedy: A small capsule that refreshes its user. It can be used to remove all status conditions you're afflicted with.\n\nDon't panic\! Remedy capsules can be a life saver, if you remember to use them\!
mission.properties|r.darkest_depths_4a: I'll make it.  Just you wait.
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_3: Without the power of the rest of the sprites, water will never flow through this realm. It requires a focus link with the Spirit Mother to bring even the smallest of drops of water into such an oppressive world. The master of this realm has seen to it that the flames surrounding him will always burn.
support.properties|m.subheader_step2_ema: We have saved the offending email already waiting to be added to the complaint, so there is no need to hurry from here. Please carefully choose the correct option matching what the player did\:
mission.properties|m.target_acquired_2a: Yes, Project R appears to be in fact two massive weapons known as the 'Roarmulus Twins.'  Designed by one of the Crimson Order itself, the Roarmulus Twins are some kind of construct cannon that the gremlins intend on moving up the Clockworks into the Haven Arcade\! \n\nBased on what the schematics suggest, their power far exceeds standard gremlin weaponry and could be truly devastating to Haven, Spiral HQ and the Strangers should it reach the Arcade.
item.properties|f.tusk_helm: Modeled after noble beasts known for their strength and fearlessness, this helm strikes such terror and respect in its wearer's enemies that the deeds will be talked about for ages to come.
item.properties|f.gremlin_suit: A special suit tailored by a gremlin's touch to fit the frame of a knight. It protects the wearer while providing a full range of motion for thwacking, knocking, or mending.
item.properties|f.green_ward: A sturdy shield with an emerald sheen that saves Spiral Knight recruits from the perils of sharp spikes and deadly toxins.
conversation.properties|m.hunter_2a: Smashing\! Then perhaps you and your mates will be of service to this lodge. You see, the alchemy machine you see before you can craft magnificent monster trophies for your Guild Hall. \n\nThe alchemy machines uses materials and crowns from your Guild Treasury and deposits the results into the Guild Treasury as well.
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_b: Did I leave my calibur back at the Arsenal Station...?
item.properties|f.winter_onesie: The perfect pajamas for passing out presents or patiently waiting for Impostoclaus' presence.
item.properties|f.raging_avenger_helm: A helm worn by heavenly guardians who watch over a kingdom hidden atop a magma-covered mountain.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_shield_2: As your shield absorbs damage it will turn from green to red and eventually break. Once it's broken you cannot defend until it regenerates, so be careful\!
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Roarmulus Twins \nThese giant gun puppies showcase impenetrable armor and high powered munitions. Their skin is so thick they are only vulnerable to fraternal firepower.
guild.properties|m.confirm_promote: Are you sure you want to promote {0} to {1}?
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro3_2a:
I've established a comlink with Knights that have formed a Rescue Camp up ahead.  If you head north, you should eventually reach it. 

I'm going to stay here for now and locate any other Knights that have crashed in the area.  I'll meet you at the Rescue Camp before sunset. 

And should you encounter anything really dangerous, press [[?DEFEND]] to use your shield\!
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_3a: Sadly, even with our link to the Spirit Mother restored we can only do so much to save this place. Yet, even as one path closes another might open. It is the nature of this shifting world.  Good fortune, star-borne.
item.properties|f.recover_accessory: Accessory tickets can be redeemed at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
monster.properties|m.fired_3: Ahh, I'm gonna have to fire you. OK?
mission.properties|r.eye_of_needle_5a: Roger that.  So you've got some missions lined up for me?
item.properties|f.arcane_salamander_suit: A Salamander Suit imbued with magical power.  It is thought to be made from the familiars of powerful witches.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_mouse_move: Keyboard used for advanced commands, quickslots and chat
item.properties|f.obsidian_carbine: A deadly gun made from the obsidian obelisks found within the realm of the Apocrea. With every shot fired, a faint whisper is heard, believed to be the true name of its target.
mission.properties|o.alchemy_beginners: Learn about the wonders of alchemy\!
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Biotech Hahn is attempting to further his research of fiend and undead family monsters and is requesting samples from your recent missions. uplink.properties|i.crowns: The number of crowns to attach.
guildhelp.properties|m.storage_info: The Guild Storage acts like a community item bank. Guild members of the appropriate rank can add or remove equipment or items to the Storage as they see fit. It's a great way to share resources between guildmates, or to help out newer members\!\n WARNING\: Items placed in Guild Storage can be removed and claimed by any guild member with access to Guild Storage. Do not put items into Guild Storage that you want to keep for yourself\!
item.properties|f.pullover: The perfect pullover for parties and perilous adventures alike.
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_5a: Handy, I'll keep it in mind.  What else you got?
dungeon.properties|m.graveyard_desc: A graveyard is a terrible place that simultaneously exists in the world of the living and the dead. Though they contain secret treasures in their dark corners, they are home to ancient horrors that wish to consume all who enter. Once inside, finding an exit as fast as possible is advised.
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_mask: An impressive mask instilled with the might of Kat Hissers, the unstable bombers of the Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research
exchange.properties|m.coinex_offer_cance: You have been refunded {0} energy for your cancelled energy offer.
shop.properties|p.sell_costume: Are you sure you want to sell costume items for very little crowns? This is a bad deal.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_lazy_gobble_: A festive fall snipe that will stay where it's placed.
item.properties|f.tabard_rose: An aged, embroidered tabard that once belonged to a Knight of the Rose, a sacred order of brave and especially dashing heroes whose numerous adventures are the subject of many folk tales. The Knights of the Rose were said to be peerless fencers, believing that their blades were like the flowers of their name\: a delicate thing of beauty that hides a vicious sting.
item.properties|f.woven_pathfinder_armor: A flexible suit of armor built for mobility and interlaced with slime fibers to protect against prickly and thorny foes.
item.properties|f.shadow_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who gain their powers using forbidden, dark arts.
item.properties|f.frenzy_champion_helm: The helm of one who defied the gods and stormed the gates of a heavenly kingdom. Some say that whistling winds are the eternal warcries of her siege.
item.properties|f.pile_o_pillows: A freshly laundered basket of pillows, ready for throwing at your friends\!
mission.properties|m.intro_reward_arcade: Select a gate to view the gate map and enable options for starting your expedition\!
item.properties|f.irontech_bomb: A heavy bomb wrapped in thick iron plates. Though it is slower than most bombs, it packs a powerful punch.
mission.properties|o.darkest_forces: Learn about the most powerful fiend and undead monsters
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_4a: Yes, I feel the same way.  We owe it to them to put an end to this gremlin threat as quickly as possible. \n\nI've lined up several missions for you that will take you to locations where gremlins seem to be gathering resources for Project R.  Your briefing should explain everything.
item.properties|f.flaming_pulsar: A pulsar modified with a scorching energy that burns greater over time. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight2_1a: Emanations from this world's core have had strange effects on our battle sprites.
item.properties|f.blitz_needle: For when suppression just isn't good enough, the Blitz Needle specializes in "oppressive fire".
exchange.properties|m.could_not_fill: Unable to fill order as submitted, please check updated price and try again.
item.properties|f.supernova: The destruction left in the wake of this peerless pistol is anything but nebulous. Supernova shots become more powerful the further they travel.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_2a: Yes, we nature sprites are the rain, the root, and the soil. But you are not like us. You are like the ones below.
mission.properties|m.shadow_knows_5a: Done here?  Yes, though there's just one more thing I wish to add.
uplink.properties|m.autoprune: Note\: Mail is automatically deleted 30 days after sent date.
item.properties|f.neutralizer: You'd be surprised at the number of practical applications to be had from two substances that, when combined, leave quite literally nothing in their wake. Neutralizer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
item.properties|f.proto_gun: A compact firearm issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
mission.properties|o.another_trace: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
guild.properties|e.guild_in_default: Sorry, that guild is in-default. Try again later.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: There isn't much time. I can't reach you from here and you need to make it out. Warn headquarters. Warn Haven\! If the Core isn't kept sealed The Swarm will escape and it will continue to consume everything and everyone.
item.properties|f.leviathan_blade: A rare treasure of the Spiral Order, the blows from this mythical sword are said to rain down upon its victims like the water from a tidal wave.
item.properties|f.deconstructor: A bomb specially designed for dismantling machinery, sentient or otherwise.
mission.properties|m.shadowplay_1a: Too late again\! I have already collected the power I need to use the Artifact and nothing you can do now will stop what I have set in motion.
mission.properties|b.laboratory_visit: Biotech Morlin is in charge of the Lab located in the Haven Garrison. He seeks a capable knight willing to brave the Clockworks in order to secure a cache of 'battle sprites' lost during the crash of the Skylark.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_9a: Rulen was recruited as the technical genius that Captain Ozlo believed would be required for navigating the vast, mechanized world of the Clockworks.  His primary responsibilities included everything from disabling locks to repairing armor to wrecking sentient constructs.  He was additionally the lead on analyzing the Core once the squad reached it.
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r9: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.boltbrand: A high-tech blade that fuses Spiral and Clockwork technology. It can produce a powerful electrical discharge that is harmless to knights.
mission.properties|r.winterfest_danger_1: I need all the help I can get, tell me all you know.
item.properties|f.hive_box: Contains one unique hive-themed item. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.firebreak_armor: Upgraded Emberbreak armor further hacked to resist fire.
item.properties|f.exp_center_4f: An expansion that adds a small central room to the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.crimsonite_deposit_2: A good-sized mineral deposit that will generate several units of crimsonite.
item.properties|f.woven_shade_armor: A loose fitting suit of armor that enables its wearer to slink through the shadows and assault unaware enemies.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_3a: Wow, it sounds like you've already had quite the adventure, {0}\!  Spiral HQ will most certainly be interested in that artifact you recovered.  It's remarkable that you were able to face off against a gremlin in the Clockworks and survive.
item.properties|f.shock_raider_tunic: Anti-static fur lines this raiders coat.
craft.properties|e.cant_use_accessory: This item is not compatible with this accessory type.
item.properties|f.warm_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within burns strong enough that it feels warm to the touch.
exchange.properties|i.mini_buy: Instantly buy energy with crowns at the energy exchange.
item.properties|f.brute_jelly_shield: A thick shield made from the remains of particularly ill-mannered slimes. It is durable, light, and delightfully berry-flavored.
mission.properties|r.new_chapter_2a: What a strange world.  What else do you have for me, Kora?
item.properties|f.static_flash: A Proto Bomb modified to generate small bursts of electricity upon detonation.
mission.properties|o.hall_of_heroes_5: Visit the Hall of Heroes and receive your commendation
conversation.properties|r.tut_warden_1a: Great, I'm looking forward to a hot meal.
conversation.properties|m.npc_lostknight: I could leave but think of all I could learn if I stayed\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_2a: What the- are these...battle sprites? Something has happened to them, they've changed into some kind of creature.
item.properties|f.polar_twilight_wolf_co: A warm coat, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. It is said that the polar twilight is a wonderous sight to behold.
item.properties|f.cosmic_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
chat.properties|m.no_last_teller: Nobody has sent you a /tell to respond to.
item.properties|f.haze_bomb: An alchemical bomb that creates a noxious cloud capable of stunning those caught inside.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
pvp.properties|m.removed: Your coliseum signup has been cancelled.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_efbf39: Hit an opponent with a snowball in Lockdown.
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_luggage: Some stylish suitcases suitable for stowing everything you'll need for the last trip you'll ever take.
social.properties|m.autofriend_single_ma: Your {0} friend {1} just started playing Spiral Knights as {2}\! Unfortunately, that knight already has a full friend list, so you were unable to be auto-friended.

item.properties|f.proto_duelist: A six-shot firearm preferred by the marksmen of Spiral Knight recruits.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_r9: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
conversation.properties|m.rc_virgil_2a: This walkway leads right out over a massive chasm.  Don't want you getting blown off into the oblivion below.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
guild.properties|i.guild_shop: Purchase guild furnishings and upgrades using funds from the Guild Treasury.
conversation.properties|m.casino_royalje: Three lichens slide into a room...
item.properties|f.vial_stun_super: An ornate glass vial containing shimmering flash pellets. It can be used to inflict enemies with Stun.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be too stupefied to give chase\!
mission.properties|r.shadow_knows_3a: I sometimes find dark matter mineral deposits in the Clockworks, perhaps-
item.properties|f.stellar_sentinel_helm: This helm was was once worn by Isoran starfarers of eons long passed that stood watch over extrasolar operations. With this equipped, you feel like you understand the machinations of the universe.
global.properties|m.peer_shutting_down: The requested peer is shutting down.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Lord Vanaduke \nLittle is known about the eternal Duke of the Almirian Empire. Our sensors show the mask is a source of power as well as a potential weakness.
conversation.properties|r.rfc_court_6b: I don't see or hear any of those things.
exchange.properties|m.offertobuy_tooltip: Submit your offer to the market. If a seller is found while you are online, you will receive a chat notification.
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r3: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Hail, Vanguard {0}. Kora said you had news of the Alpha Squad. Please, give us your report.
mission.properties|o.target_acquired: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_2: The Forge uses the heat stored in your gear and combines it with the power of Fire Crystals to unlock its new potential.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: I worked my employees hard to get where I am today.
item.properties|f.blazing_pulsar: A highly advanced pulsar capable of launching compact infernos from afar. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
mission.properties|b.p_toxic_plant_r7:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has uncovered a gremlin bioweapons facility deep within the Clockworks. It is believed that this facility belongs to a member of the Crimson Order known only as 'Herex.' The Recon Rangers have been tasked with infiltrating the facility and uncovering the nature of Herex's bioweapons before they are put to use.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
projectx.properties|e.cant_loadout: That loadout can't be used here.
item.properties|f.nether_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a corrupted tortodrone. A tormented howl of rage can be heard on the wind when this shield smashes through your foes.
exchange.properties|m.trade4crowns_toolt: The best current market price. A response of ??? indicates that there is no current market offer for the amount you've entered.

item.properties|f.hololite_box: Contains one randomly-chosen Hololite costume or accessory.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.ignition_armor: Light armor augmented to help protect knights venturing into heated situations.
item.properties|f.rugged_robo_wrecker: An upgraded robo wrecker that has assisted a great many constructs in becoming smoldering, scrap metal heaps.
item.properties|f.furni_bench_manor: An exquisite bench, perfect for perching in plush repose.
item.properties|f.khorovod: A low-tech, but nonetheless well-made sword whose brutal strikes can stun unsuspecting enemies. Wielding it makes you feel like dancing.
item.properties|f.magmatic_fanatic_mask: A mask said to have been worn by fanatics that worshiped a magma god. Its fires will light the path to victory.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_charge_3: Now that you know how to perform a charge attack, let's apply that to a more advanced battle. Charge your weapon and unleash at the right moment when the enemy is exposed. Good luck\!
conversation.properties|r.sl_guard_3: I'll get a Shadow Key and start investigating\!

helptips.properties|m.loading14: Do not share your account information. Game Masters will never ask you for your password.
item.properties|f.angelic_helmet: A beautiful costume designed exclusively for great heads.

mission.properties|o.blades_fallen: Place the sword of an unknown knight at the memorial in the soldier's graveyard
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_4a: It's all a bit too convenient.  But do gremlins really have this kind of power?  I suspect something more than even what they are capable of engineering. \n\nIn any case, this Almire, it's not a kingdom any longer.  All that remains is a great citadel that seems to be engulfed in never-ending flames that Spiral HQ has been calling the 'Firestorm Citadel.'  From what we can tell, the whole place is swarming with undead and built like a fortress.
item.properties|f.plate_helm: A heavy duty helm suited for heavy combat.
item.properties|f.shadowsun_stetson: A dashing hat for duelists who prefer to get their work done at midnight, rather than high noon.
item.properties|f.wild_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Hail, Vanguard. It will be a rough road ahead of us but I am confident that we are up to the challenge.
conversation.properties|m.barracks_boost: Want to earn even more Krogmo Coins with every match?
conversation.properties|r.hunter_2a: Ah, so it's a team effort?
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_6: Our geological research is ongoing, so there may yet be other fascinating uses for these strange and powerful minerals.
item.properties|f.irontech_destroyer: The big brother of the Irontech Bomb, the Destroyer unleashes the full potential of irontech power.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_danger: The Grinchlins have sabotaged Winterfest for the last time. Take the fight to them\!
chat.properties|m.usage_kick: Usage\: /{0} player name\nKicks a player offline.
item.properties|f.hazardous_diablo_helm: A helm worn by members of the Scarlet Scouts. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of a demon said to have broken off its own horn to use as a weapon when it faced its end.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.emberbreak_armor: Armor with a hacked elemental core aimed at resisting fire. However, this non-standard modification creates other elemental weaknesses.
mission.properties|b.shadowplay: Even after Lord Vanaduke's defeat at your hands, Firestorm Citadel continues to burn with accursed flames. Though the nature sprites have been steadily making progress in fighting the flames, something or someone has recently caused a violent resurgence in its destructive power. Spiral HQ requests that you gather together a crack squad of knights and return to the collapsing ruins of Firestorm Citadel in order to discover the source of the disturbance.
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_4: We've doubled the amount of patrols around Haven in case there is another attack, but I have a feeling that those gremlins already got what they came for...
item.properties|f.sacred_pathfinder_armo: A reinforced suit of double padded armor that is sure to stop the sharpest of foes.
mission.properties|m.the_flickering_flam: We don't know for sure but it has to be related to the Artifact. The energy signatures are identical. If the Artifact is involved that means...
item.properties|f.valestone_deposit_1: A small mineral deposit that will generate a single unit of moonstone.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_end_1:
{0}\! You did it\!  I've got my kitchen back\! 

Remember, you can exchange the Cake Slices you receive for awesome cake helms from Maskwell in the Haven Town Square. It's just like that old baker's saying, 'Wear the hide of your fallen foes to prove your might as a warrior\!' 

Ok, maybe I just say that.
redeem.properties|e.invalid_code: The code you entered was not found. Please double-check it and try again.
item.properties|f.punkin_pie_pan: A hot steamy pie made from real gourdlings\! Not suitable for Knight consumption, please discard at nearest friend.
chat.properties|m.smell_format_targeted: {0} gets a big whiff of {1}. Whew\!
mission.properties|b.p_r7_weap_4: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
mission.properties|o.p_heart_of_ice_r4: Discover the source of the terrible blizzards emanating from Amu-Sol
town.properties|m.rescue_camp_desc: The Rescue Camp serves as a refuge for newly dropped Spiral Knights. It offers a few creature comforts as well as a training facility to prepare recruits for their journey to Haven.
item.properties|f.quilted_demo_suit: A suit snugly lined with luxurious stay-alert quilting. It smells a bit sweaty.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Devilites \nDevilites are the workhorse of the underworld. If a Pit Boss catches an idle Devilite he may promote them to an angry Overtimer or a docile Yesman.
social.properties|m.autofriend_multiple_: These knights have automatically been made your friend\:\n{1}\n{2}
mission.properties|m.silent_legion_2a: I could swear I heard them just now, their voices carrying in the wind.  No longer screams, no longer cries- whispers.  Indecipherable even in the stillness of this place.  Are they leaving me here?  Why must I be left behind? \n\nYou... I warned you not to proceed, to stay away from me.  Now you'll learn what they did... that those who are close to me die\!
dungeon.properties|m.golden_slime_prize_: Each spin of the wheel rewards you with a random prize, sometimes including very special items\! Requires 50 Golden Slime Coins or equivalent crowns.
monster.properties|m.promotion_2: We could use a guy like you in management.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_roarmulus: 'Project R' is nearly complete. We must gather more scrap\!
mission.properties|o.p_halloween_r6: Seek an audience with the Punkin King.
item.properties|m.use_change_color: Use your {0} to change your personal color?
mission.properties|m.ancient_generator_1: What do we have here, more little creatures that came from the sky?  Here to take my power and disturb my research? \n\nNo one disrupts the work of the great Schemer Razwog\!  I'll see to it you never leave this room alive\!
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_4a: Even though you have defeated Vanaduke, it appears as though the curse he brought down upon this kingdom still lingers. It requires all of our power to keep these raging shadow fires in check.
helptips.properties|m.branch_battle_warn: Two paths lie before you. Which one will you take?
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_4a: Bombs are special in that they have no standard attack.  A bomb can ONLY be used as a charge attack, so make sure to outmaneuver monsters while charging\!
item.properties|f.magnus: A large handgun with hard hitting rounds that can leave even the strongest of monsters dazed. A charged shot can even pierce through multiple enemies.
conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_2: After the Skylark crashed, its primary tearium core exploded, destroying a portion of the ship and leaving it without a main power source. Since so far we haven't found several hundred tons of tearium just lying around, the bird has effectively lost its wings.\n\nWith the help of the Strangers, we were able to set up a small base of operations here in Haven. Once we got our systems online, we discovered that within the heart of this rock resonates a power signature of unprecedented magnitude.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
conversation.properties|m.energy_info_3b: Energy is used for all sorts of things\! It's the primary currency for buying goods from the Supply Depot, it allows you to purchase upgrades for yourself, revive yourself in the Clockworks when you run out of Sparks of Life, and it's required to form a guild. \n\nYou'll also find all sorts of devices in the world that are powered up by using energy. Just look for the blue energy symbol on the device.

conversation.properties|m.fc_court_2: I am a sprite, a force of nature summoned to this realm to extinguish the unnatural fire that is consuming it. But Vanaduke discovered and imprisoned us. I managed to escape, but the other sprites remain in his custody.\n\nNow none may proceed beyond the court as columns of shadow fire block all exits. Shadow fire can only be extinguished with the water that flows from these spirit wells. The water is the purest found in all of nature, flowing directly from the springs within the realm of the Spirit Mother herself.

mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_12: I admire your courage but if initial reports of this construct monster are accurate, you'll need some additional help. I'll prepare a selection of battle sprites to be ready for bonding to you, {0}. We'll talk again once I've made the proper preparations.
item.properties|f.dragon_scale: An armored scale from what was thought to be an extinct creature. It reflects light with an otherworldly sheen.

conversation.properties|m.rc_vet_2a: Always be on your guard. Who knows what other dangers await us on this world?
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_shad: Hello {0}, I am Sylvin, a knight who utilizes gear that offers high shadow damage defense.  The recipes I have for you produce armor and shields that protect you from the shadow attacks of fiends and the undead. \n\nShadow defense can be harnessed from the shadows themselves.  The armor and shields I specialize in are derived from the very fiendish and undead creatures that seek to use the power of the shadows against you.  Plus, it looks incredibly scary and cool.
item.properties|f.heavy_hatchet: A big blade intended to fell trees. Unsurprisingly, you can also use it to fell enemies, blocks, mineral deposits and most anything else you'd care to hit with it.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_crystal: Crystal blocks are like breakable blocks except that if destroyed, they also destroy the crystal blocks of the same color connected to them.
conversation.properties|r.tortodrone_hav: Thanks for the tip\! I'll track down those glyphs.

shop.properties|m.cart_vitapod_adjusted: You may only equip one best vitapod\: cart adjusted.
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_6: Fire Crystals are somewhat unstable, the amount needed for a successful forge varies. \nAdditionally, we've discovered that adding more Fire Crystals results in chances at special bonuses that will be applied to the item\! \n
helptips.properties|m.tg3_charge_1: Spiral Knights are capable of unleashing the hidden powers locked from within the weapons they use called "charge attacks." Charge attacks are more powerful than a standard attack and can often produce special effects.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_zombie_bellh: A bellhop with unusual dedication in charge of carrying luggage to a guest's quarters. Most just offer to carry the bags themselves.
mission.properties|o.mission_sprite_2: Secure a cache of battle sprites and return them to the Lab
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_7b: (Your words do not seem to faze the fallen knight, whose mind seems to be lost somewhere in the glories of his past life.)
item.properties|f.divine_avenger: An upgraded Avenger forged from the purest sun steel. There are few foes remaining in this world that are worthy enough to be defeated by such a fine blade, and there are still fewer heroes worthy of wielding it.
helptips.properties|m.tut_victory: You've made it\! Walk on ahead to enter the Rescue Camp.
mission.properties|r.search_continues_2a: A prison to keep something inside?
item.properties|f.imperial_tricorne: A magnificent hat worn by those who aspire to build empires on which the sun will never set.
item.properties|f.azure_guardian_armor: A grand set of armor commonly donned by the leaders of the Spiral Order. It's extraordinarily thick and protective, but as comfortable to wear as flowing miracloth.
mission.properties|b.toy_soldiers: Recon Knights are reporting much greater numbers of mecha knights in the first stratum of the Clockworks and have discovered a mecha knight production facility close to Haven. \n\nMecha knights are believed to be gremlin-engineered sentries of the construct family that share many of the capabilities of a Spiral Knight.  Proceed with caution when seeking out the production center and then shut it down for good\!
chat.properties|m.usage_cry: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nCause your knight to cry.

conversation.properties|m.och_leader_3_1: (Lieutenant  Feron appears to have been injured) \n\nThere you are, {0}, here for the big finale, eh?

mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_heav: Hello {0}, I'm Izola, a knight who utilizes gear fit for a squad guardian.  The recipes I have for you produce highly defensive armor and hard-hitting weapons. \n\nHeavy weapons require precise timing to use effectively and the gear tends to slow you down some.  But what you sacrifice in usability is returned in sheer power.  The gear I specialize in will make you a knight that your squad can depend upon to stay alive and face even the fiercest of monsters.
item.properties|f.power_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.
item.properties|f.storm_champion_helm: The helm of one who defied the gods and stormed the gates of a heavenly kingdom. Some say that thunderclaps are the eternal echoes of her siege.
item.properties|f.frenzy_plate_mail: A legendary suit of armor said to imbue the wearer with the frenzy of a thousand demigods.
helptips.properties|m.tg_pots: Some objects can be picked up and used or even thrown across the room. Try throwing a pot at that switch.
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_2a: Oh {0}, I'm just doing my job.  And speaking of which, I have a job for you\!
item.properties|f.supply_standard_compac: A package of useful supplies valued by Spiral Knight research teams working deep within the Clockworks.  This standard pack has enough supplies to last a few Knights one week.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_b_: You made it, {0}\!  I'm happy to see you arrive here in Haven safe and sound.  I'll confirm with Spiral HQ that you will now be undertaking missions in Haven. \n\nTo start, I've issued you a few missions that will help get you acclimated with all that Haven has to offer.  Be sure to say hello to the Strangers as you begin exploring.
item.properties|f.super_dark_matter_bomb: A shard bomb stuffed with even more Dark Matter. How much Dark Matter is too much? This much.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_6a: I'll contact you again soon, good luck {0}\!
item.properties|f.nodeslime_armor: A variegated veiling ward worn by vehemently venerated victors.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_5: ...and the required materials, orbs of alchemy, and crowns needed to transmute the item.
mission.properties|r.first_contact_b_4a: I'd like to help however I can.  Where is Spiral HQ now located?
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_3b: Thank you for your help. When I am ready, I will enter the final gate.
item.properties|f.furni_block_ice: A block made of densely packed snow. It's perfect for assembling elaborate snow forts\!
item.properties|f.dread_venom_striker: An assassin's armament whose edge causes deep wounds that seep with vitriol. You should probably store it separately from your snacks.
dungeon.properties|m.training_grounds_de: This derelict portion of the Clockworks has been modified to train new recruits in the fine art of not dying when they have the rest of the world to explore.
mission.properties|m.the_flickering_flam: That is our assumption as well. I hate to send you back into that horrible place, {0}, but if there is any hope of quickly getting to the bottom of this mystery it is you. The citadel is still very dangerous so please be careful\!
helptips.properties|m.tut_fighting: Aim at enemies with your mouse and attack with [[ACTION]].
helptips.properties|m.loading12: If you experience a problem of any kind, press F2 to send a bug report.
mission.properties|o.spark_roar: Prove your valor against a legion of elite elemental monsters
helptips.properties|m.alpha_recon: This recon module was left by a member of the Alpha Squad.  The recording it contains has been copied to your Arsenal.
item.properties|f.sun_shards: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in solar-charged Luminite. Whatever you do, don't look directly at it.
projectx.properties|e.name_too_consec: Sorry, names cannot contain the same letter in a row more than twice.
mission.properties|r.alchemy_beginners_9: I think I've got it, thanks\!
mission.properties|o.plan_of_attack: Recover the gremlin schematics in the secret test lab
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_12b: Thanks Bechamel, I'll be seeing you\!
conversation.properties|m.hav_snipes_2a: The snipes are the graceful, adorable, fetchingly-corpulent birds you see roaming about Haven. Some say they are the most beautiful creatures in the galaxy, but you would never hear that from the snipes themselves as they are incredibly modest.
item.properties|f.punkin_cinnamug: A frothy blend of punkins and cinnamon that is sure to burn those that don't wait for this mug to cool.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_4: Required items will appear once your sprite is ready to level up. After your sprite has consumed enough heat, a 'required material' notice will appear above the feeding tray. This material MUST be fed to the sprite in order for it to advance further.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_2a: After the Skylark crashed, its primary tearium core exploded, destroying a portion of the ship and leaving it without a main power source. Since so far we haven't found several hundred tons of tearium just lying around, the bird has effectively lost its wings. \n\nWith the help of the Strangers, we were able to set up a small base of operations here in Haven. Once we got our systems online, we discovered that within the heart of this rock resonates a power signature of unprecedented magnitude.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_weap_4: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_4a: Energy is essential in order to acquire powerful gear and items from the Supply Depot. \n\nYou will find all sorts of uses for it in your travels, just look for the energy symbol\!
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_r9: Meet with Biscotti in her kitchen and provide 'baking assistance.'
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Parma\! Your Scout\! You're alive\! Where are you\!? We need to get you back to Haven.
item.properties|f.fur_coat: An extra-toasty coat made from the hide of a furry beast.
item.properties|f.radiant_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within is wild and mysterious, shining brighter than any natural fire.
mission.properties|b.alien_ooze: One of our field research teams is under siege from a large colony of lichens. Lichens are an alien species of the slime family thought to have come to the Clockworks via a meteor that crashed on to the surface of Cradle.  This particular species of slime is formed from innumerable smaller slimes that form mobile, sentient 'colonies.' \n\nLichen colonies can further combine to form larger and larger versions of themselves, rapidly evolving a range of deadly claws and barbs.  Prevent them from combining at all costs and save the research team\!
mission.properties|o.p_r3_gate_gremlin: Steal the gremlin schematics from the gremlin construction site\!
global.properties|m.internal_error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.
guild.properties|m.invite_message: Enter an optional message to include with your invitation\:
item.properties|f.kat_tribe_fetish: A tattered fetish from the now-extinct Kat Tribe, the ferocious feline warriors responsible for the destruction of the Owlites and their prestigious High Academy of Magicks. The fetishes were carried into battle by Kat warriors and are said to bring good luck despite the ill fate of the Kat Tribe itself.
item.properties|f.grey_feather_mantle: A cloak for renowned Owlite scholars, this feathery frock is filled with the wisdom of the ages... and is super soft\!
item.properties|m.insufficient_crystals: Insufficient crystals to forge this item.
item.properties|f.sacred_hazard_armor: A sturdy suit of armor for those who want to shoot some slimes.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_3a: Well, keep your wits about you. If the surface of this world is crawling with monsters, who knows what you'll find down there in the dark\!
item.properties|f.solid_cobalt_helm: A sturdy Cobalt Helm with upgraded internal systems and external reinforcement.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: I would like to hear about the battle sprites again.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_danger: The Grinchlins have sabotaged Winterfest for the last time. Take the fight to them\!
item.properties|f.arctic_rogue_mail: A plated mail said to be crafted by an arctic rogue. It comes augmented with ice plating to conceal your location during arctic expeditions.
mission.properties|m.razwog_defeated: There is a strange crimson symbol on Razwog's clothing.
exchange.properties|m.billing_declined: Your card has been declined. Please check that the information you have entered is correct.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We're in\!  This is it\!
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_2a: Do Strangers sell anything else besides weapons and gear?
item.properties|f.sentenza: An ancient handgun forged from shadow steel. It is said to have been wielded by an evil one who possessed "angel eyes."
item.properties|f.vile_seal: A small scrap of ancient parchment imbued with dark magicks. It is believed that they grant power to those with evil souls.
conversation.properties|r.almire_histori: What happened to the rest of the kingdom?
item.properties|f.power_mitt: A must have in every kitchen. The comfortable fit and heavyweight silverweave surface are great for handling high heat. Now you're cooking with power\!
item.properties|f.trojan_armor: The armor of the stalwart Spiral Wardens is said to give great comfort to other knights. Nothing says 'here comes the cavalry' like the sight of these iron giants taking to the battlefield.
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_f: Where is the safety on this thing?
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: There are three distinct battle sprites available. Each has responded to the power emanating from this world differently and each offers a unique combat experience. \n\nThese sprites include the fiery drakon, the radiant seraphynx, and the shadowy maskeraith.
conversation.properties|m.vise_seerus:
Hello there lad\!  
Taking on ol' Seerus aye?  Careful now, he's not right in the head. Proper imbalanced that one.  

He and I go way back, but not in any way worth remembering.  Should your mission prove successful, see if you can bring me back a little souvenir.  I'll make ya something nice for your troubles.
item.properties|f.obsidian_mantle_of_dev: 'Wrap thy self in my embrace and succumb to my infinite love. Let your breath drift from you like candle smoke, dreaming deeper and deeper still.'
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_4c: Harness upgrades are definitely worth the crowns. Superior versions of each harness reduce combat skill cooldowns\!
projectx.properties|m.return_to_wegner: Return to Wegner for more info about minerals.
item.properties|f.circuit_breaker_armor: Armor with a hacked elemental core aimed at resisting shock. However, this non-standard modification creates other elemental weaknesses.
item.properties|f.shocking_salt_bomb: A large chunk of rock salt primed with a potent explosive. For nutritional purposes, this particular chunk of salt has been enriched with dangerous amounts of electricity. Wait, what?
item.properties|f.super_freeze_barrier: Surrounds you with potent icy orbs that can freeze hostiles in their tracks
conversation.properties|m.tut_warden_3a: Nicely done, {0}\! It seems you know your way around the battlefield. \n\nCome on, let's head to the camp. Maybe you can help us figure out just what the heck is going on here.
item.properties|f.ash_agni: When this bomb has left the battlefield in ashes, then, and only then, will your enemies have permission to die.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_9a: If so, we must prevent further damage.  Now please, there are yet more sprites to be rescued.  And who knows what we'll discover when we get there\!
item.properties|f.philoso_feather: A large, grey feather plucked from the greatest of the Owlite magicians.
item.properties|f.super_shard_bomb: A shard bomb stuffed with even more depleted Crimsonite. The choicest cure for a combative creature is clearly a crystal to the cranium.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: What are you doing\!? My cakes\! My pretty cakes\! Unacceptable\!
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_7b: You may only select one ultimate skill per sprite skill so choose wisely\! Also note that selecting ultimate skills will further change the appearance of your sprite. \n\nWith all these options, your max level sprite is sure to look  and behave differently from the rest\!
mission.properties|o.vile_engine: Locate and destroy the bizarre slime generators below the lichen colony
item.properties|f.brimstone: A smelly, stygian, sulfuric shard commonly found in the Underworld.
item.properties|f.raiders_hammer: An ornate hammer infused with the power of a great storm, it's as cutting-edge as a blunt weapon can be.
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_h:
The Clockworks have been so consistent for so long\! Just ticking along like, well... you know. But now *something is happening* and I don't know what it is\!\! 

I'm so excited\! 

Bring us samples of these Mysterious Spikes and we'll make good trades for them\!
uplink.properties|m.confirm_att_del: You haven't accepted the attachment. Are you sure you want to delete it?
item.properties|f.humbug_hat: A horrible hat worn by those who truly loathe the magic of Winterfest. The only possible explanation for this feeling is having a heart two sizes too small.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_partypad_2: This is a party pad. It's a big floor button that only activates when all members of the party are standing on it. They often open doors, but sometimes there is a little more to it than that...
uplink.properties|m.auction_incomplete: We're sorry, but the item you tried to sell was not sold.\n\nTip for sellers\: Always sell shiny items that everyone wants at super good prices.
item.properties|f.argent_peacemaker: An ancient handgun forged from sun silver. Its bullets serve as ushers for those that refuse to leave this world.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeexplo: One of them lobbed a spike at me\!
item.properties|f.chroma_tear: A crystallized Chromalisk tear suitable as a lens for focusing weaponry, or for correcting myopia.
arena.properties|m.revive_desc: Use a Spark of Life to revive early and gain an edge in battle.
helptips.properties|m.terminal_1: Welcome traveler, this is a Clockwork Terminal. Take a moment to rest and change your gear. \n\nUse the elevator either to return to Haven or delve into a more dangerous stratum of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.raging_warrior_helm: A helm worn by a fabled sword master so angry, his rage alone could fell armies that rose against him.
item.properties|f.drake_scale_mail: Armor forged from the scales of beasts thought to be the descendants of dragons.
conversation.properties|r.tut_intro_1a: Roger that, I'm on my way\!
item.properties|f.confetti_dark_harvest_: Celebrate the Dark Harvest Festival by launching a sizeable gourd into the air. What comes next is up to the Punkin King...
conversation.properties|m.npc_teaser_kni: This last mission sure was a strange one. We were clearing the way to an elevator when we saw some odd structures off in the distance. We couldn't see any way to reach them though.  I guess we'll just have to keep an eye out for them in the future.  The Clockworks is ever-shifting after all.
item.properties|f.guild_members_250: Allows your guild to recruit up to 250 members\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_9a: Yes I know. Anyway I also understand that some of the sprite transport crates were empty again. Something is not right... \n\nNow then, secure that last cache of sprites before whatever is stealing sprites finds it\!
sprites.properties|d.explosive_firestorm: Creates a series of explosions when unleashing the firestorm.
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_s:
We got enough that Anomalie let me mess around with a few. 

See, I had this handgun chassis from an old import.  Cool little launcher, but impossible to get parts for, especially the ammo. 

Well, with a little wrenching and a little creative misapplication of thermodynamics, I converted it into a pretty peppy little Spike Slicer\!
dungeon.properties|m.terminal_return_des: A level where travelers can safely return to the town above.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_3a: Over here we have a collection of valuable items and objects you will likely find in the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.pathfinder_armor: A handy set of armor for blazing trails and protecting against the bites of hungry monsters in the wild.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Trojan \nThese massive leviathans are invulnerable from the front. Hit the crystal on their back to bring them to their knees.
item.properties|f.umbral_blaster: An enhanced shadow blaster designed to neutralize alien bioforms.
item.properties|f.wicked_whisker: A whisker won from the great Kat Tribe hero, Margrel. They were traditionally worn as a ward against Owlite magics but now represent the triumph of goodly magical arts over evil.
mission.properties|o.shocking_sentient_s: Battle your way to the secret weapons facility
chat.properties|m.usage_sgo: Usage\: /{0} scene name\nMoves to the named scene.
conversation.properties|m.npc_campguard_: Welcome to our camp\! Have a seat by the campfire if you want a little break.
item.properties|f.kat_claw_raiment: A reclaimed raiment said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Scraith, first to scale the walls of the Owlite High Academy of Magicks.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_mat_0: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
social.properties|m.empty_feed: No recent event activity. Check back later.
projectx.properties|m.mission_imf: Recover the recon module in the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.
sprites.properties|d.haunted_haze: Any target that dies as a result of the damage caused by hexing haze will spawn a vengeful ghost that seeks out other targets and explodes on impact.
item.properties|f.haze_bomb_mkii: A Haze Bomb modified to disperse noxious chemicals over a wider range.
item.properties|f.lockdown_guardian_shie: A shield carried by a Spiral Guardian, a stalwart protector on the battlefield.
item.properties|m.gsc_vip: Golden Slime Casino C.U.B.E. Club Membership
logon.properties|m.failed_to_connect: Failed to connect to the server.
mission.properties|m.alien_ooze_1a: I have nothing to say yet, but it involves Beast Bells. (DEV-ONLY)
mission.properties|m.intro_arcade: Arcade Missions allow you to explore the ever-changing Clockworks without specific objectives. Visit the Haven Arcade to discover how you can transform the Clockworks to suit your needs\!
item.properties|f.sealed_sword: A mysterious sword of great untapped potential. It hums with raw power.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_7a: Brinks is the Token Trader, issuing certain items to Knights in exchange for tokens that can be collected within the Clockworks.  Tokens can be found in treasure blocks, issued as mission rewards or found when defeating special boss monsters.
item.properties|f.heater_shield: A shield with a built-in furnace that keeps its user toasty warm, protecting them from most freeze attacks. Many knights also use it as a makeshift stove top when out in the field.
social.properties|m.trader_left: Oops\! That player is no longer here.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_failedpar: The candle's going out\!  They're coming\! Curse Kalem for going after that treasure...
item.properties|f.sudaruska: A rugged weapon for the knight who is more than willing to trade style and panache for ridiculous amounts of blunt force trauma.
guild.properties|m.treasury_warning: WARNING\: Deposits made to the Treasury cannot be removed. Please review carefully before confirming.
mission.properties|r.true_champion_1a: It's good to know you care, Kora.
sprites.properties|d.hexing_haze: Creates a miasma around you that hexes any target within. Each hex has a timer that deals damage to its target upon termination. For every target acquired by hexing haze, the duration of the miasma increases.
item.properties|f.mechaknight_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a mecha knight.  It's so convincing, your friends just might try to deconstruct you\!
item.properties|f.mercurial_demo_helm: A demo helm made from gremlin technology. It is for the bomber that wants a boost of speed, more power and a greatly reduced chance of dying by electrocution... which is probably every bomber out there.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_8a: Just one last shop to visit and then we're done. I've saved the best for last.
item.properties|f.aerohelm: A light, aerodynamic helmet sure to lift your attitude. It won't let you fly, so you'll just have to wing it.
item.properties|f.seraphic_helm: A beautiful mail coif that causes its wearer to strike out at evil with righteous fury.
item.properties|f.plasma_cell: A high-tech plasma source that could positively blind someone with science.
item.properties|f.royal_core: A sweet-smelling lump of ooze collected from a particularly noble specimen of slime.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_5: Favored items can be alchemized using this very alchemy machine you see before you. All it takes is two of any one material and some minerals from the Clockworks. Easy\!
item.properties|m.use_harness: Use this item to add the {0} as an available harness for your battle sprites? \n\nOnce installed, all sprites capable of using this harness can select it via your sprite manager. This action cannot be undone.
mission.properties|b.rotting_metropolis: It would seem as though those slime generators have been around much longer than we thought, seeping their vile toxins into any levels that should be near them. \n\nA modern city, much like those that the devilites inhabit seems to be overrun with these toxins, and was probably left behind by both the devilites and gremlins as a result.  Now a legion of slime and undead creatures haunt the place, festering in the poisons that linger in the air.  A squad that was attempting to pass through the city has gone missing.  Given that the very air is toxic, it is urgent that an experienced team enter this city and rescue the squad.  There is little hope left for them otherwise.
conversation.properties|m.dark_harvest_e:
Welcome to the Dark Harvest Festival\!  This annual celebration honors the undead with festive masks, delicious treats and dangerous tricks\!

To participate, explore the Clockworks and try to find the legendary 'Punkin King.'  This ghoulish gourd gives out candy to visitors.  You can exchange the candy to the traders here in the Haven Town Square for monster masks\!

Should you prefer the direct approach, or just need a few more, our vendor will sell you candy as well.
item.properties|f.plate_shield: A heavy iron shield adept at deflecting impacts that would otherwise leave you stunned.
pvp.properties|m.love_review_confirm: Are you sure? Once in review, you will no longer be able to make changes. Please completely test your level before submitting. It may take up to a week to review.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_3_3: Aye, it appears I'm no longer fit for this fight.  It's up to you now, {0}. You alone possess the strength to face Seerus and bring him to justice.  Many knights have lost their lives here today.  Honor their spirits by finishing the job\!
item.properties|e.not_use_busy: Can't use this item while occupied
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft1_r4: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
conversation.properties|m.tier_1_require: Well met, {0}.  In order to proceed and explore deeper depths of the Clockworks you must first achieve Rank 4-2. \n\nReturn here once you have completed the requisite Rank Missions.
item.properties|m.unlock_box_prompt: A Silver Key is required to open this Lockbox. Lockboxes contain random prizes inside.
mission.properties|m.another_trace_3a: The energy signature is coming from somewhere in the Royal Jelly Palace and we need you to investigate.  Royal Jellies are very territorial so you might have to get past its lair in order to reach your objective. Be wary though, a Royal Jelly surrounds itself with plenty of protection.  You will likely face significant resistance as you investigate the palace.
guild.properties|e.design_full: Sorry, design mode is already occupied by the maximum number of editors.
item.properties|f.rocket_sprocket: A sturdy sprocket used by machines that fire projectiles.
helptips.properties|m.loading3: You can revive another player by clicking on their portrait and granting them a Spark of Life
guild.properties|m.confirm_deposit_treas: Are you sure you want to deposit into the guild's treasury? This can never be undone, not even by a GM.
item.properties|m.add_more_bonuses: Add more fire crystals to unlock chances for bonuses\!
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r9: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
item.properties|f.eye_pack_shapely: Contains three shapely eyes for your style kit\: Triangle, Square, and Hexagon.
guild.properties|x.rename_desc1: Your guild may only be renamed every 30 days.
item.properties|f.divine_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
item.properties|f.crest_almire: A shimmering crest once proudly carried by the noble knights of Almire. It is said to bless those who fight for their homeland, granting them strength from within.
helptips.properties|m.mission_trap_chamb: All drones can move in a few different ways.
help.properties|m.clockworks_2: The depths below Haven can be classified into three progressively challenging Tiers. Be sure to equip Tier-appropriate gear when venturing forth, and remember\: the greatest treasures the Clockworks have to offer are far underground near the planet's Core, so delve deep\!
guild.properties|log.room_placed: Placed a {0} for {1} crowns, replacing a {2}.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_b_2a: It is now. I was just on my way to the bazaar to drop off some supplies when I was ambushed by these gremlins. I thought they were from Emberlight, a colony of gremlin outcasts, but it looks like I was mistaken. \n\nJust to be safe, would you mind helping me get these items to the bazaar?
projectx.properties|m.shutdown_warning: This server will be refreshed in {0} minutes. {1}
item.properties|f.night_cap_sallet: A comfortable cap for knights to wear at night. Sure to give the wearer lucid dreams to face their nightmares.
helptips.properties|m.tg_welcome: Welcome to the Training Ground, recruit. In this derelict section of the Clockworks you'll find areas we have built in order to train you in the fine art of not dying a horrible death. So pay attention to these helpful tips, ready your weapon, and get moving\!
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
projectx.properties|m.save_offer: In order to save the knight that you have created, you must create an account to use when logging into the game.
help.properties|m.support_3: If you're having problems with another player, click on them and choose the Complain option for assistance.
item.properties|f.kat_claw_mask: An impressive mask instilled with the might of Kat Clawers, the fearsome frontline fighters of the Kat Tribe.
lottery.properties|m.lottery_award: Congratulations to {0} for winning {1} in the Birdsong Trading Co. giveaway\!
sprites.properties|d.bristle: Increases the number of quills fired and their sticking duration.
item.properties|f.graviton_charge: A small explosive charge with mysterious origins. It is capable of generating a vortex of crushing gravity.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: The seraphynx sounds like the battle sprite for me\!
guild.properties|m.remove_expansion: Removing this expansion will lower upkeep but will also remove any installed rooms in the expansion. Any furnishings in the expansion will be returned to the Guild Treasury.\nYou will lose the following rooms\: {0}
item.properties|f.firecracker: A Proto Bomb modified to generate small bursts of fire upon detonation.
item.properties|f.torpor_tantrum: The ultimate sleep bomb. It's like a bedtime story, only more explodey.
item.properties|f.eye_pack_bedazzling: Contains three bedazzling eye shapes for your style kit\: Flower, Blooming, and Sparkle.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_bystande: Careful in there.  Looks like they had a big one with them...
mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_1:
The Hall of Heroes is where knights go to receive their Star Certification allowing them to access deeper depths of the Clockworks.  Each certification ensures a knight meets the star level required to deal with challenges in the upcoming missions. 

The Hall of Heroes also allows knights the opportunity to speak to veteran knights and discover their loadouts, even offering the opportunity to purchase recipes for these loadouts. 

Visit the Hall of Heroes and receive your 2 Star Certification in order to obtain access to missions within deeper levels of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.armor_fallen: A cursed suit of armor once worn by a celestial being cast down from paradise.
item.properties|f.bushy_tail: A peculiarly intact specimen of a Clockworks beast's tail.
item.properties|f.feral_cannon: A handgun alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. While wielding it, you can feel the penetrating energies within just waiting to be unleashed.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_2_2: Those heavy cogs are in our way, and from intel reports, the only way to open them up is from inside two adjacent gatehouses.  I will not waste needless lives battering at the gatehouse from the front.  I'll need you to find a way around.  Flank the defenses, get inside the gatehouse, and open up the gates\!
item.properties|f.redwood: A sturdy chunk of fine, unfinished wood. It's typically used in the production of cabinets.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
mission.properties|m.search_continues_1a: {0}, I cannot thank you enough.  We've already established our research base and are collecting a tremendous amount of data that we would have never had without your efforts.
item.properties|f.dark_matter_deposit_2: A good-sized mineral deposit that will generate several units of dark matter.
helptips.properties|m.atg_ublocks: Some blocks cannot be destroyed by normal attacks.
auction.properties|m.cancel_support:
Are you sure?


Use your GM powers to cancel this auction and refund everyone involved?
mission.properties|o.shopping_again: Follow Bechamel on a tour of the Bazaar's more advanced offerings
dungeon.properties|m.candlestick_keep.de: All that remains of the Owlite Academy, the Candlestick Keep is now a grim shadow of the once great school of magical arts.  Knights who have made it out of this cursed keep have only this advice to offer- 'stay in the light.'
helptips.properties|m.tg_doors: Doors can be opened in many different ways.
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research
uplink.properties|m.tf2_end:
To Whom It May Concern\: 

I have confirmed your arrival at the Clockworks Terminal, and have obtained the relevant data regarding our competitor's catalog. Mann Co. appreciates your cooperation in this task. 

In return for your assistance, we have remitted to you one (1) Mann Co. Brand "Spiral Sallet" replica headwear. No refunds or exchanges will be offered for this reward, and Mann Co. is not liable for any injury sustained while attempting to use said reward. 

Regards,

uplink.properties|m.ironclaw_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, we have intercepted gremlin transmissions from this facility that indicate they are building some kind of weapon to destroy Haven\!  It is your mission to infiltrate the facility, destroy this weapon and save Haven from destruction\! 

Known only as 'Project Roarmulus,' it is said to be impenetrable from standard attacks.  You will have to find a way to break whatever armor it is using.  Intel suggests this weapon is located deep within the facility. 

But getting to it won't be easy.  You will find that gremlins have little care for a safe work environment as live rockets seem to be fired every which way at all times.  However you should be able to utilize the 'polarity walls' you will find in testing environments to block the oncoming rockets.  Look for a purple and gold switch to toggle them. 

We've also detected another Recon Module of the Alpha Squad somewhere in this factory.  Retrieve it if you can\! 

Good luck\!

mission.properties|b.silent_legion:
Guardian Knight Arkus was one of the finest warriors serving the Spiral Knights until some time shortly after the crash.  As one of the first to search for the Alpha Squad, Arkus's own squad perished in a grisly battle with a horde of dust zombies.  Since then, Arkus has blamed himself for their loss, saying that he betrayed his Guardian's Oath to protect his squad. 

Arkus now journeys into the Clockworks alone, never risking the loss of another squad and we believe, somehow trying to find the squad he once lost.  As these expeditions began to appear self-destructive, Spiral HQ issued him a direct order to cease. 

Arkus ignored these orders and has gone deep into the Clockworks and not returned.  Not wanting to lose the last member of his squad, Spiral HQ is asking you to pursue him to his last known whereabouts, some kind of mysterious statuary at depth 26.

Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.
