dungeon.properties|m.vip_tos:
This C.U.B.E. Club Membership Agreement constitutes a binding legal document between the undersigned (the "knight"), Golden Casino Holdings LLC (the "Casino"), and the entire slime community ("slimes").

 I. General Terms and Conditions
  1. Membership in the C.U.B.E. Club is for personal use only and can not be transferred to other knights, Devilites, or other Clockwork creatures.
  2. Selling access to your ability to spin is prohibited.
  3. Keep your arms and legs inside the Casino at all times.
  4. Please do not drop items into the core.
 II. Description of Benefits
  1. Benefits are varied and may be changed at any time.
  2. Lounge access is not guaranteed and limited by availability.
  3. Buffalo Wings are not included.
  4. All disputes will be arbitrated by the Casino floor manager and all decisions are final.
 III. Winnings, Payments, and Fees
  1. Winnings may be paid in Golden Slime Coins at the discretion of the Casino floor manager.
  2. No additional fees are collected at this time.
 IV. Promotional Awards
  1. Sale promotions\: Reduced prices for members, if any, will be displayed plainly in the shop interface.
  2. The Gift Shop reserves the right to modify, alter, discontinue or terminate these promotions at any time for any reason whatsoever without notice to the end users. No whiners.
 V. Restrictions and Conditions of Use
  1. As a condition of your use of the club services, you agree not to use club facilities or interfaces for any purpose that is unlawful or prohibited by the terms, conditions, and notices included in this Membership Agreement or any relevant Licence Agreement, or anything generally regarded as uncouth by the slimes.
  2. The Spiral Knights Terms of Service supersedes these terms where applicable.
  3. The knight agrees to all terms and conditions enumerated here, and those not enumerated here. The slimes may add new conditions at any time that require complete retroactive compliance.
 VI. Termination of Account
  1. The Casino has the right to terminate your membership for violating any terms or conditions, precise or vague, enumerated herein or generated at the time of infraction. You've been warned.
 VII. Disclaimer of Warranty; Limitation of Liability
  1. Your use of the Casino is at your sole risk. You click it, you bought it.
  2. The Casino nor the general slime community shall not be liable in contract, tort, negligence or otherwise for any loss or damage whatsoever arising from or in any way connected with your use of the Casino.
 VIII. General
  1. This Membership Agreement is governed by the laws of Haven and the laws of Cradle. You hereby irrevocably consent to submit to the jurisdictions of the Courts of Cradle and Haven.
  2. This agreement was written by a few slimes with little grasp of legal language beyond what they saw when watching A Few Good Men. Thus, any parts that don't make sense are usually blamed on the other guy. Any good parts left over are still good. They don't go bad just because we screwed up on the other badder parts. There's a word for that concept and the fact that we don't know it is one of the bad parts.

item.properties|f.night_cap_pith: A comfortable cap for knights to wear at night. Sure to give the wearer a restorative night of sleep.
item.properties|f.plated_sentinel_helm: A helm reinforced with gremlin plating to defend against a range of dangerous elements.
item.properties|f.bechamel_room: A trendy room where Bechamel can add or remove Accessories from your favorite equipment.
mission.properties|f.p_tip: Prestige Badges are displayed next to your knight name.  They are automatically awarded when enough prestige is acquired.
item.properties|f.rageous_plate_mail: A legendary suit of armor said to imbue the wearer with the rage of the titans.
chat.properties|m.emote_self: You can't do that to yourself.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_3a: That's exactly right\! The Core of the Clockworks could very well contain the energy source we need to create a new power source for the Skylark and restore it to operational condition. There's only one problem- the Clockworks themselves seem to be built like some kind of crazy death trap. \n\nReaching the Core is not going to be easy...
item.properties|f.ice_queen_mail: A regal suit of armor resembling the ever-frigid Ice Queen.  In addition to providing great defense, it is said to dramatically boost one's ego and create a cold detachment from those around them.
support.properties|m.option_203_0:
You have to be 13 years or older to play this game. If someone admits in chat that they are under 13 then please click here to file the complaint against them.

Do NOT use this option if you simply believe the player to be underage, as there has to be proof in the last few minutes of chat. If there is no proof, then you should drop the complaint. 

Please use common sense, if they claim to be 4 years old while typing perfectly as an example then that's clearly not true and you should not file the complaint.
item.properties|f.casting_cone: A cap for comfortable casting. Conical, but no laughing matter.
item.properties|m.unlock_slime_prompt: A Slime Key (or Silver Key) is required to open this Lockbox. Lockboxes contain random prizes inside.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_bomb: Hello {0}, I'm Remi, a knight who specializes in bombs and explosives.  The recipes I have for you are pretty straightforward- producing weapons and gear that focus on blowing up your enemies to smithereens\! \n\nUsing bombs isn't a fire and forget kind of affair though.  Bombs require an understanding of timing, both before and after you drop one, in order to get the most bang for your buck.  The gear I specialize in will make you a knight that your squad sends in to take down many enemies at once.  Bombs are great for clearing out a mob of beasties in one swift KA-BOOM\!
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_3a: Congratulations {0}, you meet the necessary requirements and have received your 2 Star Certification.  Take the elevator behind me in order to complete your mission.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_6a: Here we have an alchemy station that you'll no doubt become very familiar with as you upgrade your arsenal.  But no need to worry about that too much as Spiral HQ is likely to give you a mission later on that explains everything. \n\nWell, that about does it for your first tour.  Do you want me to go over it all again or do you think you've got it?
support.properties|m.option_204_0: Names that are offensive are not acceptable. Be aware that what you consider offensive may not generally be considered offensive. So please only click here to file the complaint if you know for sure everyone would find that name offensive.
item.properties|f.kat_claw_mail: An impressive mail instilled with the might of Kat Clawers, the fearsome frontline fighters of the Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|b.high_temperature_ho:
Intel had reported a gremlin deconstruction crew dismantling a portion of the Clockworks in order to generate scrap resources for use in their Project R. Using powerful welding torches, they are truly burning the place to the ground. 

One of the squads investigating the site has gone missing and is believed to be now held in captivity at the site. 

Infiltrate the fiery deconstruction zone and rescue the captive knights.  But be warned, the deconstruction crew are said to have a powerful security construct hidden somewhere on site.
exchange.properties|m.coins_cancelled_po: You have been refunded {0} crowns for your cancelled energy offer.
item.properties|f.winterfest_tree: A spectacularly spiraling tree decorated in the spirit of Winterfest. Folklore states that Impostoclaus leaves presents for those that have been nice throughout the year while those that have been naughty find their presents filled with jelly. Some believe this is the only reason that chromalisks are hostile.
uplink.properties|m.end_survey_prompt: To help us improve the game, please rate your enjoyment of this session on a scale of 1 to 5.
pvp.properties|m.autotarget_off: Krogmo has turned off autotarget for this match only.
item.properties|f.spiraltail_mask: A simple simian mask made to celebrate the new year. Your sly shenanigans are sure to become a spectacle.
item.properties|f.rocky_core: A delicious gummy treat with an impenetrable rocky shell. More than a few teeth have been lost by knights attempting to get at the gooey interior.
social.properties|m.discord_join_req: A discord player is asking to join your party. Please check the discord client.
mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r6: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
board.properties|i.playsolo: Create a party in which other players can only join if you invite them.
dungeon.properties|m.jigsaw_valley_desc: Appearing to be sky islands ripped apart and put back together again as if it were a puzzle this world can sometimes be confusing to navigate. Unfortunately it seems to also be home to a host of mindless slimes and constructs who do not seem to mind its erratic layout.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roya: A scaled-down model of the Royal Jelly. He'd probably be flattered by it if he hadn't already been flattened.

mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_3a:
Re\: Re\: Resource allocation request, Amu-Sol 

Thank you for your prompt response.  Unfortunately your resource allocation has been denied. 

Reason\: 
Provided summary of need for requested resources\: 'All hail the great and terrifying Maulos, true lord of the Blinding Abyss.'
item.properties|f.gun_puppy_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a gun puppy.  It's so convincing, your friends just might give you the run around\!
mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r7:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
item.properties|f.pulsar: A high-tech Gremlin firearm originally designed for use by elite squads of Ironclaw soldiers. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
item.properties|f.frosted_helm: A delicious helm made of cake created during the Spiral Knights Anniversary Celebration. Since it's made of cake, it eventually falls apart.
guild.properties|m.warn_in_default: WARNING\: Your guild is in default\!
mission.properties|b.p_moorcroft1:
Someone or something has summoned a horde of cursed black kats into the Clockworks. These shadowy beasts hunger for arcane power and raided the Moorcroft Manor Archives' precious collection of magical grimoires. 

In the wrong hands these ancient tomes could be catastrophic, but it turns out that black kats can't read, so they instead decided to just eat them.

The residents of Moorcroft Manor would like you to retrieve the Ancient Pages of the magical grimoires that quite likely reside in the stomachs of black kats. We'll leave you to figure out just how to recover them... 

For this mission, journey into the depths of a moldering sewer where intel has located a black kat nest. Recover those Ancient Pages and return them to Moorcroft Manor\!

mission.properties|m.another_trace_4a: Good luck, {0}.  Be sure to thoroughly prepare before attempting this mission.
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch: Welcome to the Moorcroft Archives, traveler. Here you will find an illustrious collection of ancient grimoires from many forgotten worlds. It's quite the sight, I know\! \n\nYou're free to look around but please don't touch- some of these books are filled with incredible mystic power. You could hurt yourself\!
helptips.properties|m.tut_explosive: Explosive blocks will harm anything around them when they are set off. This includes you\! Take them out from a safe distance with your handgun.
item.properties|f.warmaster_helm_2: A remake of a mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus of the Crimson Order.  Though it very much resembles the original, it is still missing pieces.
mission.properties|m.silent_legion_recon:
I am drawn to this place. 

In the eyes of these silent warriors I see myself\: cold, strong, unflinching... and crumbling. I have been asked to let it go, to move on, but this I cannot do. 

Their faces, their dying cries... they haunted me in my dreams, so I no longer sleep.  Now I see them when I close my eyes, so I shall not blink. 

I will remain here, among the stones... never blinking, never forgetting.

mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r7: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.
uplink.properties|m.royal_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, we've detected another Recon Module of the Alpha Squad within this palace.  It is your mission to locate and retrieve the module. 

The Royal Jelly Palace is a strange place.  It appears to be some sort of castle that slimes have re-purposed as a residence for members of their oozing aristocracy.  Known as a 'Royal Jelly,' these noble slimes are said to rule over their countless loyal subjects with an iron fist-shaped appendage. 

Our intel suggests that the module is located somewhere near an enormous concentration of slimes, so it is reasonable to believe that it may be the 'throne room' of a Royal Jelly.  If so, be prepared for a fearsome fight- Royal Jellies are quick to anger and love to throw their enormous weight around.  Your best bet is to find a way to suppress their natural regenerative abilities. 

Good luck\!

mission.properties|b.chilled_to_bone:
By now you have no doubt run into strange, undead monsters known as 'spookats.'  Recon Knights have finally discovered what seems to be the source of these ghostly cat-like creatures. 

Large concentrations of spookats have been sighted in what is believed to be the darkened remains of an owlite castle.  Dubbed the 'Candlestick Keep' this shadowy realm is only illuminated by a series of owlite candles.    

Proceed with caution while exploring outside the light of the candles.  Lurking in the dark are enormous spookats known as 'grimalkins.'  Grimalkins seem to withstand all weaponry and are to be avoided.  Your only defense is to stay in the light\! 

Spiral HQ has issued you this mission in order to collect more data on the origins of the spookats and the mystery behind the fall of the owlites.  Investigate the Candlestick Keep and report your findings\!

uplink.properties|m.wildwoods_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, we've detected a recon module left by the Alpha Squad somewhere within this forest.  It is your mission to locate and retrieve the module. 

This forest is home to packs of wild beasts that have proven deadly for squads in the past. Because of this, Tech Knights have placed Beast Bells throughout the area.  Striking them should stun any beasts caught within the sound wave they produce. 

Be advised that Recon Knights have reported the presence of a terrible beast the likes which we have not seen before stalking this forest.  Known as 'the Snarbolax,' it appears as a shadowy mass of fangs and claws and seems completely immune to our weaponry.  Should you encounter it, try and find a means of escape as fast as possible. 

Good luck\!

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has uncovered a gremlin bioweapons facility deep within the Clockworks. It is believed that this facility belongs to a member of the Crimson Order known only as 'Herex.' The Recon Rangers have been tasked with infiltrating the facility and uncovering the nature of Herex's bioweapons before they are put to use.

The residents of Moorcroft Manor would like you to retrieve the Ancient Pages of the magical grimoires that quite likely reside in the stomachs of black kats. We'll leave you to figure out just how to recover them...

item.properties|f.callahan: A handgun of incredible power that can leave its target in a daze. It is said to make its targets feel far less lucky.  A charged shot can even pierce through multiple enemies.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Having faced the jaws of the most ferocious wolvers, avoided the spikes of fully evolved jelly cubes and even the vile regurgitations of virulisks, you have no doubt collected samples from these encounters that would be of great use to Spiral HQ's research teams.
mission.properties|r.pioneers_11a: I'll do my best to recover the recon module and destroy the Snarbolax\!
conversation.properties|r.sprite_tut_2c: Where can I purchase more harnesses?
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: I'll sneak out after it's safe.  Thank you for rescuing me\!
mission.properties|b.p_r6_weap_3: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_baa4bd: Become a premiere elite select platinum plus priority member in the Golden Slime Casino C.U.B.E. Club.
item.properties|f.vial_freeze: A glass vial containing glacial wind. It can be used to inflict enemies with Freeze.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and chill your foes right in place\!
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: I am here to listen. Let it all out.
item.properties|f.prize_box_gourmet: Contains various unique costumes and weapons used by battle chefs. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
social.properties|m.trader_busy: Oops\! That player is otherwise occupied.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: A dash of Moonstone, a pinch of... H... How did you... Who are you\!? You're not supposed to be here\!
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_keyboard_m: Keyboard used for targeting, attacking, movement, advanced commands,
item.properties|f.padded_armor: A loose-fitting set of light armor that is typically worn by gunslingers.
item.properties|f.elemental_cloak: A fine robe with numerous forms of elemental protection woven right into the fabric.
chat.properties|m.usage_grant_gift: Usage\: /{0} <account name> name attr value attr value...\nGrants a gift to the identified account.
item.properties|f.miracle_hood: A miraculous mask said to grant a single miracle to the wearer when they need it most.  In practice, it'll likely save your skin more often than that.
helptips.properties|m.final_test: You've made it this far knight - but your final exam will require quick thinking and even faster feet.
item.properties|f.slumber_smogger: An alchemical bomb that fogs an area with a sleep agent.
item.properties|f.plated_shade_helm: A helm of fiendish fabric interlaced with dark matter to conceal its wearer while they creep in camoflauged corners.
item.properties|f.metal_sonic_suit: A meticulously engineered suit of armor that is said to be equipped with a an ultra-powerful V. Max Overdrive Unit.
item.properties|f.padded_cap: A one size fits all light helm that is typically worn by gunslingers.
item.properties|f.fused_demo_helm: An upgraded Demo Helm fused dangerously with the unstable core from a powerful Blast Cube. It produces an unpleasant hum in your ears.
mission.properties|b.dreams_and_nightmar: Respond to the distress signal from the Core Terminal. We have no intel on what to expect. \nThis is a dangerous mission. Prepare for anything.
item.properties|f.firebreak_helm: An Emberbreak Helm modified to provide further protection against fire.
projectx.properties|i.vsync:
Synchronizes the game display with the monitor's
output to help prevent screen tearing,
but may affect framerate with less 
powerful systems.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_gate_fiend: Free the captured Knights from a fiendish corporate prison\!
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_3: Hi there, {0}\! As Head Chef of the Skylark I've been assigned to oversee the nutritional development of our new sprite companions. They seem to have really diversified themselves down there in the Clockworks. It will be interesting to see how they develop. \n\nDo you have any questions about feeding and caring for your sprite?
item.properties|f.blizzbrand: A high-tech blade that fuses Spiral and Clockwork technology. It can produce a concentrated low-temperature explosion that is harmless to knights.
item.properties|f.silverweave: A length of understated cloth intricately interwoven with precious metal. It's tastefully ostentatious, yet prudently protective.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_bc04ed: Earn clearance to explore Tier 2 of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.defender: A durable, high quality shield of the Spiral Order that is suitable for any adventure.
conversation.properties|m.energy_info_2a: Awesome\! I'll break it down for you in three easy lessons\: what it is, how it's used, and how you can get more.
item.properties|f.spiral_plate_mail: Heavyweight armor made of iron plates that can withstand a great deal of standard attacks.
item.properties|f.vial_fire: A glass vial containing a molten mixture. It can be used to inflict enemies with Fire.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and turn 'em into toast\!
item.properties|f.blackhawk: A shadow-aligned handgun of incredible power, it's said to contain the soul of a knight who was only two days from retirement.
item.properties|f.lite_shield: A lightweight knight light that offers holistic protection.
helptips.properties|m.tut_treasure: Treasure blocks are always a lucky find\! They contain coins and useful items.
item.properties|f.storm_avenger_helm: A helm worn by heavenly guardians who watch over a kingdom hidden atop a snow-covered mountain.
item.properties|f.supply_deluxe_compact: A package of useful supplies valued by Spiral Knight research teams working deep within the Clockworks.  This deluxe pack has enough supplies to last an entire squad of Knights one week.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
item.properties|f.veteran_door: Installs a force barrier at the entrance of the room that can only be passed by guild members of Veteran rank and up.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_9a: Handy, I'll keep it in mind.  What else you got?
item.properties|f.scary_skelly_suit: An upgraded Skelly Suit infused with the elemental essence of fear. It comes standard with matching pants that cannot be scared off.
conversation.properties|r.tut_intro4_1a: I'll scout ahead then\! Be careful, Rhendon.
item.properties|f.ult_evo_catalyst: A contained charge of highly unstable energy that can be synthesized by battle sprites. In doing so, sprites can evolve into their ultimate forms and harness the power of their ultimate skills.
item.properties|f.gel_drop: A drop of goo collected from a jelly. It's still quivering.
mission.properties|r.go_shopping_6a: I'd like you to give me the tour once more.
mission.properties|b.operation_crimson_h:
Warmaster Seerus is the evil master of munitions within the gremlin's all-powerful Crimson Order  Thought to be the true mastermind behind the Roarmulus Twins and countless other gremlin weapons, he is the Crimson Order's creator and supplier for their diabolical engines of war. 

Recon Knights under the command of Lieutenant Feron recently discovered Seerus's 'Grand Arsenal,' his development center and storage facility for all his weaponry.  Now, Feron himself is leading several squads of knights directly into the Grand Arsenal, with the intention of weeding out Seerus and destroying his war machines. 

Met with heavy resistance, Feron's squads require reinforcements and Spiral HQ is sending you in to assist.
item.properties|f.virulent_catalyzer: The incorporation of Spiral technology has given this harrowing handgun a powerfully poisonous payload. Catalyzer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
mission.properties|r.creators_and_create: Let's talk about the hostile ones I'm likely to meet.
item.properties|f.grand_tortoise: A shield empowered by the limitless fury of a tortodrone. The very plates of this colossal carapace shake as the unstable energy within waits to be unleashed.
conversation.properties|m.mission_surviv: B-beware...it stalks us...it watches our every move\!
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_snar: A long, razor-sharp tooth, proof that you encountered the fabled Snarbolax and survived to galumph back.
guild.properties|i.buy_themes: Change the theme for the Guild Hall.
sprites.properties|d.dark_harness_eli: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal shadow damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 10% \nCan be used by\: Drakon, Maskeraith
item.properties|f.torto_skull: A cavernous, musty helm made from the remains of a Tortodrone- a reminder that sometimes it pays to not stick your neck out.
mission.properties|b.alone_in_dark: The spookats of Moorcroft Manor have another valuable piece of intel for us that is worth investigating.  They say that a lost soul of the former Kingdom of Almire resides in a soldier's graveyard near the Firestorm Citadel.  This soul is willing to provide us with the information on the nature of the citadel as well as how we can get through it and reach the Core. \n\nReaching him will not be easy given his location.  Graveyards are terrible places, especially at this depth.  It is highly advisable that you move through the graveyard as quickly as possible in your search for this lost soul.
conversation.properties|m.core_tech_1: Welcome to the Core on-site research camp.  Got any news from the surface?
projectx.properties|m.reboot_warning_pen: The server will be rebooted in under {0} minutes. {1}
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_5: It will take a little time to get all of our equipment fully working again.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_6a: Bombs are special in that they have no standard attack.  A bomb can ONLY be used as a CHARGE ATTACK, so make sure to evade monsters while charging\! \n\nFeel free to give it a try.  Just remember to equip it at that arsenal station up ahead.
item.properties|f.guild_storage: Permanently adds Member Storage, Veteran Storage and Officer Storage options to Guild Command Console. Storages allow guild members of sufficient rank to exchange unbound items with other guild members.
mission.properties|r.first_contact_b_2a: (Tell Kora about the Ancient Generator, Razwog and the mysterious Artifact.)
item.properties|f.splinter_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in a synthetic mineral. Prone to shattering, the otherwise useless material in this bomb is perfect for giving foes a nasty splinter.
dungeon.properties|m.leaveparty_return: Leave the party and return to {0}.
mission.properties|r.new_chapter_3a: Thanks Kora, I'll do my best\!
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_6a: Indeed.  Let's start by putting out some fires and then we'll see about trying to get to the citadel.  Given the opposition, it's a one in a million shot. \n\nGood luck, {0}.
item.properties|f.frenzy_warrior_helm: A helm worn by a fabled sword master so fast, his frenzy alone could fell armies before they rose against him.
item.properties|f.fiend_portal_key: Using this will allow you to open and pass through the Grim Gate in the Ancient Grove.
mission.properties|b.axes_of_evil: A gremlin logging operation has been discovered in levels known as the 'Jigsaw Valley.'  These strangely carved islands are home to an even stranger species of twisting trees that gremlins seem to be determined to completely wipe out. \n\nSpiral HQ believes that gremlins are using the lumber from this operation as resources for the development of Project R and needs you to enter the Jigsaw Valley and shut it down.
conversation.properties|m.mission_collec: They burst out of the ground all around us...
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: I don't know if I feel better or worse after finding out what happened to everyone in the Core. Poor Grantz...Parma...Euclid...Rulen...
item.properties|f.prize_box_companion: Contains various items for your sprite and a chance for rarities. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|r.energy_info_2d: Your lessons have energized me\! I'm off to adventure, bye\!
item.properties|f.ancient_shell: A fragment of resilient Tortodrone shell. It is rumored that by sleeping on a Tortodrone shell, one can feel the subtle vibrations that call these mighty beings towards the Long Migration's mysterious final destination.
conversation.properties|m.core_resting_2: Can't wait to get back to Haven...
item.properties|f.token_vanaduke: A seal from the lost kingdom of Almire, proof that the keeper braved the ever-burning abyss known as the Firestorm Citadel.
chat.properties|m.complain_self: You can't file a complaint about yourself.
chat.properties|m.usage_set_rank: Usage\: /{0} rank subrank\nSet your rank and subrank.
projectx.properties|m.enqueued: Please be patient; we are currently experiencing high server load.
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r4: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
item.properties|f.prize_box_equinox: Contains various unique costumes and accessories celebrating Cradle's equinox\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.prize_box_running_wild: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a canine style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
guild.properties|log.upkeep_default: Upkeep not paid\! Guild Hall is in default.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_vana: A magnificently preserved royal seal of the lost kingdom of Almire. It probably belongs in a museum.
mission.properties|b.rescues_and_recycli: A 'Deconstruction Zone' is a gremlin work site where gremlins seem to tear apart existing levels and use the components to build new levels. Their ability to rapidly engineer levels and machines is incredible, surpassed only by their hostility to anyone who crosses their path. \n\nRecon Knights have discovered that a squad may have observed their engineering marvels a little too closely as they are now being held captive in one of the deconstruction sites near depth 10.  It is unclear what the gremlins have in store for these knights or if they simply plan on letting them perish along with the rest of the level they are dismantling.
item.properties|f.indestructible_giftwra: Presents wrapped with this Grinchlin gag can never be opened again. Leave it to Grinchlins to ruin complimentary gift wrapping services for everyone.
item.properties|f.forbidden_fruit: A sinful snack favored by famished fiends.
dungeon.properties|m.confirm_boot: Are you sure you want to remove {0} from the party?
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_2a: Once I make it to Haven I really can't come back?
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_housepla: A sunny saffron plant inside a cheerful pot.
mission.properties|b.time_to_crafty: Bosco would like you to alchemize a Hot Edge and Frost Gun for him to inspect. If it's good, he'll inform Spiral HQ that you've grasped the vital art of alchemy and even add a couple powerful Unique Variants to your new weapons.  What a generous guy\!
item.properties|f.raging_crusader_helm: A helm worn by mythical soldiers who are said to ride their rage into battle.
mission.properties|b.work_idle_hands:
Devilites are a type of fiend that seem to have a very rigid corporate structure that governs their every action.  Recon Knights have discovered a series of devilite 'offices' throughout the Clockworks, typically found in the remains of an alien city. 

Analysis of the data collected from these offices indicates that devilite corporations are outsourced by gremlins in order to design and manage various projects that include weapons specifically engineered to target Spiral Knight squads. 

It's time these devilites were issued pink slips and their fiendish projects cancelled.
item.properties|m.item_lockable: This item will bind to you when equipped.\n
item.properties|f.red_saber: A saber the color of the burning sun that is given to knights who have shown exemplary bravery in past actions.
helptips.properties|m.converse: Use the arrow keys and spacebar to navigate the conversation.
item.properties|f.turbillion: An ostentatious mechanized blade whose turbine crackles with the power of a thousand storms.
conversation.properties|m.casino_imposto: Oh, haven't seen you around here before\!
item.properties|f.mandolin: A spike-shredding, high-capacity, overclocked double disk launcher.  Experimental spike energy seems drawn to orbit itself... and drawn back toward the launcher with extra potency\!
helptips.properties|m.battle_arena: Each stage of a battle arena is more challenging than the last, but a victory always earns you a chance to cut your losses and move on.  The only rule is, everyone must fight at least once\!
mission.properties|b.first_contact: You have escaped your crash pod and reached a Rescue Camp just as the sun set across the alien landscape.  Using your comlink, it is now time to establish contact with Spiral HQ.
guild.properties|i.guild_log: Examine recorded events within the guild.
item.properties|f.style_kit: {0}  This item will be destroyed, but you will be able to re-apply this modifier to your knight using the style kit.
mission.properties|o.p_heart_of_ice_r7: Discover the source of the terrible blizzards emanating from Amu-Sol
chat.properties|m.usage_tell: Usage\: /{0} player name message\nSends a message to the specified player.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_undead: The ruins of Owlite castles are dark and cursed places that are swarming with legions of undead spookats.  The worst of these, the seemingly invincible grimalkins, constantly lurk in the shadows, awaiting the moment your life-saving light is finally snuffed out. \n\nSome knights succumb to the darkness and become paralyzed with fear in these shadowy realms. The only thing that can save them are brave knights who have long lost their childhood fears of the dark and all the terrible creatures that lurk within.
item.properties|m.forge_locked: The Forge can only be used in town or at Arsenal Stations.
pvp.properties|m.love_reupload_layer: Uploading a new file for the selected level. Other layers may be updated\!
item.properties|f.obsidian_hood_of_sight: 'Through my eyes you will see the path to ages. Pure is my gaze, free from the lies of reality.'
mission.properties|o.strength_unity: Defend the Geo Knights from a monstrous assault
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_construct: Destroy the operational war machines within the ruined factory\!
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_2b: What sort of challenges await me in the final gate?
mission.properties|r.another_trace_3a: You can count on me, Kora.
item.properties|f.umbra_driver: This horrifyingly powerful handgun fires bullets that are completely devoid of color, odor and mercy.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_3: You will find ore deposits in all levels of the Clockworks, and you must attack them in order to break them down into a size you can carry. You can only pick up one at a time, but you can swap them by picking up another. Look for the biggest, shiniest one you can find. They are the most valuable.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: Greetings, {0}\! Now that I've had sufficient time to research the battle sprites you rescued I can give you a proper evaluation of each. \n\nDespite their well, strange appearance, we have concluded that these 'new' battle sprites are not only suitable for combat but may have even further enhanced capabilities as a result of their transformation.
uplink.properties|m.detached_accessory: Spiral Knights had a change and the attached accessory was removed from your {0}.\n\nApologies.
conversation.properties|m.rc_end_3c: Once you reach Haven I would advise you explore the town and familiarize yourself with all the sights and services the town has to offer. You will gain access to more powerful gear than we offer here as well and be surrounded with many more experienced knights. Be sure to ask them for assistance if you get lost.
mission.properties|m.once_only: This mission can only be played once per day.
exchange.properties|m.billing_steam_erro: Steam Error\: User account is unable to make purchases at this time.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_kit: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
item.properties|f.tundrus: A modified magnus that ensures that if somehow your target survived the first shot, they will still be frozen in their tracks. A charged shot can even plow through multiple enemies.
item.properties|f.grand_tortofist: A handgun empowered by the limitless fury of a tortodrone. While wielding it you can feel the berserk energy within eager to be unleashed.
item.properties|f.furni_counter_spiral: A modular piece of counter that can be combined in infinite ways. Always be careful when working with infinity.
helptips.properties|m.tut_weapons: You can cycle between equipped weapons with [[NEXT_WEAPON]]. Try equipping your handgun.
mission.properties|o.p_fiend_test_t1: Help us test this new content.
global.properties|m.idled_out: You have been disconnected due to idleness.
item.properties|f.furni_library_lectern_: A podium perfect for pondering over many a quaint and curious volume of forgotten lore.
item.properties|f.ticket_unbind_2: Use this ticket at the Unbinding Forge to unbind a 2 star item.
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_raiment: A reclaimed raiment said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Torair, who clung to the gates of the Owlite High Academy of Magicks as both it and his explosives burned.
item.properties|f.confetti_bubbles: Use this item to blow a cloud of bubbles into the air. See how long they last before they pop\!
item.properties|f.mining_hat: A sturdy, old helmet once used to dig for precious minerals. It offers a little more defense than a Spiral Helm.
sprites.properties|d.iron_heart_attack: Targets destroyed while enchanted may also drop defense orbs.
mission.properties|m.legion_almire_3a: Now only death and smoke hang in the air, even from these great heights. And the fires; the unnatural fires that seem to burn eternal, the fires that turn even the most pious men into horrible nightmares, I know that these fires shall soon take me as well. \n\nI will not give my former Lord the gift of my own life.  It is not his to take, to twist. This shall be my final order.  This shall be my Justice.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_2a: It should, there're plenty of new recruits that chatter about them constantly. They're like heroes to some knights. \n\nThe Alpha Squad was an elite squad of knights that Ozlo personally selected to first enter the Clockworks in an effort to locate the source of the massive energy signal below.  Because all systems on the Skylark were offline for several weeks, radio communication was not possible.  Instead, they left a series of recon modules throughout their travels, sort of like a breadcrumb trail.
item.properties|f.gh_env_snowing: A beautiful environment that fills your Guild Hall with perfect snow\: the kind that gently falls from the sky and never collects on the ground, melting into gray muck.
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_3: Attack a mineral column in order to break it down into a size you can carry. You can only pick up one at a time, but you can swap them by picking up another. Look for the biggest, shiniest one you can find. They are the most valuable.
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_5a: I'd like to go over your energy tutorial one more time.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeknigh: Readings in Haven look good so far...
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Biotech Hahn is attempting to further his research of slime and beast family monsters and is requesting samples from your recent missions.  He has specifically requested that you be reminded of his 'very informative lecture' that was given to you 'free of charge' when making your decision as to whether or not to comply.
helptips.properties|m.design:
Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to place.
Press DEFEND [[DEFEND]] to put away.
Press PREV_WEAPON [[PREV_WEAPON]] to rotate clockwise.
Press NEXT_WEAPON [[NEXT_WEAPON]] to rotate counter-clockwise.
mission.properties|r.pierce_of_cake_4a: You talked pretty fast, can you go over it-
exchange.properties|m.opening_paypal: Opening PayPal checkout in your browser...
mission.properties|b.pioneers: After the crash of the Skylark, Captain Ozlo selected an elite squad of Spiral Knights to be the first to enter the Clockworks.  They were never seen again.  Contact Intel Agent Kora and learn how you will play a role in solving this mystery.
item.properties|f.nova_driver: It'll take more than a wish to save you if you're the unfortunate target of this all-powerful pistol with the strength of the stars themselves.
item.properties|f.punkin_sprout: A small sprig capable of growing into a grand gourd.
pvp.properties|m.prize: You were awarded the weekly prize for {0}\!
mission.properties|m.target_acquired_1a: Hello {0}, I hope you're ready for me to send you out into the lion's den once more.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_gamepad_1: Gamepad used for targeting, attacking, movement, advanced commands and quickslots
social.properties|m.confirm_go_solo: Are you sure you want to continue on alone?
item.properties|f.token_snarbolax: A long, razor-sharp tooth plucked from the mouth of a Snarbolax; a memento representing a Knight's triumph over the monstrous stalker of the Gloaming Wildwoods.
item.properties|f.moonstone_deposit_4: A mother lode of metalliferous minerals that will generate a jackpot of moonstone.
chat.properties|m.unspecific_command: Command not specific enough, did you mean "{0}?"
item.properties|f.mechaknight_suit: A slim suit of armor designed to disguise a knight as they delve into the depths of Cradle.
mission.properties|m.occurance_at_owlite: (The remaining pages are too deteriorated to decipher anything further save for a date of the events described which suggest that the Kingdom of Almire was destroyed over a thousand years ago.)
exchange.properties|m.trade4energy_toolt: The best current market price. A response of ??? indicates that there is no current market offer for the amount you've entered.
item.properties|f.gorgofist: A terrifying handgun that combines the dual-crushing power of a gorgo and the mythical tortomega. Suppressing enemies has never been more fiendishly fun.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest2_r9: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
mission.properties|o.p_tortodrone_r7: Investigate the Ancient Grove and put a stop to a Fiendish plot.
item.properties|f.mighty_defender: An advanced Spiral Knight shield, reinforced for battle and beautifully embossed for the stories afterward.
mission.properties|b.creators_and_create: In order to be fully prepared for the challenges ahead, Chief Biotech Hahn is requesting you contact him before undertaking the new missions that you have available to you.
auction.properties|e.auction_bid: The auction may not be cancelled, it already has a bid.
item.properties|f.ronin_gasa: A lost straw cap once belonging to a lordless swordmaster.
helptips.properties|m.atg_healthcap: Use HEALTH CAPSULES from your quickslot bar to heal.
dungeon.properties|m.golden_slime_prize_: C.U.B.E. Club Members may spin up to 50 times at once.\nRequires Golden Slime Coins.
item.properties|f.draped_armor: A stylish suit of armor that adds a touch of class to battle.
item.properties|f.crimsonite_deposit_4: A mother lode of metalliferous minerals that will generate a jackpot of crimsonite.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_9a: Hi {0}\!  Look at you, wow\!  Hey, Vanguard or not you know where to go if you want to really stand out right?
helptips.properties|m.confirm_energy: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to confirm spending energy.
conversation.properties|m.npc_minerknigh: Spiral HQ wants us to haul these minerals back up to Haven.
helptips.properties|m.shop: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to browse vendor goods.
mission.properties|b.explosive_plot: Recon Knights have discovered what they believe to be a gremlin-hatched plot to destroy Haven\!  As a Knight Elite, you have been selected by Spiral HQ to investigate this matter.  Contact Intel Agent Kora for details.
conversation.properties|m.tut_warden_1a: Hail, knight. You must be {0}, Rhendon radioed us and said you were on your way. Come with us, the Rescue Camp is just ahead.
item.properties|f.stagger_storm: Though it was originally developed by the Spiral Order to harmlessly subdue dangerous species, how you deal with foes unfortunate enough to be caught in the storm is entirely up to you.
support.properties|m.subheader_step2_gif: We have saved the offending gift box message already waiting to be added to the complaint, so there is no need to hurry from here. Please carefully choose the correct option matching what the player did\:
mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_4: Mount Grinchlin is an oppressive environment and few knights likely have the fortitude to reach its summit. If you feel things getting too rough, take the exit\! Otherwise you risk losing everything\!
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_tall_ora: A tall, elegant street lamp that emits an orange glow with a gentle hiss.
chat.properties|m.player_between_scenes: That player is moving between scenes.
conversation.properties|m.mission_collec: It looks artificial, but it seems to have a sinister awareness...

item.properties|f.airbraker_shield: A lightweight, compact, and pneumatically-activated shield that expands its surface area against enemy attacks.

conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_8: This gremlin comes from the colony of Emberlight, deep within the Clockworks. They're a group of outcasts that have defied King Tinkinzar and the Crimson Order. We're hoping we can make a treaty with them that will allow us to use their colony as a base of operations for our missions deeper underground.
item.properties|f.volcanic_plated_sentin: A helm reinforced with volcanic plating to defend against a range of elements.
item.properties|f.eternal_orb: A rare, encapsulated element used in alchemical transmutation. This orb is prized by the most powerful knights and is used to craft items of extraordinary power.
mission.properties|m.prestigious_opportu: Greetings {0}, and congratulations on becoming a Squire\!  Your performance has caught the attention of Spiral HQ and they have given you authorization to now take on Prestige Missions. \n\nPrestige Missions are select missions offered to you daily that offer prestige as rewards for completion.  Sometimes these missions require supplying Spiral HQ or other Knights with items and other times they will have you exploring the Clockworks.
mission.properties|b.spark_roar:
An exceptionally high concentration of constructs has been found guarding an area of the Clockworks that Spiral HQ suspects could be a Crimson Order hideout. Unlike other monsters, constructs don't seem capable of reproducing on their own, meaning that any time one is deconstructed, it's a permanent dent in their numbers. It will be a worthwhile task regardless of Crimson Order influence or not. 

Spiral HQ is requesting that you enter these levels, investigate the possible hideout, and eliminate the construct threat. 

It is highly recommended that you equip yourself with elemental resistant gear with elemental and shadow damage weapons\!
guild.properties|i.charter: View important information about this guild.
mission.properties|b.vile_engine:
Somewhere below a level that lichens have taken to inhabiting lies a strange facility of unknown origin that seems to be used for the production of toxic slime monsters. The 'slime generators' are capable of rapidly producing slime monsters that then quickly populate nearby levels. 

Squads in neighboring levels have already reported overwhelming numbers of toxic slimes, making it impossible to lead expeditions beyond depth 23.  It is time a knight of your caliber form a squad to infiltrate this strange facility and shut down production of these vile creatures. 

Any data that you could collect as to their origin would be highly valuable to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.drakon_pod: A sprite pod containing a level 1 Drakon Battle Sprite. \n\nThe Drakon is a battle sprite that embodies fiery destruction. Its skills focus on raw, offensive power.
item.properties|f.volt_breaker_armor: Upgraded Circuit Breaker Armor further hacked to resist shock.
item.properties|f.book_of_dark_rituals: An ancient grimoire filled with unspeakable eldritch rites. Just like any cursed tome, there is likely some twisted individual out there who wants it for extremely nefarious purposes. Trade with caution.
mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_5a: Along the north wall here we have all sorts of blocks, switches, doors, and buttons from the Clockworks. If you want to overcome the devious and deadly mechanisms down there I suggest you become familiar with how these work\!
mission.properties|b.p_r4_weap_1: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
conversation.properties|m.emberlight_vis: Emberlight founded by gremlin outcasts from Great Colony. Gremlins of Emberlight not obey the Iron Law, so flee or die. We start over with Emberlight. New colony home to few of us\: most ex-schemers, some merchants, some fighters, all traitors in eyes of Great Colony gremlins.

The guy was selfless.  I imagine that if disaster truly befell the Alpha Squad, Grantz didn't let it end without one hell of a fight.

Finding the source might help us understand what that gremlin schemer Razwog planned on doing with the Artifact or what the device is actually capable of.

item.properties|f.vog_cub_coat: This hide garment is so flame retardant that you won't even mind that it reeks of wood smoke.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_vana: An artistic arrangement of Lord Vanaduke's mask, armor and scepter. It represents the folly of greed, the agony of despair, and how awesome fire and spikes look together.
item.properties|f.cloak: An extraordinary cloak favored by the students of the arcane.
