mission.properties|m.legion_almire_1a:
Nothing like a death-defying romp through a haunted necropolis to really get the blood pumping, eh Rangers? 

The necropolis originates from Almire, fallen kingdom of some crazy lord something-something, population\: innumerable legions of Undead.  Apparently these less-than-living residents are guarding something that Spiral HQ would like to acquire. 

Our job is to recover a special book, a piece of a much larger collection of works that may give us more insight into the nature of this cursed kingdom.  So grab your helmets, and your best zombie-basher- I'm not expecting a warm reception. 

Let's ride, Rangers\!
item.properties|f.royal_jelly_crown: Ruggedly royal regalia recently reproduced from regally resinous remains.
item.properties|f.vial_sleep: A glass vial containing a drowsy draught. It can be used to inflict enemies with Sleep.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and your foes will be snoring in seconds\!
item.properties|f.crescent_helm: A sturdy helm that resembles a crescent moon when the visor is lifted.
mission.properties|m.alone_in_dark_2a: Lord Vanaduke rules over the citadel now.  His soul bound to some horrific armored prison. \n\nHe has the citadel ready for battle at all times, believing that his kingdom is still under siege.  He doesn't even realize that what he is trying to protect was lost a thousand years ago.
item.properties|f.static_diskgun: A shockingly powerful handgun that creates a storm of electrified disks. Diskgun shots return once reaching their apogee.
item.properties|f.down_puffer: A puffy, downy jacket. Superior insulation is provided by snipe down feathers. (No snipes were harmed making this jacket, feathers were gathered non-intrusively from free-roaming snipes.)
projectx.properties|m.deposit_minerals: Gather minerals and deposit them in any gate in the Arcade.
mission.properties|b.mission_sprite_1: Rhendon is waiting for you in an area of the Clockworks known as the Sunset Steppes where reconnaissance has located a cache of missing battle sprites.  Secure the sprites and clear the area of hostiles.  You are authorized to utilize any sprites you secure in order to complete the mission.
projectx.properties|m.bug_message: Please enter a brief description of the bug.  \nPlease note that bug reports are not answered by GMs.  \nIf you also need assistance from a GM, please file an in-game support request.
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_2a: Very well {0}, let's get right to it.  It seems the closer monsters get to the Core, the more their unique properties begin to surface.  In most cases this takes the form of their being able to inflict special damage types that require special defenses in order to withstand properly. \n\nIn Tier 2, a monster inflicting a special damage type will always produce a split normal/special damage output.  Thus, normal defense is still a somewhat valid defense choice.
helptips.properties|m.loading13: If you are the party leader, you can remove any player from your party. Click the status icon of the player you wish to remove and select "Remove from Party."
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_5: A sprite's appetite will increase naturally over time, though slowly. To increase appetite quickly, take it for a run in the Clockworks. Absorbing heat from monsters is a great way to burn calories\!
helptips.properties|m.activate_grim_gate: The Grim Gate will activate when all living party members are standing on it.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_2: Indeed\! A battle sprite can synthesize matter into useable energy. This machine can take certain materials and alchemize them into extra special sprite food... that is, when it's finally calibrated.
mission.properties|m.elig_ok: You are eligible for this mission.
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_3a: Amazing that after all this time we didn't know the truth. I mean, we've suspected for a while now that this planet was some kind of prison but who could have guessed that this 'Swarm' was just waiting for someone to stumble across the Core and free it?
social.properties|m.knight_progress: You cannot join until the party reaches depth {1}.
support.properties|m.transfer_item: Transfered item "{0}" from knightId\:{1} to knightId\:{2}. (count \= {3})
guild.properties|log.door_placed: Placed a {0} for {1} crowns, replacing a {2}.
helptips.properties|m.pressure_pads: These special buttons will only trigger if something is holding them down. Try using that statue to hold one down.
mission.properties|m.another_trace_1a: Hello {0}, I'm happy to report that my equipment is back up and running\! Now I have some good news and bad news for you.  The good news is\: I've been able to track down the source of that energy signature. Here is the bad news\: the energy source has been pinpointed to a highly dangerous area of the Clockworks that Recon Knights have dubbed the 'Royal Jelly Palace.'
item.properties|f.toxic_core: A solid, pulsating lump that oozes with vitriol.
item.properties|f.primal_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. The plates used in its construction provide some protection against the elements of fire and freeze.
item.properties|f.super_slime_slasher: A shovel with a wicked edge that's especially well-suited to fighting slimes in the trenches.
mission.properties|b.occurance_at_owlite:
An unlikely source of intel has surfaced from the residents of Moorcroft Manor.  A few of the spookats that call it home contacted one of our visiting Recon Knights and provided details of the negative energy mass that has appeared above the Core. 

Calling it 'a place of burning hatred' and 'a prison for dark souls' they say that you can read all about it in 'one of those weird Owlite books' in an Owlite keep they pinpointed. 

If what they claim is true Spiral HQ could gain valuable intel from investigating the Owlite keep.  Just remember that these Owlite structures have all proven to be swarming with the lost souls of countless undead monsters.  Prepare accordingly.
helptips.properties|m.bramble: Some areas are overgrown with bramble that will hurt you if you run through it\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_h: Stick with your squad - remember it's dangerous to go alone\!
mission.properties|m.breaking_in_recruit: This is no longer routine training\! Get those Recruits to the elevator. We're extracting them back to Haven. You on the other hand need to head down and see who's at the bottom of this.
mission.properties|b.p_fiend_test_t1: Please refer to the posted instructions when testing this content.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_construct: Destroy the operational war machines within the ruined factory\!
item.properties|f.storm_rider_mantle: A legendary suit of armor thought to be worn by a god who used lightning to carve whole worlds from stone.
item.properties|f.furni_beacon_floor_red: A Spiral-issued light source typically installed in dangerous areas.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Euclid volunteered to help The Sleeper. I'm sure he's in here somewhere battling The Swarm even as we speak. As for Rulen...Vaelyn I'm sorry. He disappeared shortly after Euclid made his decision. I haven't been able to find him ever since.
item.properties|f.spiral_pith_helm: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.spiral_culet: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
helptips.properties|m.tut_hearts: Break these blocks to receive hearts. Hearts restore your health. You cannot pick them up unless you need them.
item.properties|f.dark_thorn_blade: A savage sword whose strength has been fortified by an offering of souls to the beast within.
item.properties|f.pumpkin_bombhead_mask: A Bombhead Mask bearing a meancing grimace reminiscent of the great, gourdly Punkin King.
item.properties|f.volcanic_pepperbox: When encamped in dangerous territory, the Volcanic Pepperbox is perfect for roasting both marshmallows and enemies.
chat.properties|m.usage_broadcast: Usage\: /{0} message\nBroadcasts message to everyone online.
item.properties|f.deep_sea_cuirass: A suit of armor with iridescent scales that seem to move like shimmering waves. The armor is rather uncomfortable to wear as it is naturally cold and wet at all times.
item.properties|f.seraphynx_pod: A sprite pod containing a level 1 Seraphynx Battle Sprite. \n\nThe Seraphynx is a battle sprite that embodies divine light. Its skills focus on supporting knights in combat with protection and restoration.
item.properties|f.zee_core: A pungent mass pulled from a slimy assailant. Its aroma is an excellent remedy for insomnia, as well as nighttime sniffling and sneezing.
item.properties|f.peppermint_repeater: This holiday hand cannon is the proper piece to pepper your opponents with hot lead of holiday cheer.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Don't worry about Feron, he'll be healed up in no time.
mission.properties|m.a_call_to_arms1: This is Vaelyn at the Core Terminal. Team wiped out. Darkness everywhere. Send help. It is opening.
social.properties|m.earned_prestige: become the Most Prestigious, having earned {0} prestige in the past 7 days\!
mission.properties|m.pioneers_6a: It was for this reason that Ozlo selected him to take a small squad down into the unknown depths of the Clockworks.  After all, if you cut your teeth battling under Morai typhoon fire you could probably handle anything right? \n\nBut maybe the Clockworks proved too much for even his ability.  We just don't know.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
projectx.properties|d.achievement_3de017: Pay a visit to Emberlight, the town of gremlin outcasts.
item.properties|f.deadly_virulisk_suit: A fine suit made out of hide from the deadliest of Virulisks. Sadly, it doesn't appear to have retained any of the Virulisk's ability to camouflage.
conversation.properties|n.rfc_dungeon_1a: I have lingered in halls even after all these long centuries, denied my eternal rest by my cursed lord. I feel his spirit clinging onto this shattered realm even now. He refuses to leave and thus dooms us all.
item.properties|m.name: Name
item.properties|f.mug_misery: A cursed drinking utility that can only be used by a truly wicked soul. Those that possess it are said to bring grave misfortune to those around them.
item.properties|f.vial_curse_ultra: A glass vial containing concentrated fiend essence. It can be used to inflict enemies with Curse.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and give your foes 10 years of bad luck\!
mission.properties|b.p_apocrea_r7: Several capable knights have gone missing in a seemingly normal area of the Clockwork Tunnels. Spiral HQ suspects foul play and has assigned you to investigate the level.
item.properties|f.skelly_mask: A spooky mask good for both scaring children and protecting from shadow attacks.
chat.properties|m.usage_accessory: Usage\: /{0} (armor helmet) [clear | accessory name]\nAdds an accessory to the equipment or clears all accessories.
item.properties|f.budding_helm: This cracked biotech helm is home to a harmless decorative plant.
prologue.properties|m.preface1: The Morai Wars have brought us to the brink of extinction.
item.properties|f.icebreaker_shield: A Frostbreaker Shield modified for increased protection against freeze.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_mastery_2a: A good sword is, well, good and all, but how about a great sword? If you want weapons that will shake the heavens, then mastery level alchemy is what you need. \n\nOnce you craft an item into its 4 and 5 star incarnation, you unlock that item's true hidden potential.
item.properties|f.wild_buster: A handgun alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. While wielding it, you can feel the fierce energies within just waiting to be unleashed.
helptips.properties|m.atg_blocks: Hit a breakable block to destroy it\!
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_1a: There you are, {0}\!  I was beginning to think you wouldn't show up\! \n\nOk, let's get to work securing this place.  But first, you'll need to equip that Proto Bomb I gave you.  Head over to the Arsenal Station behind me and equip it.
item.properties|f.poison_barrier: Surrounds you with toxic orbs that can cripple hostiles
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_6a: On the east side we have a couple of combat practice rooms. These Training Cubes are mostly harmless and are perfect for experimenting with your weapons and shield techniques\!
item.properties|f.coin_bonus_upgrade_1: Once used, this upgrade will increase Coins earned in Coliseum games by 1 for 24 hours.  You may have up to 6 Krogmo Coin Boosters active at any time.
conversation.properties|r.hav_clock_3b: Thanks for the info tall guy, see you around town.
mission.properties|m.intro_arcade_locked: Complete Rank Missions to gain access to Arcade Missions\!
pvp.properties|m.love_delete_confirm: Are you sure? The level will be deleted.
item.properties|f.twicer_slicer: Slicer prototype Mk II.  They say a little bit of knowledge is a dangerous thing, so that's exactly how much knowledge we have about the mysterious spikes we're slicing up and launching out here.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_ora: A tall torch filled with otherworldly orange fire.
mission.properties|o.p_halloween_r3: Seek an audience with the Punkin King.
item.properties|f.surge_breaker_shield: A reliable shield that'll help keep you grounded in battle.
item.properties|f.shadow_key: A mysterious key that grants a party entrance to Shadow Lairs.  A Shadow Key is destroyed once used.
pvp.properties|m.blast_network-info: A bombastic game of explosive action where players attempt to blow away their competition\!  Blast Network provides all participants with the gear to play, so no preparation is required to get in on the action.
trade.properties|e.cart_removed.1: NOTE\: a {1} was removed from the cart.
support.properties|m.option_208_0: If a player is trying to get your account name or password from you right now, or already did and is admitting to this in chat, you should click here to file a complaint.
item.properties|f.cosmic_dust: A portion of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
item.properties|f.chaos_cloak: A forbidden mantle said to grant the wearer protection within the nameless realm where all elements are said to converge into one and divide into all.
item.properties|f.volcanic_plated_shade_: A helm of fire retardant fabric interlaced with dark matter to conceal its wearer while they hide in heated hallways.
helptips.properties|m.atg_statustraps: Beware\!  Some traps can cause damage AND inflict harmful status effects.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_elem: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
helptips.properties|m.atg_gblocks: Hitting a GHOST BLOCK can remove a whole field of blocks - including unbreakable blocks\!
mission.properties|m.alchemy_mastery_3a: At 4 and 5 star level, gear offers the best protection you can find and weapons pack the biggest punch.  If you want to stay alive where you're heading, you need to start building an arsenal of 4 and 5 star gear. \n\nAnd remember- as items reach 5 star they typically can branch even more than before.  Your combat options are about to really open up.  Plan your arsenal with care.
item.properties|f.twisted_spine_cone: An enhanced Spine Cone that will thrash opponents with thorns and bury them in brambles.
mission.properties|o.choose_your_sprite: Talk to Morlin and choose a battle sprite as your companion
item.properties|f.iron_gear: A metal gear that was once a component of a complicated contraption.
item.properties|f.vial_sleep_super: An ornate glass vial containing a drowsy draught. It can be used to inflict enemies with Sleep.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be snoring in seconds\!
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: The seraphynx is a battle sprite that embodies protection and restoration. Its skills focus on supporting knights in combat\: ray of light creates a steady beam of holy light, heart attack increases the chance of hearts dropping from monsters, and angelic aura creates a light shield that protects its knight and party members within. \n\nThe seraphynx is best suited for knights who wish to protect their party and provide them aid.
uplink.properties|m.items_expired: You have items that have expired. Items can be repurchased from the Supply Depot.
board.properties|m.gate_closed: Sorry, that gate is no longer open.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_min: Gather minerals for Chief Geo Knight Wegner's research.
social.properties|m.befriend_name: Enter the name of the knight whom you would like to befriend\:
item.properties|f.dusker_cap: A hide helm for knights that prefer to take their opponents on toe-to-toe.
exchange.properties|m.billing_steam_erro: Steam Error\: User is in a restricted country.
item.properties|f.firetail_mail: A scorching simian mail typically worn by commanders in combat. It will ward off many wounds made to the wearer.
monster.properties|m.vanaduke_defeated: We shall never fall\! We shall... never...
social.properties|m.trade_request: {0} would like to trade with you.
item.properties|f.solid_cobalt_armor: A sturdy set of Cobalt Armor reforged for additional comfort and protection.
item.properties|f.ship_wheel: How could this possibly make a good shield? Where did it even come from? Careful matey, ask those questions and you could be made to walk the plank.
item.properties|f.iron_wolf_hood: A helm once worn by a member of the 'Iron Wolves,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_4a: Looks like I need to get you up to speed.  We've crashed on a planet known as 'Cradle.'  Cradle is a fascinating world in that the entire interior of the planet below its surface is an ever-changing mechanical complex known as the 'Clockworks.' \n\nThe Clockworks seems to have been built by 'gremlins,' a furry race of malevolent monsters that have not taken kindly to our presence.
conversation.properties|r.rc_virgil_2a: Why is this walkway here then?
item.properties|f.silent_nightblade: Crafted with some of the most devilish materials found on Cradle, this inky blade can explode with fiendish fury.
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_1a: Greetings, {0}\!  I hear you've recently arrived in Haven from across the great chasm.  While you were out there, did you encounter any of our battle sprites?
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_battlesta: An elegant display commemorating a knight's promotion to the rank of Champion.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: By now you have likely collected some interesting materials in the first stratum of the Clockworks that would be useful to Spiral HQ.  Help advance their continued research of the mysteries of Cradle by donating materials.
projectx.properties|m.save_continue: In order to access this feature, you must create an account to use when logging into the game.
item.properties|f.sorcerer_robe: A fine robe known to be worn by powerful sorcerers, and this one guy Bob.
mission.properties|b.a_call_to_arms: A frantic emergency comlink message broadcasts across all channels.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_2a: You stand within the Hall of Heroes, where the best of the Spiral Knights offer what they can to aspiring knights.  Knights like you yourself once were when you first emerged from your drop pod and found your way to Haven. \n\nAnd after so many successful missions, daring rescues and exemplary performance in battle, you now stand fit to join these heroes.
item.properties|f.force_buckler: A Proto Shield modified to resist stunning impacts.
exchange.properties|i.mini_sell: Instantly sell energy for crowns at the energy exchange.
item.properties|f.raiders_axe: An ornate, fiery axe favored by raiders for its versatility.
item.properties|f.energy_well: After energy is added to the energy well, guild members may withdraw 100 units of energy daily.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_4a: Some items can be used to attack monsters, like these vials.  You can practice picking them up and throwing them in this target range here.
item.properties|f.confetti_winter: When thrown, this winter confetti gives you quite a chill.
item.properties|f.nefarious_hood: A hood said to be crafted by a nefarious imp. The floating rune is certain to cloak you during clandestine campaigns.
mission.properties|m.time_enough_at_last: I don't know about that... I'm fine here amongst all these ancient tomes.  I've got plenty to read, more than I ever could in a lifetime.  But I suppose that won't be a problem. \n\nPlease, just head on back to Haven.  Let my squad know that I'm ok and that I'm safe.
item.properties|f.voltaic_tempest: This high-tech, high voltage device is not recommended for use in water, around water, or near people thinking about water. To be safe, you probably shouldn't look at it, either.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_mat_234: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.dead_gold: A coin placed into the hands of the dead before burial, granting them fare for the long journey ahead.
projectx.properties|m.revisit_help: You can click on completed stages to revisit them.
item.properties|f.furni_chair_manor: An exquisite chair, cunningly crafted for cozy comfort.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_r6: Meet with Biscotti in her kitchen and provide 'baking assistance.'
logon.properties|m.machine_tainted: This computer has been used by a banned account and cannot be used to create new accounts.
item.properties|f.kat_eye_mask: An impressive mask instilled with the might of Kat Seekers, the skillful grenadiers of the Kat Tribe.
item.properties|f.slime_slasher: A sturdy shovel modified to dole out a little extra damage to slime family monsters.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro_1a: Welcome to Cradle, recruit\! Always happy to see a knight survive a drop in one piece. We have a Rescue Camp not far from your position.  I'll guide you there- but ready your sword, there are hostiles on the road ahead\!\n
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Amazing...I never thought I'd see another one of us ever again\! I'm glad to see you made it here safely.
item.properties|f.buccaneer_box: Contains one of various unique items and accessories for buccaneers. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.cooling_cell: A small device used in complex machines to keep them from overheating. Also handy to keep in your pockets on hot summer days.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_1: Well met {0}, it has been some time since I first met you having just arrived from the Rescue Camp.  You've come along way since then, rising to the rank of Defender Elite no less. \n\nYou are a gifted soldier, {0}.  I have no doubt you will soon be a Champion amongst the Spiral Knights and instrumental in our solving the great mystery that is the Core, restoring the Skylark and returning home.  You have proven that you have what it takes to face the legions of dark forces that lurk below the surface.
item.properties|f.shadow_blaster: An enhanced blaster modified to fire shadow rounds.
mission.properties|o.dreams_and_nightmar: Prepare for the worst and journey to the Core
conversation.properties|r.och_leader_3_3: Roger that, Lieutenant.  I'll make the Warmaster pay.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_weap_2: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
conversation.properties|r.energy_info_2c: How do I obtain more energy?
item.properties|f.shrouded_crest: Blackened, cursed, and hidden from sight. Thrice-damned herald of an ill-fated soul.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_13: Where do I find accessory tickets?
guild.properties|i.veteran_storage: Community item storage for veterans and above.
item.properties|f.deadshot_mantle: A poncho for a pale rider with sights set on taking down the bad, ugly, undead denizens of the dark.
projectx.properties|e.name_invalid_chara: Sorry, that name contains an invalid character.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_torin: A fading inscription reads\: Here lies Torin, knight of Almire.
redeem.properties|m.instruct: If you have a special code to redeem a reward, you can enter it here\:
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We saw the Gremlins hiding mines out there, watch your step\!
support.properties|m.option_201_0: Instead you could simply click here to ignore {0} so you won't have to listen to them again.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Quite the scarab nest we've stirred up this time eh, {0}? Reminds me of the time we engaged the Morai siege fleets over Isora. That was quite an all or nothing gamble. Doesn't surprise me in the least that we're the only thing standing between us and utter annihilation again.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_mat_345: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
sprites.properties|d.wide_embrace: Increases the area of effect of heart attack.
helptips.properties|m.tg_heat_short: Collect heat to level up your gear\!
conversation.properties|m.hav_mecha_1a: I got a great deal on this broken mecha knight. If I can just figure out how to get it working properly I'll have myself a personal bodyguard for my expeditions into the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.volcanic_plated_pathfi: A hardened set of armor, reinforced with volcanic alloys, made to protect against the toastiest of monsters while exploring the unknown.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Herex slipped away\! I lost sight of him as things went black. It felt like a thousand hands were pulling us away. As if something didn't want us to follow.
item.properties|f.bucket_of_bloons: This bucket seems to have an endless supply of water bloons. They look ready to pop so throw them at your friends\!
item.properties|f.sacred_keeper_armor: A cerulean suit of armor for those who want to wreck some robos.
item.properties|f.hail_driver: Once you've seen the splitting bolts of unnaturally cold ice it produces, you'll understand why this Driver is hailed.
mission.properties|o.return_of_ur: Stop the devilites from summoning an army of nightmarish trojan warriors
conversation.properties|m.winterfest_cam: It's a hazardous climb, {0}. Watch your footing and beware those Grinchlin traps\!
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_2a: That mass of negative energy we've been investigating is a portion of an ancient kingdom called Almire, the very same realm described in that Owlite tome you discovered\!
support.properties|m.subheader_step207:
Scamming is when a player is trying to trick you into doing something you shouldn't do. Examples\:
- This could be trying to reveal your account name or password.
- Wanting to trade accounts with you.
- Claiming to be a Game Master or a friend of yours and trying take advantage of that.
There are many other ways to scam.
item.properties|f.wolver_mask: A simple mask made from wolver pelt.
mission.properties|o.crimson_chaos: Investigate a Crimson Order base that has suddenly gone silent
conversation.properties|m.mission_surviv: It hunted us down...got the rest of my team...
conversation.properties|r.energy_info_3a: I have another question for you.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogmas: Trespassers within my Arsenal?  I'll see to it you go... quietly.
conversation.properties|r.lab_biscotti_4: Where can I acquire these items?
conversation.properties|m.barracks_boost: Purchase a Krogmo Coin Booster from the Upgrades Merchant\!
helptips.properties|m.new_sprite: You've got a battle sprite\! Press [[SPRITE_ACTION_1]] to use your sprite's battle skill\!
item.properties|f.proto_bomb: A small bomb used by Spiral Knight recruits to learn the art of blowing things up.
item.properties|f.nodeslime_shield: This weathered wobbling wall can withstand a walloping when wielded by unwaveringly willed warriors.
projectx.properties|m.love_opt_in_notice:
By enabling this option, you will gain access to knight-created arenas.
You can browse, test, and play community-made content, as well as upload your own.

All arenas are subject to approval by coliseum crew before becoming part of the playable pool.
Please review the information and terms before continuing.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_4a: Sorry, yes of course.  Good luck to you, {0}.  Assemble the best squad you can and lead them well.  We're all counting on you.
sprites.properties|d.caustic_quills: Fires a series of quills that stick to targets and inflict poison. For each hit a quilled target receives, they lose one quill and take additional damage.
redeem.properties|e.max_attempts: You have tried too many invalid codes. Try again in a few minutes.
conversation.properties|n.rfc_dungeon_2a: I was imprisoned here over a thousand years ago for speaking out against my liege lord, sentenced to be here for a lifetime as my punishment.  When the fires overtook the citadel even in my passing I did not find freedom.  My soul is bound to these cursed stones.
helptips.properties|m.tut_bash: When your shield is full, press [[SHIELD_BASH]] to bash and stun monsters\!
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_3a: I'm glad you asked, they certainly do\!  Let's head over to Vatel.
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_1a: Hello there, {0}.  Spiral HQ has informed me that you will be needing a quick lesson in the species of monsters within the Clockworks that inflict piercing damage, yes?
dungeon.properties|m.treasure_vault_1: Treasure Trove|Fortune Smiles on the Greedy
item.properties|f.token_jelly: Typically only carried by jelly royalty, these squishy gems are the official currency of the jelly kingdoms. Though highly prized by slimes, most other creatures simply eat them as they are quite delicious.
help.properties|m.monster_undead: Deal SHADOW - Weak to ELEMENTAL - Strong against SHADOW
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: One of our squads made it inside but got cut off, save them if you can\!
item.properties|f.jack_froster: Usher in a winter wonderland with this nose-nipping, nasty surprise that is perfect for giving your foes a bad case of frostbite.
mission.properties|m.best_of_beast_3a: Should you find yourself facing beast and slime monsters in Tier 3, be aware that they are capable of pure piercing damage.  Only the best piercing-resistant gear will keep you alive in the face of these powerful, piercing predators. \n\nOnce you've completed your upcoming missions we'll talk again.  Good luck, {0}.
item.properties|f.cryotech_alchemer: An alchemical handgun that fires hyper low temperature bullets that split on impact.
guildhelp.properties|m.record_info: The Guild Record logs important recent activity within the guild, such as donations to the Guild Treasury, deposits to and withdrawals from the various Guild Storages, and promotions, additions or departures of guild members. They allow higher-ranked guild members to track who is donating or taking a lot from the guild, and act accordingly.
item.properties|f.polar_twilight_wolf_ho: A warm hood, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. It is said that the polar twilight is a wonderous sight to behold.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
mission.properties|b.reporting_duty: Lieutenant Feron is responsible for overseeing the Clockworks mining operation in the Haven Arcade.  Report to him and learn about the situation in Haven and Spiral HQ's mission to reach the Core of Cradle.
support.properties|m.subheader_step2: We have saved the chat log already waiting to be added to the complaint, so there is no need to hurry from here. Please carefully choose the correct option matching what the player did\:
shop.properties|m.accessoryUseRecover: Want to recover your accessory? Use your recover ticket\!
item.properties|f.thunderball: An orb of pure electricity that is typically found at the bottom of the sea of all places.
item.properties|f.moonstone_shard: A shard of Moonstone that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
mission.properties|r.time_enough_at_last: Without you?  No, I'm here to bring you back.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_3d4b16: Amass an Arsenal that includes a 5 star helmet, armor, shield, gun and bomb.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_steam_cont: Menu key toggles between mouse mode
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_6b: I'd like to see the services. (Follow Tylen)
item.properties|f.hazardous_draped_armor: Loose-fitting armor worn by more experienced Scarlet Scouts. It's rumored that gear like this is crafted from the remains of armor from Scouts who fell in combat, acting as a reminder that unless necessary Scouts never leave a man behind.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_kit: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
item.properties|f.royal_skewer: A jagged, razor-sharp barb from one of the most powerful slimes on Cradle. Once removed from the slime it grows brittle and eventually turns to dust.
social.properties|m.join_friend_mission: Join your friend {0} at depth {1} on the Mission\: {2} ({3})
help.properties|m.support_1: You can access your account info, change your password and update your e-mail address on our official website.
helptips.properties|m.tglobby_vitapod: Vitapods temporarily increase your maximum health until you return to town.
sprites.properties|d.vengeful_shadow_clo: Creates an explosive disruption field around you when shadow cloak is interrupted that has a chance to stun targets.
conversation.properties|m.npc_rummagekni: I know it was here somewhere...
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_b_1a: Hi there {0}\!  Wow, you've made Soldier already?  You're really moving up fast in the ranks. \n\nAnyway, I'm Bechamel, and I'm here to give you a tour of some of the Bazaar's more advanced services. To start, do you want to learn how to even further power up that gear of yours?
item.properties|f.miracle_cloak: A miraculous mantle said to grant a single miracle to the wearer when they need it most.
mission.properties|b.operation_crimson_h:
Warmaster Seerus is the master of munitions of the gremlin's Crimson Order.  Thought to be the true mastermind behind the Roarmulus Twins and countless other gremlin weapons, he is the Crimson Order's creator and supplier for their diabolical engines of war. 

Recon Knights under the command of Lieutenant Feron recently discovered Seerus's 'Grand Arsenal,' his development center and storage facility for all his weaponry.  Now, Feron himself is leading several squads of knights directly into the Grand Arsenal, with the intention of weeding out Seerus and destroying his war machines. 

Met with heavy resistance, Feron's squads require reinforcements and Spiral HQ is sending you in to assist.
item.properties|f.personal_eye: Once used, this item will permanently change your Knight's eyes to the specified eye shape.
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight3_1a: We managed to pull the secondary generator from the Skylark mostly intact. Unfortunately it's barely powerful enough to keep this lab running, let alone power our ship.  We'll need to find another power source if we ever hope to return home.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: Oh no\! Tell her the cakes will be ready. Erm, I'm just a little behind.  I'll make you a deal\: I'll give you some extra cake if we can keep this between you and me. I don't want to be kicked out of the party.
mission.properties|b.p_toxic_plant_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has uncovered a gremlin bioweapons facility deep within the Clockworks. It is believed that this facility belongs to a member of the Crimson Order known only as 'Herex.' The Recon Rangers have been tasked with infiltrating the facility and uncovering the nature of Herex's bioweapons before they are put to use.
item.properties|f.furni_statue: A commemorative statue that may be placed in a Guild Hall. Up to {0} statues may be placed per hall.
item.properties|f.shockburst_brandish: An upgraded Brandish infused with the elemental essence of lightning.
item.properties|f.polar_twilight_warden_: An insulated coat that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The fur-lined armor plating makes it ideal for hours of scanning the horizon during polar twilight.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: We've had a few cases where knights have met non-hostile constructs that they swear behaved like true sentient creatures.  But that is very difficult to believe. Gremlins are brilliant, but brilliant at the kind of direct engineering that simply gets the job done and little else.  Brute force. \n\nArtificial life?  Well, that's something else entirely.
item.properties|f.wild_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_5a: It would seem so.  And this place, it just radiates evil, it's almost indescribable.  It's even starting to affect the levels surrounding it- fires are breaking out everywhere. \n\nYou're one of the best we've got, {0} and if there's anyone that could lead a squad through the citadel it's you.  But even reaching it won't be easy.  We're going to need to take care of a few fires and gather a bit more intel before storming the gates.
item.properties|f.honor_blade_4: A ceremonial sword issued to Vanguards of the Spiral Order. Though intended for formal occasions, its fine edge makes it suitable for combat use.
mission.properties|b.eye_of_needle: After compiling the data you collected from the Owlite keep and additional intel from Recon Knights, Intel Agent Kora has prepared a debriefing for you with regard to the mass of negative energy blocking access to the Core.
mission.properties|r.cwt_mintut_6: Sounds great\! Thanks for the info\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_lab_by: Our guards were overwhelmed.  We never stood a chance.
projectx.properties|e.wrong_level_item: Must use required item to level up\!
helptips.properties|m.rescue_door_sk: I've almost got this door open. While I'm working at it, rescue the captive knights in the area\!
item.properties|f.chilling_duelist: Start settling disputes at the crack of dawn with this cold, custom handgun.
dungeon.properties|m.split_invite: {0} has ventured on ahead, if you're quick you can still join them\!
mission.properties|b.p_r7_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
item.properties|f.wrench_wand: A heavy hand tool favored by Gremlins. It's good for both tightening bolts and cracking skulls.
item.properties|f.fowl_cloak_vol: A scorched feathered cloak. Set a fire under your feet and ensure punctuality as sure as the roosters crow.
conversation.properties|r.tier_unequippe: Roger that, I'll head back for now.
conversation.properties|m.tut_warden_2a: You and me both. Now let's get- \n\nHold on, something's not right. Brace yourself, I think we've got company\!
mission.properties|b.target_acquired: After analyzing the schematics you recovered from the gremlin test lab, Spiral HQ now knows the nature of Project R as well as its location within a gremlin munitions facility.  Spiral HQ is requesting that you enter this facility and destroy Project R before it can be used on Haven.  Speak with Intel Agent Kora for full details.
mission.properties|b.darkest_forces: Hearing that your next missions will have you facing the likes of fiendish and undead monsters in the depths of Tier 3, Chief Biotech Hahn has requested you contact him before deploying for your latest missions.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: Excellent\! Which battle sprite will you choose as your companion?
item.properties|f.storm_caller: A party favor of the gods, used to summon a bolt of lightning from the heavens.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro3_3c: Remember, press [[?DEFEND]] to use your shield\!
pvp.properties|m.start_soon: Your {0} game will be starting soon...
item.properties|f.furni_table_manor_1: An exquisite end table, meticulously manufactured for monumental magnificence.
item.properties|f.chaos_cowl: A hood of dubious origin that shrouds its wearer in both mystery and elemental protection.
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_expira: Please check that the expiration date is correct and try again. Your card has not been charged.
item.properties|f.token_spirit: An otherworldly brand placed upon a soul claimed by the mysterious Apocrea. Removing it allows the captured soul to escape imprisonment within the terrible realm of the Apocrea.
item.properties|f.bombastic_demo_helm: A finely-made helmet for the more discerning explosives expert. It won't tell you what kind of wine goes best with Nitronome, but it'll certainly keep your head looking good. And in one piece.
mission.properties|b.true_champion: Having come out of the Firestorm Citadel alive, Intel Agent Kora eagerly awaits to hear from you.
helptips.properties|m.unlock_grim_gate: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use a Fiendish ID Card \n\nWARNING\: If this Grim Gate is unlocked the party will become locked and stay locked for the duration of the mission. Choose your party members wisely\!
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_1: Hello. I'm Wegner, Chief Geo Knight of the Skylark and head of geological studies within the Clockworks.
conversation.properties|m.rc_injured_c: Thanks to you we will not have to face another night like the last...
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_4a: When a battle sprite is issued to a knight, a 'bond' is written into the sprite's code to support the knight no matter the circumstances.  They will never leave your side\! \n\nUnfortunately, the cargo crates holding the Skylark's cache of battle sprites fell deep into the Clockworks after the crash.
conversation.properties|m.rc_instruct_3b: A "gate" is an entry point into the Clockworks. They take the form of the lifts you see before you. Each gate has a display monitor showing the gate's unique icon as well as a control panel that allows the user to enter the gate. This gate here will always take you to the same place, but other gates have shifting floors beneath them. In those, you never quite know what's next\!
mission.properties|b.p_r9_weap_5: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
chat.properties|m.usage_unmute: Usage\: /{0} player name\nStops blocking messages from the specified player.
item.properties|f.mechaknight_helm: A hardy helm handcrafted by Gremlin smiths to protect a Mecha Knight's control unit. With the control unit removed it fits a knight remarkably well.
item.properties|f.super_poison_barrier: Surrounds you with potent toxic orbs that can cripple hostiles
item.properties|f.buckled_coat: A verdant coat fastened with shiny golden buckles.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_battlesta: A simple display commemorating a knight's recruitment into the Spiral Order.
mission.properties|o.crossing_chasm_b: Cross the chasm with Rhendon and reach Haven
mission.properties|o.crossing_chasm: Cross the perilous chasm and connect with Spiral HQ in Haven
item.properties|f.venom_fiend_mail: A plated mail said to be crafted in the image of a venomous fiend. It comes with a sinister skinsuit that pulses with a vile essence.
mission.properties|o.p_heart_of_ice_r6: Discover the source of the terrible blizzards emanating from Amu-Sol
conversation.properties|m.npc_campknight: Have a seat and rest a while.
helptips.properties|m.unlock: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use a Silver Key.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_lazy_snipe: A quietly resting snipe that will stay where it's placed.
mission.properties|m.alone_in_dark_3a: Should you attempt to enter the citadel and manage to reach the throne room, please, end his suffering.  Allow the souls he keeps bound to this world a chance to return to their loved ones. \n\nAnd one more thing- I've heard that some kind of force of nature had once tried to right his wrongs but Lord Vanaduke imprisoned it somewhere within his fortress.  Finding and freeing it may prove useful.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Moorcroft Manor.
item.properties|f.grate_plate: A protective plate with peephole perforations permitting ventilation of exhalations.
mission.properties|m.darkest_depths_2a: Yes, it has become something of a second home for us hasn't it?  Almost like we belong here, it's strange.
auction.properties|m.no_mybids: You have not bid on any recent auctions.
helptips.properties|m.tut_goldkey: Pick up and use on Gold Doors\!
item.properties|f.rage_caller: A party favor of the gods, used to summon a shaft of rage from the heavens.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_7a: Hsst\! So, you're the ones who defeated Razwog and took what was mine.  You are not worthy of possessing this powerful Artifact and so I am here to relieve you of it.
item.properties|f.prize_box_winterfest: Contains various unique Winterfest prizes. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.prize_box_blazing: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Blazing style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|r.rc_greet2_3a: I'll meet up with Rhendon before I investigate the generator.
support.properties|m.subheader_step202: If the player you're complaining about is annoying then that does not qualify as complaint worthy.\n\nAnnoying are issues like calling you names or teasing you.
conversation.properties|m.mission_crimso: King Tinkinzar alone holds the Iron Law\!
item.properties|f.gram: An extraordinarily heavy sword whose weight will slow down even the swiftest of knights. That said, just imagine what it'll do to anything you hit with it...
conversation.properties|r.rc_instruct_1b: No questions, just actions. I'm off now.
item.properties|f.wizard_box: Contains one of various unique weird and wonderful wizardly items. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|b.the_collector: There have been scattered reports of a large, mechanical entity we have named the 'Collector' who has been intercepting our knights and taking both them and the sprites they were tracking and imprisoning them in a well-guarded compound deep within the Clockworks.  Armed with your new sprite, your mission is to find this 'Collector' and rescue the knights and sprites it has taken captive.
item.properties|m.expire_days.1: This item expires {0} day after it is equipped.\n
item.properties|f.prize_box_cavalry: Contains various unique accessories and items to celebrate the Year of the Horse\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_1:
Glorp\! Glorp\! Glorp\! Merry Winterfest\!

That special time of year is finally here, when a delicate blanket of wondrous white snow covers Haven and every Stranger, every snipe and every Knight fills their hearts with holiday cheer.

But to you I must tell, all is sadly not well. Lacking motive or reason, a group of shriveled-heart grinchlins have threatened this Winterfest season\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_colossal: Contains various unique costumes and accessories to celebrate the Year of the Horse\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
conversation.properties|r.core_tech_3: I'll continue to explore the Clockworks and collect the minerals needed for your research.
dungeon.properties|m.terminal_desc: A level where travelers can safely return to town, or journey further into the depths of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.crystal_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in an alloy of Moonstone and Valestone. Its soothing shade of cerulean has been clinically proven to both calm knights and annihilate the undead.
item.properties|f.furni_beacon_floor_yel: A Spiral-issued light source typically used to recommend caution.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_wasd_move_: Keyboard used for movement, advanced commands, quickslots and chat
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: But what about you and the others?
chat.properties|m.unspecific_flag: Flag not specific enough, did you mean "{0}?"
item.properties|f.love_puppy_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a love puppy.  It's so convincing, your friends just might want a kiss\!
mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_2a: As you know I am attempting to assemble a research team to work on-site in the Core terminal.  In order to successfully utilize it to restore the Skylark, it is imperative that we reach it and set up this research station. \n\nAll evidence seems to point towards you having the potential to finally reach the Core.  By breaking through the Firestorm Citadel and establishing a link to the Core, my team could set up the necessary supply lines and get to work immediately.  But we can't do that while that infernal citadel and its horrible ruler stand in our way.
item.properties|f.crimsonite_deposit_3: A large lump of minerals that will generate a great many units of crimsonite.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Hello {0}, it seems you had few problems with the oozing hordes and their like which can no doubt be chalked up to a good education on their behaviors prior to the mission.
mission.properties|o.the_collector: Save the sprites and the researchers from the Collector
item.properties|f.seraphic_mail: A beautiful mail coat that causes its wearer to strike out at evil with righteous fury.
projectx.properties|m.reboot_warning: The server will be rebooted in {0} minutes. {1}
item.properties|f.ticket_unbind_1: Use this ticket at the Unbinding Forge to unbind a 1 star item.
global.properties|e.invalid_xfer_state: An error has been detected with your knight. Please log off and back on again. If the problem persists, please file a bug report.
mission.properties|o.p_halloween_r4: Seek an audience with the Punkin King.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_bomb: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
guild.properties|m.rename_gms_only: Sorry, only Guild Masters may rename a guild.
item.properties|f.winterfest_table: A stylish antique table with a plate of cookies set out for Impostclaus.
conversation.properties|m.mon_pocket_1:
Greetings\! I'm Nonna with the Emberlight Adoption Agency\! 

We at the Emberlight Adoption Agency collect baby monsters that have managed to become lost in the darkest depths of the Clockworks.  No longer having a home or any means of caring for themselves, we try to find these needy monsters a good home\! 

By purchasing one of these adorable 'monster pockets' you can carry around a baby monster of your very own\! 

The Emberlight Adoption Agency will visit Haven from time to time, and you never know what we will have to offer\!
item.properties|f.capsule_health_super: A capsule that restores a large amount of health. An adventurer's best friend\!
item.properties|f.power_cell: A small device used to power complex machines.
social.properties|m.party_invite: {0} has invited you to join their party.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: (For the first time since you've known him, Hahn is silent. He seems to be contemplating your findings very carefully.)
guild.properties|i.console_edit: Work with others to decorate and modify the Guild Hall.
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus: Glorp, glorp, glorp\!  Merry Winterfest\!\n\nGet into the holiday spirit with snowball fights in wintery Lockdown levels and turn in those Krogmo Coins for splendid Santy Hats\!
mission.properties|o.built_to_destroy: Dismantle the Roarmulus Twins in the heart of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory
mission.properties|m.target_acquired_4a: There's one last thing- it seems you won't be the first knight to have entered the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.  We've detected another Alpha Squad recon module somewhere within the factory.  Please attempt to recover it.  I hope that analysis proves that Euclid's squad made it out of there alive...
item.properties|f.storm_dragon_helm: An enchanted helm crafted into the visage of a beast who some believe created the world in its passing\: its fire the sun, its bones the mountains.
item.properties|f.prize_box_stormy: Contains various unique costumes and accessories crafted from thunder and lightning. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_b_: I'll be sure to say hello when I see a Stranger.
item.properties|f.armor_rear: An accessory that can be attached to the rear of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_0_1a: Well met, {0}. This is the Hall of Heroes, where veteran knights come to offer their services to members of our order who have attained the rank of Soldier or higher. \n\nBy undertaking more missions, I am confident that you will one day stand among us.
mission.properties|r.pioneers_6a: Tell me about Squad Guardian Grantz.
pvp.properties|m.start_delayed: Your {0} game has been delayed. Waiting for more players...
helptips.properties|m.unlock_gold: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use the Gold Key.
conversation.properties|m.tortodrone_hav: Tucked away inside a mysterious garden we found a strange portal that HQ is calling a Grim Gate. From what we were able to decode you will need a key of sorts to open it. Spiral HQ thinks the glyphs we spotted the Fiends carrying might have something to do with opening the gate.
uplink.properties|m.subject: SUBJECT
helptips.properties|m.tut_golddoor: Find the Gold Key to open this door\!
item.properties|f.exp_east_3f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.cautery_sword: A sword adapted from a medical tool, its heated blade reduces tissue damage. It is very formidable at destroying monsters of the slime family.
item.properties|f.skolver_coat: The ultimate in Wolver-hide clothing, this coat has been expertly crafted to give your melee attacks extra power.
chat.properties|m.usage_follow: Usage\: /{0}\nTell your comrades to follow you\!
sprites.properties|d.concussive_firebolt: Adds a chance for a powerful stun to the firebolt.
conversation.properties|r.monsterboost_s: And... Anomalie is signing off on this?
item.properties|f.hunting_blade: A jagged edge used for finishing off big game. It cuts through beasts like butter.
helptips.properties|m.tut_welcome: We have picked up your distress signal, recruit. Your first objective is to reach Haven, where we have created an outpost. You're likely a little woozy from the crash, so I'll guide you through the basics. The road may be dangerous, so ready your sword and keep your wits about you. Good luck\!
dungeon.properties|p.join_leave_party: Leave your current party to join {0}?
item.properties|f.token_roarmulus: A special circuit board developed by gremlin engineers designed to enhance both the bark and bite of the Roarmulus Twins.
chat.properties|m.usage_pbroadcast: Usage\: /{0} message\nBroadcasts message to everyone on the current peer.
item.properties|f.prize_box_cozy: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Cozy style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
craft.properties|e.existing_accessory: This item already has an accessory of this type. Remove it first.
pvp.properties|m.super_brawl-info: Super Brawl is a fantastic, free-for-all fight for up to eight knights\! You will be awarded points for defeating other contestants and lose points for being defeated. The contestant with the most points at the end of the five-minute round wins\!
item.properties|f.omega_shell: A shield created from the armor of a Tortomega. The sheer weight of this powerful shield makes it only an option for the strongest of warriors.
conversation.properties|r.atg_greeter_2a: Thanks\! I'm off to explore now.
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_tall_gre: A tall, elegant street lamp that emits a green glow with a gentle hiss.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_3_2a: Well met, {0}. It is good to see you once more. \n\nNow then {0}, for your 4 Star Certification you must be currently equipped with a 4 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
item.properties|f.ultra_shock_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly orbs of lightning that can give hostiles a jolt
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_3_8a: I assume you've named them as well?
mission.properties|b.p_r6_mat_123: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|m.in_style_kit: (This modifier is also present in your style kit.)
conversation.properties|m.af_chat_04: They're coming out of the walls\!
item.properties|f.confetti_fall_equinox: When thrown, this fall confetti bursts with autumn embers.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_end: Seems like you have a good grasp on the basics. I think you're ready to join the rest of the recruits in the Sparrow Gate. There you will learn how to work as a party. There's a lot of recruits out there depending on you now. Great job\!
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_11: (He appears to be staring very intently at the corner.)
mission.properties|o.shadowplay: Discover the source of the disturbance in Firestorm Citadel
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_1a: How about this place, huh? Looks like some kind of old rail station overrun with restless spirits. What an odd place to find underground. \n\nAnyway, we better head to the cache of sprites fast given what we found back in the Sunset Steppes. Let's go\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_hazardous: Contains various unique items used by Rhendon's elite Scarlet Scouts. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_3b: All gremlins belonging to the colony serve King Tinkinzar. Tinkinzar is said to be a great ruler and mechanical genius, responsible for the vision of the whole of the Clockworks. It is our understanding however that the king is never seen by common gremlins, but instead his orders are delivered and carried out by his Crimson Order, a fearful and zealous band of gremlins who alone share audience with the great king.

mission.properties|b.built_to_destroy:
Once known to Spiral HQ as 'Project R,' the Roarmulus Twins have been identified as a gremlin-engineered weapon of tremendous power built with the sole purpose of destroying Haven.  Stored deep within the heart of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory, this weapon is not only protected by hordes of shock-powered constructs and gremlins, but the factory is a highly dangerous, explosive hazard itself\! 

In addition to shutting down the Roarmulus Twins, Spiral HQ would like you to recover the Alpha Squad recon module that is believed to be located somewhere within the factory. 

It is highly recommended that you form a full squad before deploying.

mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.

mission.properties|b.weight_of_darkness:
It is speculated that all fiends within the Clockworks crossed over from a dimension known as the Underworld.  While how they crossed over and what their motives are on Cradle is unclear, data collected from fiendish cities seems to indicate that they are now stranded on Cradle, much like us. 

The undead on the other hand remain a mystery.  Why spirits return to the material realm is unknown, though it is clear that many of the spirits within the Clockworks have come from other worlds.  Given how hostile these creatures can be, the only way to obtain useful data is through direct interactions, like combat. 

Spiral HQ is requesting that you collect combat data for the powerful fiend and undead monsters in Tier 3 of the Clockworks in order to better understand the nature of these creatures. 

It is highly recommended that you equip yourself with shadow resistant gear with elemental and piercing damage weapons\!

The Iron Law is Broken\! 
The Crimson Order is False\! 
The Nine are blind, they cannot see the Truth that lies below.
