conversation.properties|m.final_test_kni: I see.  This will be very interesting information for Spiral HQ.  Our base camp in Haven is just up ahead.  Head on up the elevator and meet the other Knights who survived the crash like yourself. The techs in the Lab will be eager to study that artifact.  They'll see to it once you get to Haven. \n\nDon't worry about the others in the Rescue Camp.  Thanks to you, we have a functioning elevator system to reach them.  You've saved them all\!
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_4a: Now then, greet those that have helped you become what you are today. When you are done, take the elevator back up to receive your commendation.
item.properties|f.dread_captain_cutlass: A custom curving cutter kept keen on careless castaways.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_4a: (Kora pauses) \n\nSpeak of the devil, Rhendon is calling now; says it's urgent. Patching him through...
mission.properties|m.collector_prisoner_: Ugh, I can barely see... did Spiral HQ send you to rescue us?
item.properties|f.kat_eye_cloak: A crudely crafted cloak made to resemble a crack shot warrior of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|b.welcome_to_haven_b: Having survived the journey to Haven you must contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink and give her your report.  She has information as to what to do next.
item.properties|f.mod_calibrator: This complicated device was specially built to calibrate mods, and should not be confused with a Calibrator Mod, which modifies calibrators. It's a common mistake.
monster.properties|m.overtime_3: Glad I caught you. I'm looking for someone to really rise to the challenge this weekend...
item.properties|f.prize_box_ancient: Contains various unique items fashioned in the ancient, veiled homeland of the tortodrones. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|b.terminal_meltdown: Drawn to the Firestorm Citadel, a horde of fiery slime and beast monsters have swarmed a nearby fuel depot putting the depot and our access to the citadel at risk. Should these monsters spread the fires into the fuel drums, the whole place will go up in flames. \n\nSpiral HQ needs you to enter the depot and put out the fire before time runs out and an explosive disaster is triggered\!
item.properties|f.graviton_bomb: Capable of dragging enemies toward its location before exploding, this bomb utilizes technology that the Spiral Order does not fully understand.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_1a: Greetings {0}, this is Intel Agent Kora confirming your contact with Spiral HQ. I will serve as your main connection to Spiral HQ during your time here on Cradle and provide you with intel for the many dangerous missions you have ahead of you. \n\nMy data briefing on your training performances in the Skylark suggests that you will be well-suited for what's to come.  I look forward to our working together.
mission.properties|m.occurance_at_owlite:
...returning as something unnatural... 

...endless inferno.... 

...Almire destroyed... 

...they can never leave, they can never escape the flames...
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r7: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_3a: Our recent intel from Recon Knights suggest that gremlins are planning something big.  We believe they are developing some kind of weapon they're calling 'Project R' that will be targeting Haven itself.  Spiral HQ and the Strangers themselves are requesting that you investigate the matter given your performance in the Royal Jelly Palace.
sprites.properties|d.disintegration_ray: The ray of light also reduces the defense of its targets.
item.properties|f.cyclops_cap: A strange helm with a single, focused eye favored by junior gunners.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
item.properties|f.gunpuppy_helm: A helm handcrafted from salvaged Gun Puppy parts.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_1a: What's this? Another poor soul ripe for harvest by the Apocrea?
helptips.properties|m.atg_blocks2: Blocks can even affect each other\!
item.properties|f.jelly_animal: A magnificent animalistic mask exemplifying ectoplasmic expropriation.
item.properties|f.maidens_tear: A sacred jewel cherished by Almirian knights.  Given to them by their beloved, it is said to keep them safe in battle.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: If only there were some way to open up those gates\!
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_mouse_move: Mouse used for targeting, attacking, movement and menu navigation
item.properties|f.token_page: A crumbling page torn from a long-forgotten grimoire of the Moorcroft Manor archives. The indecipherable language written upon it glows faintly in the dark as if containing power in its very words.
item.properties|f.frenzy_caller: A party favor of the gods, used to summon a flash of frenzy from the heavens.
item.properties|f.drake_scale: A solid scale wrested from a brutal beast.
mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
item.properties|f.phial_phear: A glass tube containing a small dose of phearium, a strange chemical said to induce panic into anyone who even gets so much as a whiff of the stuff.
projectx.properties|m.instance_shutdown: There has been a server error. You will be transferred to another instance.
item.properties|f.dusker_coat: A warm adventurer's coat that'll let you strike with the ferocity of an Alpha Dusker.
item.properties|f.winged_helm: A helm whose design evokes an almost heavenly beauty.
chat.properties|m.usage_goodbye: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nBids your fellow players farewell.
mission.properties|m.collector_prisoner_: My rescue team was ambushed by some giant mechanical horror. We didn't stand a chance. I'm glad you got here when you did, otherwise I don't know if we would have made it.
projectx.properties|m.infobox_loadout: Loadouts are configurations of equipment that you design\! Here you can save your current configuration for later use or equip an existing loadout.
chat.properties|m.usage_level_up: Usage\: /{0} (weapon armor helmet shield) [crystals]\nAttempts to level up the specified equipment using fire crystals.
item.properties|f.searing_edge: A light blade that sets foes ablaze as it slashes. The technology that keeps the hilt from catching fire is more advanced than the sword itself.
item.properties|f.cuirass: A tight-fitting suit of armor that is all business and no pockets.
item.properties|f.hex_visor: It's said a fly could dodge anything with eyes like these. Too bad you're not a fly.
item.properties|f.prize_box_dazed: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Dazed style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_short_gr: A short, elegant street lamp that emits a green glow with a gentle hiss.
chat.properties|m.no_tell_mute: You can't tell to a person that you've ignored.
mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r7:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!
item.properties|f.slumber_squall: A powerful alchemical bomb that creates a thick fog of sleepy mist.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_min: Gather minerals for Chief Geo Knight Wegner's research.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_1a: Hello {0}, I've been meaning to talk to you for some time, but it seems Spiral HQ is keeping you very busy.
item.properties|f.furni_library_bookstac: A loose pile of miscellaneous texts, ranging from cookbooks to eldritch codexes scribbled in unintelligible script.
item.properties|f.bottomless_stocking: An interdimensional tear in this fuzzy fabric sock swallows any item placed within it.  It even swallowed the stitches.
mission.properties|o.the_gauntlet: Battle your way to the Firestorm Citadel through a bulwark of monstrous might
shop.properties|m.purchaseWindowDepotAd: Out of energy? Get more in the supply depot\!
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_7a: No problem, I've got the time.  Let's start from the top.
item.properties|f.deadly_crystal_bomb: A large chunk of Moonstone and Valestone alloy primed with a potent explosive. Studies have shown that this bomb can be used to reduce a zombie's craving for brains by up to 100% by blowing them to pieces.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2d: Battle sprites gain perks at certain levels that you can equip within the battle sprite interface. Perks provide bonuses to your stats.
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_3a: A battle sprite is an AI-driven construct capable of reconnaissance and light combat support.  Battle sprites are highly adaptable.  Their AI allows them to acutely observe their surroundings and aid their knight in the most optimal way.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_gremlin: Steal the gremlin schematics from the gremlin construction site\!
conversation.properties|m.core_lead_2: We're attempting to find a means to activate the Core through the power of the minerals found within the Clockworks.  Those minerals are capable of transforming the Clockworks- we have seen this in the Haven Arcade.  It is our belief that we can use that power to activate the Core and... open it somehow.
mission.properties|b.securing_camp_b: Before you attempt to investigate the monster-infested depths below the Rescue Camp, Rhendon would like you to help him eliminate some of the monsters that attacked the Rescue Camp last night.
mission.properties|b.strength_unity: Something has riled up a pack of beasts in the Aurora Isles and they have descended upon a Geo Knight research team.  Cornered, the team has sent a distress signal and Spiral HQ has issued the task of saving them to you. \n\nBy standing together, the Geo Knights have made it this long but their time is running out. Assemble a team and confront the beasts that seek to devour your fellow knights\!
helptips.properties|m.scenario_fiendbook: What to Do if You Summon the Wrong Infernal Overlord
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_1a: Listen up, Rangers\!  Grab your scarves and sharpened swords because where we're going isn't going to include a warm welcome\!  Our scouts report that Amu-Sol is a frozen wasteland filled with fiends and hungry beasts.  This fiendish city seems to be spreading its icy chill throughout the Clockworks and if we don't get in there and figure out why, it's going to be a long winter here on Cradle. \n\nLet's ride, Rangers\!
item.properties|f.kat_eye_cowl: A magnificently crafted cowl said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Preowa, whose artillery silenced the Grey Feather Tower Sages.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_weap_5: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
item.properties|f.warmaster_helm_3: A remake of a mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus of the Crimson Order.  This perfect recreation bears the terrible likeness of Seerus himself, serving as a dark memento of Operation Crimson Hammer.
mission.properties|m.true_champion_2a: Well, as far as I'm concerned this is only the beginning for you, {0}.  You are a true Champion of the Spiral Knights.  And since I haven't been reassigned, I suppose it's just the beginning for 'us' as well\!
item.properties|f.volcanic_demo_suit: Highly protective gear for the cutting-edge demolition man. The internal cooling system makes you feel a little like you've been cryogenically frozen.
mission.properties|b.p_apocrea_r9: Several capable knights have gone missing in a seemingly normal area of the Clockwork Tunnels. Spiral HQ suspects foul play and has assigned you to investigate the level.
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_compl: Our focus with the Spirit Mother is strong now thanks to you\! Use the water that flows from the spirit wells to extinguish the shadow fire. The path ahead is is ridden with shadow fire and Vanaduke's minions and while we sprites can do little to aid you in battle, we can at least summon spirit wells in certain areas.
helptips.properties|m.party_locked_warni: WARNING\! Upon using this elevator your party will be locked for the remainder of the mission.
dungeon.properties|m.terminal_core_desc: A small terminal in the darkest depths of the Clockworks that looks out on to the colossal, ever-beating heart of the world.
item.properties|f.jar_o_fireflies: A small jar of hibernating fireflies that can be released on a festive occasion.
mission.properties|o.silent_legion: Pursue Guardian Knight Arkus and bring him back to Haven
mission.properties|o.time_enough_at_last: Discover the fate of the lost knight within the Scarlet Fortress
chat.properties|m.usage_fallback: Usage\: /{0}\nTell your comrades to fall back.
conversation.properties|r.mon_pocket_1: Show me who is up for adoption\!
item.properties|f.critter_carapace: A chitinous chunk carefully shucked from a Clockworks creature. It's in surprisingly good shape.
projectx.properties|i.cull_transients: Prevents display of some off-screen graphics effects\npossibly speeding up graphical performance, but may\ncause some effects not to appear.
item.properties|f.icebreaker_helm: A Frostbreaker Helm modified to provide further protection against freeze.
item.properties|f.dark_matter_deposit_3: A large lump of minerals that will generate a great many units of dark matter.
mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!
helptips.properties|m.atg_cblocks: Hit a CRYSTAL BLOCK to destroy other crystal blocks of the same color.
conversation.properties|r.rc_instruct_3b: Thanks for the information, I'll be off now.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_3: Then use them with honor and let them protect you from the fury of the countless foes you will soon face.  The Core that we seek, there's something truly dreadful about it.  I know that it may very well be what gets us home, but I can't shake this feeling that we've been thinking about it all wrong.
helptips.properties|m.tut_lever: Doors can often be opened by finding the right switch. Try hitting this switch with your handgun\!
mission.properties|o.p_tortodrone_r9: Investigate the Ancient Grove and put a stop to a Fiendish plot.
item.properties|f.power_dust: A portion of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.
item.properties|f.slime_trinket: A curious circle coated with calcified slime.
item.properties|f.clockworks_box: A celebration of all things related to the Clockworks\! Contains costumes and accessories built from the same girders, plates, cogs, and gears that make up the Clockworks deep within the planet of Cradle. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
guild.properties|log.mist_added: Deposited {0} energy to the energy well (new total\: {1}).
item.properties|f.illuminating_ward: A personal candle for warding off the darkness, and that which lurks within it.
item.properties|f.weapon_slot_upgrade_30: Once used, this upgrade opens an additional weapon slot for 30 days.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
pvp.properties|m.playagain_team.1: 1 guildmate is needed for a {1} team.
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_remin: Once you find a sprite, carry them back to the sacred circle you see before you. They are no doubt weakened from Vanaduke's curse and will require rejuvenation. Once we are all reunited we will form a focus link with the Spirit Mother and bring water to the wells.\n\nPlease hurry\!
projectx.properties|m.confirm_mode_chang: Mode changed. Click to accept within {0} or the\nmode will automatically revert to the previous setting.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_5a: That's right, you can acquire recipes and materials in order to alchemize weapons and gear at alchemy stations.  Come on, I'll show you one.
chat.properties|m.usage_mute: Usage\: /{0} player name\nBlocks messages from the specified player.
