mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Backup at last\! {0}, look\! The Core is opening\!
mission.properties|m.the_flickering_flam: We were in the middle of receiving a report from Lieutenant Vaelyn's team at the Core Terminal when our signal was disrupted. It took some time, but I've managed to pinpoint the source of the disruption. It's coming from that strange device you discovered near Vanaduke's throne room in Firestorm Citadel.  It seems like someone has activated it.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft1_r6: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
mission.properties|b.skies_under_cradle: The Clockworks are a fascinating underground complex that houses entire worlds within its colossal, iron geo-globes.  One of them that recon knights have discovered is known as the 'Aurora Isles,' a series of mysterious floating islands under a false sky. \n\nAs a newly ranked Apprentice, you now have clearance to explore the ruins within these islands and collect any useful materials you may discover.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_16: Wonderful\!  I'm glad I could help you get your bearings. Good luck to you, {0}\!
mission.properties|b.operation_crimson_h:
Warmaster Seerus is the master of munitions of the gremlin's Crimson Order.  Thought to be the true mastermind behind the Roarmulus Twins and countless other gremlin weapons, he is the Crimson Order's creator and supplier for their diabolical engines of war. 

Recon Knights under the command of Lieutenant Feron recently discovered Seerus's 'Grand Arsenal,' his development center and storage facility for all his weaponry.  Now, Feron himself is leading several squads of knights directly into the Grand Arsenal, with the intention of weeding out Seerus and destroying his war machines. 

Met with heavy resistance, Feron's squads require reinforcements and Spiral HQ is sending you in to assist.
item.properties|f.sacred_keeper_helm: A cerulean hued helm for those who want to wreck some robos.
item.properties|f.fire_raider_helm: A pristine raider helmet, save for a few dings and a thick coat of ash.
mission.properties|m.shadow_knows_2a: Spiral HQ has informed me that you are ready to learn about monsters that inflict shadow damage correct?
helptips.properties|m.atg_crowns: CROWNS are used to buy items and pay for other services.
exchange.properties|m.tradefooter: Current offers are set by the players. If a suitable offer for you is not available, click the market tab to post your own.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_4: Welcome back to the Hall of Heroes, {0}.  Please speak to the heroic knights you see before you to gain access to their weapons and gear.
item.properties|f.deadly_charcoaler: This gallant grill is guaranteed to char your competition.
item.properties|f.confetti: Use this item to throw it into the air and celebrate good times. Come on\!
item.properties|f.blast_powder: A dangerous by-product produced by fire-based organic creatures. Gremlins like to use it to blow stuff up.
mission.properties|e.good_unavailable: Sorry, that item is no longer available.
projectx.properties|m.reboot_msg_downtim: The game will be unavailable for a short time during scheduled maintenance.
item.properties|f.fire_barrier: Surrounds you with fiery orbs that can set hostiles ablaze
mission.properties|r.best_of_beast_2a: I understand my upcoming missions will have me facing mostly beast and slime monsters.
steam.properties|m.convert_to_steam: Would you like to move your knights, energy, achievements, etc., to your Steam account? \nThis will allow you to log on automatically at start up as well as to take advantage of \nSteam features such as achievements, voice chat, and invites.
mission.properties|m.honor_duty_2a: I've read your report of the Core, it's fascinating.  What an impossible structure and to think that the Alpha Squad might actually still be alive but... inside that thing is just incredible. \n\nI understand that Lieutenant Vaelyn has already led a team to the Core terminal and is establishing a base of operations for research.  This is of great value to all Spiral Knights and we have you to thank\!
item.properties|f.twisted_snarble_barb: A gnarled Snarble Barb enhanced to swing with a satisfying "snicker-snack".
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_4a: Vatel here will sell you a selection of recipes as well as personal color changers and other items.
item.properties|f.grave_soil: Dreadful dirt dredged from a creepy crypt. It is always a little cold to the touch.
item.properties|f.furni_rainbow: A magnificent arc of refracted light. What does it mean?
item.properties|f.dark_chaingun: A machine gun capable of firing a barrage of searing, shadow bolts.
conversation.properties|m.npc_lostknight: It's good to know Spiral HQ hasn't forgotten about me.
conversation.properties|r.hav_clock_1a: Tell me what you know about the Clockworks.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_5: May the Spirit Mother guide you.
sprites.properties|d.drakon: The drakon is a battle sprite that embodies fiery destruction. Its skills focus on raw, offensive power.
item.properties|f.freezing_pulsar: A pulsar modified with a freezing agent that grows colder over time. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
item.properties|f.culet: An elegantly designed suit of armor capable of flattering any form.
item.properties|f.polar_day_warden_hood: An insulated hood that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The full coverage mask makes it ideal for hours of daytime watch duty.
helptips.properties|m.loading6: If you become poisoned you will not be able to heal yourself. Avoid taking too much damage until it wears off.
dungeon.properties|i.difficulty_easy: Normal difficulty features challenges suitable for any player.
sprites.properties|d.dark_harness_adv: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal shadow damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 5% \nCan be used by\: Drakon, Maskeraith
item.properties|f.trojan_horseshoe: A jet black horseshoe. It appears relatively harmless.
pvp.properties|m.title: KING KROGMO'S COLISEUM
social.properties|m.party_full: Oops\! That party is no longer accepting new members.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_4a: We need you to discover what happened to them.  You'll start by seeking out known locations of their recon modules and collecting them for analysis.  I will be in charge of locating their general whereabouts and directing you toward them.  It's your job to go into the wild to retrieve them. \n\nAdditionally, I'll provide you with a quick background of each of the four members of the Alpha Squad\: Squad Leader Euclid, Squad Guardian Grantz, Squad Recon Parma, and Squad Technician Rulen.
mission.properties|m.breaking_in_recruit: Greetings, little. One. Don't step. On snipes.
mission.properties|b.rise_or_fall: Infiltrating the Royal Jelly Palace and taking on the hordes of slimes that serve the great Royal Jelly is not going to be an easy task.  It is highly recommended you seek one of the 'Battle Arenas' within the Clockworks and determine if your equipment is up to the challenge of facing so many savage slimes. \n\nSpiral HQ has located one of these mysterious arenas that seems to be filled with all manner of gooey gladiators seeking a challenge.  Give them a good fight\!
item.properties|f.medieval_war_helm: A heaume sturdily built to last for a hundred years of war.
item.properties|f.chroma_mask: A mask crafted from the hide of a chromalisk, offering the wearer its distinguished look.
item.properties|f.prize_box_c: The complete collection of {0} costumes and accessories. One item will be randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.cryo_driver: A high-tech alchemical sidearm that fires powerful cryo bullets that split multiple times on impact.
item.properties|f.barbarous_thorn_shield: A mythical shield imbued with the fury of the Snarbolax itself. It's said that the beast can use the glowing orbs on the shield's face to see and stalk weak-hearted wielders.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Apologies for not appearing in person. I'm hidden away in a safe place. I knew I'd never make it there in time when I noticed your signal. Luckily I was able to pull some strings and find you an exit.
item.properties|f.kat_eye_raiment: A reclaimed raiment said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Preowa, whose artillery silenced the Grey Feather Tower Sages.
item.properties|f.angelic_helm: A beautiful helm made to resemble a heavenly guardian.
pvp.properties|m.love_unapprove_confirm: Are you sure? You will be able to make changes again, but the approval process will be started over.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: I'm not ready to choose yet.
item.properties|f.furious_fork: A good chef knows when to flip burgers. A great chef cooks burgers while they flip them.
item.properties|f.brute_core: An oozing blue lump from a particularly potent gelatinous opponent.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_f: I keep a sword around for close encounters.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2c: All battle sprites wear a mechanical harness that aligns their skills to a damage type. Not all sprites can wear all harnesses though. For example, a drakon cannot output piercing damage. \n\nBy default, you have an iron harness that any sprite can equip. If you want to branch out as you likely do with your weapons and gear, you need to purchase new harnesses.
conversation.properties|m.rc_rhendon_1a: What the heck do you think this thing is, {0}?  Must be important if that Razwog guy got so bent out of shape when you snatched it. \n\nServes him right for trying to kill you and all\!
item.properties|f.furni_pet_companion_cu: A sociable slime with uncontainable curiosity. (Limit 1 per hall).
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_d: Between the warmth of the fire and the safety of the defensive turrets, I think I'll sleep well tonight.
item.properties|f.ice_axe: A technical climbing tool that can pick apart monsters with precision.
mission.properties|b.oilers_in_boilers:
A boiler room beneath Moorcroft Manor has been overrun by a legion of oily slimes known as 'oilers' that seem to enjoy fiery conditions.  This could prove disastrous for any levels in close proximity should the slimes enter the boilers and cause an explosion. 

Moorcroft Manor serves as an invaluable connection point into Tier 2 and its departed residents have been the most gracious of hosts.  It is in Spiral HQ's best interest to send a squad in to deal with the smoldering slimes before they create a firestorm that seals off our access to Tier 2. 

It is up to you to locate the oilers and remove them from the boilers\!
help.properties|m.energy_1: Energy is used to purchase items from the Supply Depot such as weapons, gear, orbs of alchemy, sparks of life, and fire crystals. \n\nTo purchase or trade for energy, simply open the Supply Depot and click the 'Get Energy' button.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_4_1: {0}\!  I can hardly believe you managed to confront the Warmaster head on and come out of that inferno alive\!  You've got the makings of a true hero\!
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Firepower will only get you so far, {0}.  Case in point, the gremlins are no doubt strong on their own, what with just sheer numbers and all, but these little, furry geniuses sought to also bolster their strength by creating an army of constructs.
item.properties|f.token_candy: A piece of candy made to celebrate the Dark Harvest Festival.  It can be exchanged in the Haven Town Square for various costume masks.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_9a: Why yes, given their outward appearance I think 'maskeraith' suits them nicely\!
mission.properties|o.in_cold_blood: Prevent the lost squad from becoming dinner to a lounge of lethal lizards
item.properties|d.furni_lay: USE\: Have a quick lie down.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Get inside, use the elevator...blow up whatever is controlling those cannons\!
guild.properties|e.leave_current_first: You must leave your current guild before accepting this invitation.
item.properties|f.celestial_nav_helm: A special helm built to commemorate Isoran spacefarers of old.  With this equipped, you can see a clear path across the night sky to countless worlds beyond.
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight6_1a: We're not taking any chances with this artifact you found, {0}. One day the gremlins might be back for it.  Be on your guard\!
chat.properties|m.usage_wink: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nWink at your fellow players.
craft.properties|e.no_accessory: There is no accessory of this type on this item.
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_2a: Well then you'll need one of these\!  It's a Proto Bomb and it's good for making things go boom\! \n\nI had an extra one in my pod so consider it an advance reward for saving all our hides here.
mission.properties|b.frostifur_fandango: Spiral HQ is receiving numerous reports of squads being wiped out by a pack of wolvers known as 'the Snowclaw Pack' near depth 10.  These ferocious frostifurs have an icy bite and are very territorial. Due to their relentless attacks, Spiral HQ is requesting an experienced squad infiltrate their den and destroy them to prevent any further casualties. \n\nIt is advised that you prepare yourself with piercing damage and freeze resistant gear before deploying.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_8a: Parma was the youngest of the bunch, a very talented Recon, but with little combat experience.  She and I went to academy together and I can remember the day when the simulator technicians had thought their program was busted due to Parma's performance.  She actually apologized\! \n\nBut still, I'm worried about her.  From the reports that I've read, the Clockworks are unlike anything we've ever encountered.  I only hope that as she keeps them informed of what's ahead, that they will watch her back.
item.properties|f.auto_turret_kit: Deploys an auto turret that fires at nearby hostiles
item.properties|f.deadly_virulisk_mask: A Virulisk Mask upgraded with an advanced toxin filter. It always smells like artificial pine needles on the inside.
item.properties|f.bombastic_demo_suit: A fine set of armor specially forged for those select few individuals who can handle explosives with panache and flair... while managing to avoid blowing themselves up.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_3_3b: I'm sorry {0}, but you currently do not meet the necessary requirements. Please speak to me again when you are currently equipped with a 4 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
conversation.properties|m.casino_yesman_: Welcome to the High Wobbler Lounge\!
conversation.properties|r.tut_intro2_2a: Roger that, Rhendon.  I'm heading your way\!
item.properties|f.frost_sword: This sword is as cold as ice, and it's willing to sacrifice your love, in addition to any monsters that happen to get in your way.
helptips.properties|m.battle_arena_2: Victory is yours\! But will these warriors leave this hallowed hall of glorious combat and be forgotten, or continue on against even more terrifying foes in hopes of reaping the rewards of the Arena King?
item.properties|f.boosted_plate_mail: A suit of Spiral Plate Mail with a supercharged internal power source. The upgrade didn't make the armor any lighter.
item.properties|f.sentinel_helm: A helm imbued with the power to repel the various afflictions that knights might encounter in the line of duty.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_7: Once you're ready to transmute the item, click 'Transmute' and hold your breath\!
dungeon.properties|m.goahead_title: Go on ahead of your party?
mission.properties|b.welcome_to_haven: Having survived the journey to Haven you must contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink and give her your report.  She has information as to what to do next as well as special instructions on the use of energy.
item.properties|f.spiral_round_helm: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.moonstone: A fabled mineral of a brilliant, blue color said to contain the knowledge and origins of all worlds.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_start_2: So here's the thing... I was tasked with baking cakes for the big Spiral Knights Anniversary Celebration and I may have got in a tiny bit over my head when I said I could bake a couple million of them in just a week. \n\nTo speed up the process I may have used a teensy weensy bit of pure, unrefined, dark matter instead of baking powder...
item.properties|f.cobalt_armor: High-performance armor of the Spiral Order suitable for any adventure.
conversation.properties|m.seerus_1: Is it power you seek? The fury of a burning star bound in steel? I will show you both\!
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_1: This is Wegner, Chief Geo Knight of the Skylark. I'm picking up a high concentration of mineral deposits in your area.
chat.properties|m.usage_hoh: Go to the Hall of Heroes
projectx.properties|m.antialiasing_note: This setting will take effect when the game is restarted.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_gremlin: Steal the gremlin schematics from the gremlin construction site\!
item.properties|f.exp_east_1f: An expansion that adds two rooms to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.ascended_calibur: Made of a rare alloy of sun silver, knights talented enough to possess Caliburs as fine as this one typically bond with and name their blades.
mission.properties|o.eye_of_needle: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
projectx.properties|m.reboot_msg_timedow: The game will be unavailable for {0} during maintenance.
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_mon_3: they are waiting to ambush you ahead
social.properties|m.autofriend_multiple_: Your friend list is already full\! You were unable to friend these {0} friends at this time\:\n{1}\n{2}
mission.properties|r.alchemy_mastery_1a: I could always use a good sword.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: So, you have chosen the shadowy maskeraith, battle sprite of those who wish to lurk in the shadows and strike the enemy with sneak attacks? \n\nOnce you choose there is no going back\!
trade.properties|e.cart_removed.n: NOTE\: a stack (of {0}) of {1} was removed from the cart.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_bystande: We almost didn't make it out alive. One moment everything was fine and the next thing we know gremlins are bursting out of the ground\!
item.properties|f.spiral_sallet: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
logon.properties|m.server_error: A server error caused authentication to fail.
item.properties|f.deadshot_chapeau: A mythical hat for those that never miss their mark. It's rumored to have been made from cloth that was previously interred.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_weap_2: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
item.properties|f.blazebreak_shield: A reliable shield that'll keep you from getting too fired up in battle.
item.properties|f.kamarin: A low-tech sword that's less effective at cutting than it is at crushing your enemies and seeing them driven before you.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: It'll take forever to decipher this gremlin cryptography...
mission.properties|r.collector_prisoner_: Can you make it back to Haven?
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft3_r4: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
item.properties|f.armor_arms: An accessory that can be attached to the arms of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
item.properties|f.volatile_catalyzer: Removing the safety overrides from a piece of Gremlin technology is a good way to lose a limb. In this case, it probably won't be one of yours. Catalyzer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
item.properties|f.blizzbreaker_helm: A reliable helmet that'll keep you from freezing up in tense situations.
item.properties|f.mighty_great_cleaver: A custom made Sudaruska designed by Biscotti, head chef of the Skylark. Though she swears it's used just for cooking, one can't help but think more than a few monsters have met it at the chopping block as well.
helptips.properties|m.tut_charge: Hold [[?ACTION]] until fully charged and then release to attack\!
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Hang in there\!
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_9a: Where do I find accessory tickets?
item.properties|f.sacred_guerrilla_helm: A helm for those who want to bring down some beasts.
item.properties|f.spark_plug: A small, mechanical component that really gets a construct's motor running.
social.properties|e.cannot_friend_gm: You can't be friends with a Game Master. They are like stone.
item.properties|f.capsule_health: A small capsule that restores a small amount of health. An adventurer's best friend\!
mission.properties|o.mission_sprite_3: Secure a cache of battle sprites and return them to the Lab
mission.properties|m.intro_reward_presti: Select a mission card to receive a mission briefing, see the available rewards and enable options for starting the mission\!
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_fiend: Free the captured Knights from a fiendish corporate prison\!
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_s: Spikes go in. Flying razor disks of barely-understood primordial energy come hurtling out\!
item.properties|f.spiraltail_mail: A simple simian mail typically worn at parades to provide prosperity and lend luck.
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_a: We may not have power, but the least I can do is get a fire going to provide a little light tonight.
helptips.properties|m.need_key_grim_gate: The Grim Gate requires a Fiendish ID Card to activate.
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight4_1a: Recon teams have recovered some strange and remarkable things from within the Clockworks.
mission.properties|m.search_continues_3a: Perhaps.  It certainly could be when you look at it.  We'll need to study it further.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_b45a8d: Travel the entire Clockworks from depth 0 to depth 29 in a single expedition.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r6: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
helptips.properties|m.mission_trap_chamb: All drones clad in gold armor are invincible.
chat.properties|m.usage_loadout: Usage\: /{0} [loadout]\nList loadouts, or equip a named loadout.
conversation.properties|r.final_test_kni: (Tell Feron about the Rescue Camp, Razwog and the Artifact)
projectx.properties|d.achievement_169085: Defeat Lord Vanaduke in the heart of the Firestorm Citadel.
item.properties|f.prize_box_obsidian: Contains various unique and terrifying items found within the realm of the Apocrea. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_undead: The ruins of Owlite castles are dark and cursed places that are swarming with legions of undead spookats.  The worst of these, the seemingly invincible grimalkins, constantly lurk in the shadows, awaiting the moment your life-saving light is finally snuffed out. \n\nSome knights succumb to the darkness and become paralyzed with fear in these shadowy realms. The only thing that can save them are brave knights who have long lost their childhood fears of the dark and all the terrible creatures that lurk within.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_2a: And speaking of gremlins, we're starting to get an alarming number of reports of gremlins mobilizing in the Clockworks below Haven.  We don't have too many details yet, but given the relations we've had with them so far, our guess is they're preparing for an attack.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_3a: Once again the sprites have changed and this time they're really creeping me out\!
help.properties|m.clockworks_1: The Clockworks is your gateway to the planet's Core\! It's filled with a huge variety of worlds and populated with monsters and treasure beyond your imagination. Beware, however\: the deeper you go below the surface, the tougher and smarter your opponents will become\!
item.properties|f.exp_west_2f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the western side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.ticket_unbind_3: Use this ticket at the Unbinding Forge to unbind a 3 star item.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_3_2:
It was those blasted cloaking fiends\! They came from the shadows and staged an ambush.   When I get my hands on Seerus I'll... Argh\! 

(Feron slumps to one side, clearly more injured than he initially appeared) 

Blast, I'm having trouble gripping my sword...
design.properties|e.regenerating: Design Mode is regenerating. Please try again in a moment.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: That's fine, just talk to me again when you are ready to choose.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_mat_2: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
social.properties|m.not_online: There is no knight named {0} online.
exchange.properties|m.mobile_tooltip: Opens a page in your browser where you can buy Energy with your mobile phone.
social.properties|m.levels_completed: become the new Level Leader, having completed {0} levels in the past 7 days\!
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_6a: Something has happened\!  That door just popped up behind you like a trap\! \n\nDefend yourself, {0}\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_8a: Yes, quite. These sprites have adapted the power to cloak, to use the very shadows around them for subterfuge. Between that and their newfound skills in toxins and debilitations, I'd say they could be quite handy on the battlefield.
item.properties|f.frayed_fabric: The worn remains of a Clockworks denizen's duds. It could probably be recycled.
guild.properties|m.not_in_guild: Sorry, you're not presently in a guild.
conversation.properties|m.rc_greet2_3a:
Our scans have located an ancient generator below this camp.  It should be sending power to the surface, but something seems to be diverting it. 

We need you to go investigate the ancient generator and divert power back to the surface.  But you'll need to be ready- it's completely uncharted territory and teeming with monsters. 

Rhendon said he wanted to meet up with you before you take on this mission.  Why don't you see him first?
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Having smashed the most terrifying zombies to dust, escaped the cold maws of grimalkins and stood victorious in battle against an army of trojans, you have no doubt collected samples from these encounters that would be of great use to Spiral HQ's research teams.
item.properties|f.rocket_hammer_1: Designed by Warmaster Seerus himself, this nefarious gremlin weapon is equipped with a rocket engine that can launch the wielder forward with a powerful hammer smash.  This particular model is a prototype version.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_1a: Alright, {0}, let's get started. Looks like you and I get to go on a little sprite hunt, eh? \n\nI've aligned my tracker with the recon knight intel but something's not right. The energy signature I'm detecting is erratic, but still definitely a battle sprite. They may be in trouble, so let's hurry\!
helptips.properties|m.danger_module: Warning\! The path beyond this point is far more dangerous than what you would expect on this level. By entering you will not be able to turn back until you complete the challenges within.\n\nHowever, should you manage to come out victorious you will be rewarded for your bravery. Enter at your own risk\!
item.properties|f.teddy_bear_buckler: A high-tech energy shield disguised as a harmless teddy bear. The perfect companion to defend against minions of the night.
conversation.properties|m.casino_jelly_c: One day I'll win enough to build my own palace\! Glorp glorp\!
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_hood: A crudely hewn hood made to resemble a temperamental warrior of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
logon.properties|m.peer_shutdown: The peer to which we connected is shutting down. Please wait a moment before trying again.
item.properties|f.polar_night_wolf_hood: A warm hood, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. The thick fur is needed during their never ending night patrols.
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Biotech Hahn for research.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_2: I've heard Spiral HQ has lined up for you some missions befitting a true Champion.  But in order to become one, you'll need the right gear. \n\nI am entrusting you with the tools you will need to become such a Champion.  With these recipes, you can craft the highest caliber of gear of the Spiral Order.  With it you can finally wear the armor of the Azure Guardian, wield the might of the Leviathan Blade, and face anything in the protection of the Aegis.
uplink.properties|m.generic_change: Something changed and we had to change things. Please accept this attachment as a replacement. Sorry for the inconvenience.
item.properties|f.furni_chair_spiralfiel: One standard-issue Spiral Order seating unit, capable of providing standard-issue comfort for one Spiral Knight.
projectx.properties|m.logoff_required: This change will cause you to log off and reconnect.
item.properties|f.shining_ward: A sacred shield that protects the user from evil.
conversation.properties|m.atg_guard: Greetings\!  Beyond this door you will find the advanced training hall. As a Spiral Knight, you are free to use it to practice your skills and learn more about the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.magma_driver: Spitting gobs of molten death at an alarming rate, this sublime sidearm is not recommended for use around (or on) anyone (or anything) that you happen to care deeply about.
support.properties|m.option_1_1: 2. If {0} has been offensive or harassing and has not stopped when asked, click here to file a complaint.
helptips.properties|m.energy: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to spend energy on this device.
auction.properties|m.search_ready: Press 'Search' to execute your current search query.
mission.properties|b.abandoned_depot: The Knights stationed in the Rescue Camp have converted a derelict facility below the surface of Cradle into a training facility to help teach new recruits the basics of survival within the Clockworks.  Beware\! As part of the Clockworks it is likely to be inhabited by all manners of monsters.  Stay alert\!
sprites.properties|d.cover: Increases the size and duration of the angelic aura.
mission.properties|m.legion_almire_2a:
An excerpt from the accounts of Lord Brandell, High Chancellor of Almire\: 

Like so many of its people, Law and Order have fled Almire.  Only Justice remains, but she too has been twisted by the cursed flames that ravage our kingdom.  Justice is now the burning scepter of our once great Lord Vanaduke.  Justice is swift, unflinching, merciless. 

My position has afforded me much in my life.  I used to love the view that my tower offers. From these lofty heights I thought of myself as the first one to greet the spring season, the first to smell the life in the air as the flowers bloomed.
mission.properties|b.guardians_of_cradle: You have been invited to attend a meeting with several members of Spiral HQ to discuss what to do next about the Core and the threat of the Swarm. Join them in the Hall of Heroes to learn about Operations Missions.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_stri: Greetings {0}, I'm Echo, a knight who utilizes gear fit for a squad striker.  The recipes I have for you produce weapons and gear that focus on rapid, close-quarters combat. \n\nThe arsenal of a striker focuses on speed.  You want to get in close with your enemy, hit them hard and get out.  The gear I specialize in will make you a knight that leaps into battle ahead of your squad, striking first before they can even fire off a shot.
conversation.properties|r.dark_harvest_e: Sounds like fun\!  I'm off to find the Punkin King\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_disguise: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Disguise style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.raging_champion_helm: The helm of one who defied the gods and razed the gates of a heavenly kingdom.
dungeon.properties|i.difficulty_medium: Advanced difficulty features an increased challenge for players who have a thorough grasp of combat. Monsters can deal and receive more damage and traps are more dangerous. Heat, crown, loot payouts and chances for rarities are increased.
item.properties|f.stranger_cap: A hat once worn by one of the enigmatic Strangers.  Local Snipes seem to be drawn to the wearer.
mission.properties|m.built_to_destroy_2a:
Crimson Order Directives\: 

- It is the DUTY of every Gremlin to repel the metal intruders\! 

- Every Gremlin must work to destroy Haven. Cradle belongs us\! 

- Every Gremlin must remain LOYAL to King Tinkinzar and the Crimson Order. The Iron Law must be obeyed\!
item.properties|f.metal_sonic_mask: A sinister looking mask crafted by a mechanical genius whose ability is said to rival that of even the greatest gremlin Gear Sages.
helptips.properties|m.atg_eblocks: EXPLOSIVE BLOCKS will cause damage to anything around them if hit.
item.properties|f.overcharged_mixmaster: An industrial strength handheld mixer that is sure to stir things up.
mission.properties|b.choose_your_sprite: Morlin has prepared three of the battle sprites you rescued for you to evaluate. You have been authorized to choose one of these battle sprites and become bonded with it. This battle sprite will forever aid you in your future adventures, so choose wisely. \n\nThis mission cannot be repeated.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Reinforcements from Spiral HQ at last\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_onwatch_a: I can't talk right now. I'm on watch.
item.properties|f.officer_door: Installs a force barrier at the entrance of the room that can only be passed by guild members of Officer rank and up.
item.properties|f.pierce_blaster: An enhanced blaster modified to fire piercing rounds.
social.properties|m.befriend_message_nam: Enter an optional message to {0} with your friend request\:
chat.properties|m.usage_come: Usage\: /{0}\nTell your comrades to come to you.
sprites.properties|d.ray_of_light: Fires a concentrated beam of light that damages anything passing through it.
mission.properties|r.alchemy_beginners_9: Let's go over it all one more time.
item.properties|f.blight_needle: It's a proven fact that even the most virulent of toxins is a lot more contagious if it's fired indiscriminately over a large area.
item.properties|l.needs_sprite: Requires completion of Rank 2-3 Mission, 'An Eternal Bond' to use this item.
chat.properties|m.usage_zgo: Usage\: /{0} zone name\nMoves to the named zone.
conversation.properties|m.npc_survivorkn: They... They got everyone except me. I just hid in the corner.
item.properties|f.obsidian_obstacle: A baleful shield of obelisk fragments bound by Apocrean ritual. Every time the fragments align, dark memories echo in your mind.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_vials_1: Vials are one type of pickup. When thrown they release the alchemical agents within creating an elemental explosion. You can give them a try in the next room.
item.properties|f.icebreaker_armor: Upgraded Frostbreaker Armor further hacked to resist freeze.
conversation.properties|m.mission_crimso: That's just it {0}, nothing. We've been monitoring the base below for weeks then it went silent. Quite suddenly. We're not sure what you're going to find down there. Our sensors show no active life forms.
item.properties|f.shade_armor: A suit of armor infused with dark matter that allows its wearer to shoot straight and surprise foes from the shadows.
item.properties|f.prize_box_rose_regalia: Contains various unique Rose Regalia costumes and accessories. Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.heavy_demo_suit: Reinforced armor intended for explosive experts.
item.properties|f.owlite_feather: A small feather plucked from an Owlite, said to be a mythical race of great magician birds.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_4a: The Apocrea bend reality, twisting the environment they invade into a trap. In these traps they stalk any life, harvesting their souls for some unimaginable purpose.
item.properties|f.mercurial_demo_suit: A demo suit made from gremlin technology. It is for the bomber that wants a boost of speed, more power and a greatly reduced chance of dying by electrocution... which is probably every bomber out there.
item.properties|f.mighty_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it, you can feel the berserk energies within just waiting to be unleashed.
mission.properties|b.search_continues: Lieutenant Vaelyn would like to thank you for opening up a path to the Core and allowing her to set up an on-site research base.
item.properties|f.rogue_lite: Be a guiding light or a glowing spark, charging forward to leave your mark. Universally venerated, procedurally re-generated, you'll never be lost in the dark.
mission.properties|m.alone_in_dark_1a:
(You see the lost soul of Almire standing before you.  In his face you see a profound sadness.  Staring beyond you he begins to speak without introduction.) 

Lord Vanaduke brought the fire from the mountains to our kingdom.  Everything burned.  His enemies.  Even his family. 

My family was lost too.  I fled the battle as soon as I saw the wave of flames in the distance.  I was able to reach my home just in time to see it burn.  I don't even remember how it ended.  I have no memory of my passing.
pvp.properties|m.cancelled: All pending coliseum games were cancelled. Please sign up again.
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_s: Well, that's why I'm not just telling everybody back at Haven about it. This little puppy may be a little too peppy for your average knight, especially when those razor disks come flying back at you\!\n\nBut I figured you'd probably get a kick out of it\!
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_5: Minerals are used to create sprite food in the Laboratory. Sprite food is very important to the development of your sprite, so grab those minerals when you see them\!
item.properties|f.feral_shell: A shield alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. Even the sharpest wolver claws merely glance off this compact carapace.
item.properties|f.dangerous_oni_helm: A helm worn by members of the Recon Rangers. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of a fiend who lives in the mountains of a distant land. Said to guard the gate to heaven itself, it only allows those who are worthy to pass.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: Out, out, oooout\! Too many cooks in the kitchen\! Too many cooks in the kitchen\!
item.properties|f.dim_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within flickers like a tiny candle.
projectx.properties|m.confirm_return: Are you sure you want to return to {0}?
item.properties|f.magister_robe: A ceremonial robe worn by learned masters of the arcane arts, who often leave their keys in one of the many inner pockets.
conversation.properties|m.almire_histori: We've recovered what little remains from Owlite Keep concerning the Kingdom of Almire. Combined with the snippets we've gotten from the nature sprites within Firestorm Citadel itself, we are starting to get a clearer picture of Almire's history.
town.properties|m.haven_desc: A peaceful town that is home to the Strangers. These salvagers offer the Spiral Knights sanctuary in return for the treasures that they acquire while investigating the Clockworks. Haven is also heavily populated with snipes, bulbous little birds with a curious means of locomotion.
item.properties|f.dangerous_hound_coat: A battle-ravaged coat worn by the squad leaders of the Recon Rangers, nicknamed 'hounds.' The name was likely coined due to their incredible tracking abilities or perhaps the fact that they fight like wild dogs in battle.
item.properties|f.miracloth: A marvelous bolt of sublimely supple fabric.
item.properties|f.gremlin_gizmo: A strange device used in gremlin machinery. It is inscribed with a warning against exposing it to direct sunlight or submerging it in water.
item.properties|f.toxic_needle: An Autogun modified to fire piercing bolts dosed with a wicked poison.
social.properties|m.confirm_unfriend: Are you sure you no longer want to be friends with {0}?
auction.properties|e.bid_insufficient: You must bid at least {0} crowns.
item.properties|f.twisted_targe: A tulgey targe that will give your sword thrusts some teeth.
mission.properties|o.ancient_generator: Explore the Ancient Generator and restore power to the Rescue Camp before night falls\!
item.properties|f.heavy_gear: A weighted gear that previously assisted in the operation of an enormous machine.
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r9: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
item.properties|f.vial_shock: A glass vial containing hyper-charged electric fluids. It can be used to inflict enemies with Shock.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and give your foes a real ZAP\!
mission.properties|b.elemental_my_dear: Biotech Hahn has agreed to inform you about the monsters in the Clockworks that inflict elemental damage.  Contact him via comlink and hear what he has to say.
item.properties|f.almirian_crusader_helm: A helm once worn by the elite royal guard of the kingdom of Almire. Its ivory color was a symbol of Almire's purity, both in the land and in the hearts of its people.
conversation.properties|m.rc_instruct_3a: The Clockworks are the massive complex of gears and machinery that lies just below the surface of this whole world. It's truly an incredible sight. It is a strange and dangerous world in which we have found ourselves. Tread carefully.
item.properties|f.stoic_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it, you sense the quiet passing of the wind and can call upon the rumbling storm that follows.
helptips.properties|m.party_button: The party button will activate when all living party members are standing on it.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro2_2a: You just hit the surface of Cradle.  My escape pod crashed just north of your position.  We should meet up and find the nearest rally point. \n\nBe careful and ready your sword, there are hostile creatures everywhere\!
uplink.properties|m.title: SPIRAL UPLINK
item.properties|f.heavy_shard_bomb: A solid chunk of depleted Crimsonite with an explosive surprise inside. Everybody loves surprises\!
pvp.properties|m.playagain_team.n: {0} more guildmates are needed for a {1} team.
exchange.properties|e.already_tx: Please wait, a request is still being processed...
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_2d: Actually, I have to run. Maybe some other time...
mission.properties|r.explosive_plot_3a: It's because the Strangers took us in that they're now targeted...
projectx.properties|d.achievement_99c5a1: Travel the entire Clockworks from depth 0 to depth 29 in a single expedition without having to revive.
chat.properties|m.usage_zone: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message on the zone channel.
conversation.properties|m.hav_clock_3c: Something of immense power, little one. There is an enormous energy signal coming from the center of the Clockworks, but that is all we know. No one has ever made it to the core. Or at least if anyone has, they have never returned.\n\nThe ones to ask would be the gremlins, for they have likely gone deeper into the Clockworks than any creature. But that might prove difficult as they are quite a disagreeable lot.
mission.properties|r.target_acquired_3a: I'll be sure to get my hands on the appropriate gear for the job.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_cj_keyboar: Keyboard used for targeting, attacking, movement, advanced commands,
dungeon.properties|m.scarlet_fortress_de: Named for its vibrant tapestries, the Scarlet Fortress is a deconstructed mass of a forgotten castle, drifting endlessly in the void of the Clockworks. Strange bestial ghosts haunt its long corridors, tirelessly pursuing those that enter their domain.
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_4a: Accept my mission and let's get to work blowing some stuff up\!
item.properties|f.cryotech_alchemer_mkii: An upgraded Alchemer that fires bolts of extremely low temperature material at an increased rate.
sprites.properties|d.meteoric_firebol: Increases the size of the firebolt's explosion.
item.properties|f.shade_helm: A dark matter infused helm that allows its wearer to get the drop on foes by shooting straight from the shadows.
item.properties|f.static_capacitor: An explosive device of Gremlin origin designed to produce a deadly field of electricity.
item.properties|f.silver_solstice_ring: An enchanted ring that embodies the spirit of the solstice. Its sparkling silver luster shines brightest during the winter months.
chat.properties|m.usage_cheer: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nCheer for your fellow players\!
item.properties|f.dark_matter_deposit_4: A mother lode of metalliferous minerals that will generate a jackpot of dark matter.
item.properties|f.super_food: Feed this to your sprite to fill their heat to max\!
item.properties|f.ignition_helm: A lightweight helmet augmented to keep a knight's head cool under pressure.
item.properties|f.holiday_hat: A festive cap that carries with it the warm spirit of the holidays. It smells faintly of gingerbread.
item.properties|f.crown_fallen: A cursed crown once worn by a celestial being cast down from paradise.
item.properties|f.obsidian_hood_of_devot: 'Wrap thy self in my embrace and succumb to my infinite love. Let your breath drift from you like candle smoke, dreaming deeper and deeper still.'
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_6a: Once again these sprites seem to have adapted their form to suit their surrounding environment.
mission.properties|m.intro_rank: Rank Missions are the main campaign of Spiral Knights. Completing Rank Missions earns you rewards and allows you to achieve higher ranks as a Spiral Knight.
mission.properties|b.return_of_ur: A Recon squad has reported that deep within a fiendish city, devilites are attempting to summon a legion of powerful trojan warriors.  Based on intel from a devilite internal memo, the trojans are known as the 'Legion of Ur,' and are said to have once numbered in the thousands.  Strangely, the memo indicated that the Legion of Ur was sealed away in the Underworld and that an alternative approach would be required for bringing them back. \n\nWhatever means the devilites intend to use to bring a few thousand trojans into the Clockworks, they must be stopped.  Infiltrate their city and stop the fiendish army before they become unstoppable\!
guild.properties|m.too_many_members: Your guild cannot have more than {0} members. \nUpgrades to your member limit may be purchased in the shop in your guild hall.
item.properties|f.haze_burst: A powerful alchemical bomb that produces a dense cloud of intensely disorienting material.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_11: Brinks is the Token Trader, issuing certain items to Knights in exchange for tokens that can be collected within the Clockworks.  Tokens can be found in treasure blocks, issued as mission rewards or found when defeating special boss monsters.
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_6: Our geological research is ongoing, so there may yet be other fascinating uses for these strange and powerful minerals.
mission.properties|b.heart_of_matter: Lieutenant Vaelyn led the first squad into the Clockworks that attempted to located the Alpha Squad.  She is a talented squad leader thought to be on par with Euclid himself.  Vaelyn has never given up her search and is now attempting to put together an on-site Core research team in order to better understand the very place where the Alpha Squad's trail is thought to end.
item.properties|f.heavenly_iron_helm: A powerful helm said to be crafted from angelic shields.  It retains many divine properties celestial beings possess but lacks their weakness to fire.
item.properties|f.frost_gel: A drop of chilly gunk collected from a cool Clockworks customer.
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_skbedrol: A soft sleeping bag perfect for whenever you're "roughing it". For a Spiral Knight stranded on Cradle, this is most of the time.
helptips.properties|m.atg_pots: Some objects like pots can be thrown at switches AND enemies\!
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_r6: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r7: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
item.properties|f.spiral_brigandine: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
mission.properties|b.becoming_champion: Having heard of your many accomplishments and successful missions completed for Spiral HQ, Lieutenant Feron would like to speak with you.
item.properties|f.slicer: Energy spikes go in. Flying razor disks of barely-understood primordial energy come hurtling out\!  And look out for that extra-peppy boomerang effect...
item.properties|f.volcanic_plate_shield: A superior shield imbued with the elemental essence of flame. It is so resistant to high temperatures that it's a mystery how exactly it was forged in the first place.
item.properties|f.red_shard: A shard of Crimsonite that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
item.properties|f.prize_box_rage: Contains various unique costumes and accessories crafted from thunder and lightning. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|m.shocking_sentient_s: It looks like time has run out, Sputterspark.  You'd better hope your little toy works.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_1_7a: Cradle is growing more mysterious by the day.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_button: If a door won't open, search under blocks for a hidden floor button to open it.
item.properties|f.ancient_plate_shield: An antique shield whose origins have been lost to the passing of time.
item.properties|f.shadow_driver: A high-tech alchemical sidearm that fires powerful shadow bullets that split multiple times on impact.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_3a: {0}, it is my great honor, in the company of all those who support you and whom you serve, to award you the high rank of Vanguard of the Spiral Knights.
item.properties|f.rock_jelly_mail: This gelatinous gear combines the sturdiness of stone with the piercing protection of sticky goo. It's a wonder that you managed to beat up the jelly this is made out of.
item.properties|f.slime_key: A slippery key that can only open a Slime Lockbox.  Once used, the key is destroyed.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_11a: Right, down to business.  We've located an Alpha Squad recon module in an area of the Clockworks known as the 'Gloaming Wildwoods.'  However, this particular zone is home to a horrible creature known as 'the Snarbolax.' \n\nThe Snarbolax has made fast work of Squires like yourself, but I know you can handle it, {0}. But you're going to need to prepare.  I've issued you a series of missions that will allow you to assemble a loadout fit for taking on this terrible beast and reclaiming that recon module\!
helptips.properties|m.tut_switches: Doors can often be opened by finding the right switch nearby. Have a look around. They are sometimes hidden under blocks.
mission.properties|b.sewer_stash: It seems that the Ironclaw Munitions Factory is not the only place gremlins are storing high-powered weaponry.  Intel suggests that once manufactured, weapons are moved out of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory and stored in secret weapon caches throughout the Clockworks. \n\nOne of these caches has been uncovered in one of the Clockwork's wasteworks systems.  It's likely not going to be pretty reaching it, but eliminating the weapons stored in these wasteworks could result in far fewer casualties in the future.
item.properties|f.frenzy_rider_mantle: A legendary suit of armor thought to be worn by a god who used frenzy to carve whole worlds from stone.
mission.properties|b.the_flickering_flam: After your victory in Firestorm Citadel, the nature sprites of the great Spirit Mother finally began to make headway in battling the cursed flames engulfing the charred remains of Almire. A recent flare-up has impeded that progress, hinting at some lingering malevolent force that continues to fuel the fires. Contact Intel Agent Kora for details.
chat.properties|m.away_set: Auto-response message set. Use /back to turn it off.
mission.properties|b.first_mission: Are you a dev? Do you enjoy enjoying things? Can you read? Let this mission be an example to you.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_pickups: Pickups are items that are slotted into your belt seen at the top of the screen. They cannot leave the Clockworks and will turn to dust as soon as you return to town. Think of them as powerups and bonus items to use as you please.
item.properties|f.furni_candles_small: A scattering of small candles that adds a bit of classic ambiance to any room.
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_11a: I'd like you to give me the tour once more.
mission.properties|r.creators_and_create: So all constructs in the Clockworks were created by the gremlins?
dungeon.properties|m.cogmaster_castle_de: Calling all knights\!  Spiral HQ has launched a full-scale assault on the heavily fortified castle of Warmaster Seerus, a devious gremlin of the Crimson Order. All attacks against the sturdy walls and destructive artillery have failed - Spiral HQ needs YOU to turn the tide of the battle and take the fight to the Warmaster himself\!
item.properties|f.trojan_helm: A helm of the stalwart Spiral Wardens that is said to give great comfort to other knights.  Nothing says 'here comes the cavalry' like the sight of these iron giants taking to the battlefield.
item.properties|f.training_room: A simple room providing access to a private guild training hall, perfect for learning new skills or keeping old ones current.
projectx.properties|e.need_higher_rank: Must be Rank {0} to level up\!
mission.properties|o.king_of_ashes: Defeat Lord Vanaduke in the Firestorm Citadel and reach the Core
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_2a: You, curious traveler, stand in the Obsidian Nexus, realm of the Apocrea. You will likely never see the sun again.
item.properties|f.ultra_freeze_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly icy orbs that can freeze hostiles in their tracks
helptips.properties|m.loading1: The Clockworks below the surface cycle levels in real time. You will never see all the levels a world has to offer in a single trip. Only a true adventurer will discover all the secrets\!
mission.properties|o.p_r4_mat_1: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_spec: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
mission.properties|m.time_enough_at_last: Ah yes, my squad.  A good bunch... strong and determined.  I'm not sure I really fit in to be honest, was always more of a reader\!  They should be fine without me I would imagine.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_8a: Yes, it seems that these sprites have mastered the ability to focus their powers on skills that protect their knight. Given that and their appearance I've dubbed them 'seraphynx.'
sprites.properties|d.heart_attack: Enchants a group of targets. If enchanted target is destroyed, it has a chance of dropping extra restorative hearts.
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_5: Minerals are used to create sprite food in the Laboratory. Sprite food is very important to the development of your sprite, so grab those minerals when you see them\!
conversation.properties|r.energy_info_1b: No thanks, I'm content not knowing about such an amazing thing.
item.properties|m.prize_box_rose_regalia: Rose Regalia Returns Again Prize Box
mission.properties|m.anniversary_start_3: In any case it would seem that this new 'recipe' caused the cakes to turn into horrible monsters that have overtaken my kitchen and infested the Clockworks.  I'd like to have my kitchen back, so could you please assist me in destroying these horrible Creep Cakes?
item.properties|f.prize_box_blooming: Contains various unique costumes and accesories to celebrate the blooming nature of spring.  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
projectx.properties|m.equipmentlocked: EQUIPMENT LOCKED\: Equipment can be changed in towns or at Arsenal Stations.
guildhelp.properties|m.emporium_info:
The Birdsong Emporium allows high-ranking guild members to purchase items for the guild using funds from the Guild Treasury. These items include various Guild Hall furniture items and upgrades. Purchased items go directly into the Guild Treasury, and thus cannot ever be removed from the guild.
 Furniture comes in a variety of types and sizes and is used to decorate your Guild Hall's rooms and halls to make them feel more like home. Some furniture even has special effects when activated\! Any furniture currently in your Guild Treasury can be placed into the Guild Hall using Design Mode.
 The Birdsong Emporium is also where you purchase Guild Upgrades that enhance your guild's capabilities, such as by increasing its maximum member count.
 As a Guild Hall's size increases by adding expansions, the selection of items available in the Birdsong Emporium's catalog also increases. Be sure to check back often to see what's available\!
item.properties|f.static_clinger: A latent strand of energy that floats throughout the Clockworks, frequently catching on hair and clothing. It's too large to properly distill into Energy, but it's very useful in alchemy.
conversation.properties|r.biscotti_2: Again, this is really weird Biscotti, but I'll do my best.
item.properties|m.use_recipe:
Use this item to add the {0} to your Known Recipes list? 

Items can be created at Alchemy Stations.
(You may view your learned recipes at any time by pressing <{1}>.)
item.properties|f.spur: A mechanized sword with a built in motor that generates energy bursts when used.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_weap_2: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
mission.properties|o.laboratory_visit: Visit the Lab and meet with Biotech Morlin
item.properties|f.radiant_silvermail: An upgraded set of Silvermail that is said to shine brightly even in the darkest of hours.
item.properties|f.magic_hood: An enchanting hood for knights who dabble in divination and contemplate conjuring.
conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_5: You have proven that you are combat ready and I have faith that you will serve the Spiral Order courageously. The gates into the Clockworks are just up ahead. \n\nGood luck to you\!
item.properties|f.vial_shock_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing hyper-charged electric fluids. It can be used to inflict enemies with Shock.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and give your foes a real ZAP\!
item.properties|f.wrapping_paper: Wrap an item in this decorative gift box and add a personalized message.
conversation.properties|m.npc_mineraltec: I'm a field researcher working under Chief Geo Knight Wegner.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_end: Great job\! With another successful run through the Training Grounds you should be getting the hang of things by now. It won't be long before you are exploring the depths of the Clockworks on your own.
pvp.properties|m.bribe_reward_subject: King Krogmo reward earned in the Coliseum.
social.properties|m.friend_party_full: Oops\! {0}'s party is no longer accepting new members.
item.properties|f.the_bitter_end: A shield carried by all members of the Recon Rangers. Its name is a reminder to all Rangers as to precisely when they are permitted to drop it in battle.
board.properties|i.joinparty: Join a party already in progress.
exchange.properties|m.opening_billing: Opening Energy Depot web site in your browser...
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_coba: Well met, {0}.  I'm Jorin, a knight who has mastered the standard issue Spiral Knight gear.  The recipes I have for you produce very reliable weapons and gear. \n\nJust because your weapons don't output fancy special damage types or your armor defends from status conditions doesn't mean you can't shake it in the Clockworks.  The gear I specialize in is good for just about any situation.  It will keep you alive and packs a punch on almost any monster that comes your way.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_1_2: Our advance has ground to a halt because of that artillery on the walls pinning us down.  Earlier, we staged a diversion to allow a small squad of knights to break through the front to silence that artillery...but they seem to have failed.  Now they're trapped in there, and we're stuck out here\! \n\nI need you to break through the front lines, get inside the artillery control center, and find a way to take out those cannons for good\!  Meanwhile, I'll get the troops reorganized so we can follow up your assault.  Good luck in there, soldier\!
item.properties|f.groundbreaker_armor: A suit of armor worn by knights who were among the first to brave the depths of the Clockworks.
mission.properties|o.securing_camp_b: Help Rhendon destroy the monsters that invaded the Rescue Camp\!
conversation.properties|r.moorcroft_arch: I'll help any way I can, Pembrooke.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest2_r7: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
conversation.properties|t.af_chat_fiend_: And I was having such a nice nap.
item.properties|f.ghost_bell: A small, silvery bell worn by considerate ghosts that alerts the living when they are close by.
item.properties|f.furni_beacon_floor_gre: A Spiral-issued light source typically used at checkpoints.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_7a: (You sense great pride coming from the fallen knight, but he says no more and stares off into the distance towards a lifetime that only he sees.)
helptips.properties|m.test_lobby: Welcome testers\! Before you head off into the Clockworks, feel free to help yourself to some wonderful stuff from the merchant to the left. \nThe embers to the far right will level up weapons once your collect enough of them and proceed to the next floor. \nGood luck, brave knights\!
mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r3: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
item.properties|f.hunters_lodge_room: A monster hunting lodge curated by the great hunter, Armero. Contains a guild alchemy machine containing monster trophy recipes. Guild alchemy machines use resources from the Guild Treasury and deposit results into the Guild Treasury.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_c: I always carry a blaster, never know when it might come in handy.
item.properties|f.spell_book: An old dictionary that seems to have quite a few spells within it.
mission.properties|m.tortodrone_1a:
[All] Important Employee Reminder\: 

An ID Card is required to access the staging area. Properly presenting the ID Card will consume it to power the Grim Gate. Remember\: "When you Use it, you Lose it." 

ID Cards not used in this manner ("lost, broken, or misplaced") will need to be reissued by HR. The cost for a card replacement will be deducted from your next paycheck and a black mark will be added to your employee file. Don't let this happen to you. Don't lose your ID Card. 

Cheers, 
Morgral'm 
Assistant Supervisor of Resource Allocations, Undercorp
item.properties|f.spiral_plate_helm: A heavyweight helm made of iron designed to withstand stunning impacts.
mission.properties|m.toxic_plant_2a: An official order from Herex, the Whispering Venom\: \n\nProduction of Compound 42 is to cease immediately.  While a formidable poison and no doubt useful in achieving a... 'higher' power amongst the Order, it seems to have formed an intelligence well beyond the scope of a standard bio-toxin.
item.properties|f.padded_demo_suit: An upgraded suit for bombers that is lined with soft, stimulating padding.
chat.properties|m.usage_shout: Usage\: /{0} message\nShouts a message to a wider area.
item.properties|f.vial_freeze_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing glacial wind. It can be used to inflict enemies with Freeze.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and chill your foes right in place\!
item.properties|f.shocking_edge: A light blade that can deliver a painful shock to its victims. Youthful knights enjoy waving these around on holidays.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_5a: Energy can only be obtained by purchase with a real money transaction or for trade via the Exchange. To purchase or trade for energy, simply open the Supply Depot and click the 'Get Energy' button.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_chromalisk: A timid chromalisk that seems to have lost its tongue.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_wandering_go: A festive fall snipe that will explore its surroundings.
chat.properties|m.usage_trade: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message on the trade channel.
item.properties|f.hazardous_grim_mask: A helm worn by members of the Scarlet Scouts. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of Death itself. Those that wear it have a saying, 'Death is at your heels, so keep facing forward.'
item.properties|f.nether_cannon: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a corrupted tortodrone. A tormented howl of rage can be heard on the wind when it is unleashed upon your foes.
item.properties|f.rocket_hammer_3: Designed by Warmaster Seerus himself, this nefarious gremlin weapon is equipped with a rocket engine that can launch the wielder forward with a powerful hammer smash.  This final, perfected design is truly befitting the Grand Arsenal of the great Warmaster Seerus.
item.properties|f.blazebreak_armor: A reliable set of armor adept at deflecting the most fiery of rhetoric. It's not bad at resisting flame attacks, either.
mission.properties|m.advanced_alchemy_1a: We meet again, {0}.  Spiral HQ has asked me to introduce you to some advanced alchemy.  Don't worry, this won't take long.  I've got an old mecha knight to work on anyway.
redeem.properties|e.max_redeemed: You have already redeemed the maximum number of codes for this promotion.
mission.properties|m.elig_ok_replay: You are eligible to replay this mission.
item.properties|f.raiment: A long, flowing battle garb best accessorized with a pair of angelic wings.
shop.properties|m.accessoryDepotAd: Want to recover your accessory? Buy a recover ticket\!
mission.properties|m.pioneers_5a: Euclid wasn't your typical knight.  By the time most in his division were getting their Squire crest, he had already achieved Vanguard.  As a Squad Leader, he lead a series of successful assaults against the Morai during the liberation of Isora.  A brilliant tactician, he was known for getting the job done with half the knights of other squads.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_7a: Indeed.  Though their cellular identity is still wholly that of a battle sprite.  My hypothesis is that somehow they rapidly evolved to survive in their new environment, but how?  Our technology could never do something like that...
item.properties|f.royal_jelly_mail: A viciously viscous set of armor crafted painstakingly from the most noble specimens of quivering slime.
item.properties|f.black_kat_hood: A crudely hewn hood made to resemble a shadowy sapper of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_6: Many recipes require an equip-able, leveled item.  These are called 'special items' in a recipe and you are free to select the special item you wish, provided it's the correct item. \n\nThis is useful if the recipe calls for an item that you have two copies of, but one is superior.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_3: When you acquire a recipe and use it, it consumes the recipe, but logs it in your 'known' recipes forever\!  Once it's known, you can create as many items of that recipe as you wish, so long as you have the right materials.
item.properties|f.omegaward: The pulsing elemental plates of this shield instantaneously react to adverse climates protecting you from even the most extreme cold or heat.
item.properties|f.prize_box_surge: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Surge style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
sprites.properties|d.chaotic_haze: Targets damaged by hexing haze have a chance of receiving a random status condition.
item.properties|f.deadly_shard_bomb: A large chunk of Crimsonite primed with a potent explosive. No more depleted Crimsonite here\: this bomb's made with the good stuff\! Or the bad stuff, if you happen to be the target.

mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_1a: What's this? You still have your body. Perhaps you can help us.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roar: A miniature model of one of the Roarmulus Twins. It is mercifully inactive.
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_3a: Exactly\!  So what the heck is it doing in the Clockworks now?  It just doesn't make any sense. \n\nSo, if we are to believe that indeed a lost kingdom from the past has somehow wound up in a massive, mechanical world in present day, the question remains, why?
item.properties|f.ice_queen_crown: A regal crown resembling that of the ever-frigid Ice Queen.  In addition to providing great defense, it is said to dramatically boost one's ego and create a cold detachment from those around them.
conversation.properties|m.af_hungry: I could sure go for a snack\!
mission.properties|m.name: Name
conversation.properties|m.rc_sleepy_1a: Training... so hard... just need to rest.... my eyes...
monster.properties|m.fired_2: Your productivity is down .03% this week. You're fired.
mission.properties|o.whipping_mishandlin: Deliver the supplies to the research team within the fiendish city of Sol' Fork
helptips.properties|m.tg3_final: Just one more room lies between you and the elevator out of here. Remember what you have learned so far and you'll do just fine... at least that's the theory. Try not to die, ok?
mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.
item.properties|f.schemer_scrap: A fragment of a blueprint used by gremlin schemers to construct their mechanical monstrosities. With enough of them and a little tape, you could construct a metal death machine yourself\!
mission.properties|m.pioneers_3a: When our technicians finally got the Skylark's communications systems online, we could not establish a link with the Alpha Squad and they have never been heard from since. Their channel is completely dead. \n\nTheir dead line is what has us all scratching our heads.  Our comlinks are built to withstand all manners of extreme conditions, even explosions.  Heck, they survived the Skylark going down after all.  There's nothing I can think of that could kill the link completely.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: I'm not sure, tell me again about the battle sprites.
mission.properties|r.arc_mintut_1: I'm here to learn about the minerals found within the Clockworks.
dungeon.properties|m.starlight_cradle_de: Beneath a moonlit sky azure islands drift in a sea of stars. These islands are home to creatures that are more than happy to creep upon those that succumb to this world's endless lullaby.
item.properties|f.golden_solstice_ring: An enchanted ring that embodies the spirit of the solstice. Its glittering golden luster shines brightest during the summer months.
item.properties|f.dark_matter_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in Dark Matter. Since its original discovery, Dark Matter has been put to a variety of uses, from powering Spiral technology, to rearranging Gremlins on a subatomic level.
helptips.properties|m.p_dz_schematic_hei: Unauthorized access of our schematics library detected. Security team dispatched. Lockdown commenced.
dungeon.properties|m.spirits_graveyard: Shroud of the Apocrea|The Grasping Plateau
mission.properties|o.from_below: Find and save the squad of Recon Rangers
mission.properties|o.shadow_beast: Defeat the Snarbolax in the Gloaming Wildwoods and recover the recon module
mission.properties|m.best_of_beast_2a: Yes well, let's get started then. \n\nTier 3 is closest to the Core and much like how high level items respond to its power, so do monsters.  Many of them take on new forms and are considered at their most dangerous.  You must prepare before taking on each mission.
