help.properties|m.support_2: If you're lost or having trouble, our Game Masters can help\! They can be contacted by filing a support request.
item.properties|f.wyvern_scale_shield: A spiny buckler forged from beast chitin, providing ample resistance to both heat and venom.
chat.properties|m.user_disconnected: That user has been disconnected for {0}.
item.properties|f.voltedge: Combining Spiral capacitor technology with samples recovered from the Ironclaw Munitions Factory produced this blade, which can output a particularly hazardous 1.21 gigawatt discharge.
mission.properties|m.ending_in_fire_2a: At the rate you're going you just might, {0}\!  Though based on new intel it would seem that's not going to be easy.
item.properties|f.polar_night_wolf_coat: A warm coat, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. The thick fur is needed during their never ending night patrols.
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_1: Cradle is a dangerous world and it's important to make sure you have powerful gear in your arsenal in order to survive.  To do that, you will need to use the Forge.
mission.properties|r.apocrea_1_4a: I won't let them take me so easily.
item.properties|f.pig_armor: Hog all the attention in this leather suit. Its durable protection may just save your bacon one day.
item.properties|f.armor_ankle: An accessory that can be attached to the ankle of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
social.properties|m.autofriend_single_su: Your {0} friend is playing Spiral Knights\!
item.properties|f.sacred_shade_armor: A shadowy suit of armor built to outlast whatever might slink from the shadows.
item.properties|f.beach_hat: A head-mounted personal portable lightweight shade structure.
sprites.properties|d.no_mercy: Increases the damage inflicted by hexing haze.
support.properties|m.header_step1: You are about to file a complaint against another player for the Game Masters to review.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: Guuurgle\! Such strength\! You shall be consumed and your power added to my own\!
support.properties|m.option_201_1: If you're convinced this qualified as spamming then click OK to file the complaint.
item.properties|f.graviton_vortex: A Graviton Bomb fortified with potentially dangerous amounts of shadow steel. Its blast should draw your foes toward it... if it doesn't rip the entire universe in two, that is.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_welcome: Welcome to the Training Grounds, recruit. In this derelict section of the Clockworks you'll find areas we have built in order to train you in the fine art of not dying a horrible death. So pay attention to these helpful tips, ready your weapon, and get moving\!
mission.properties|r.eye_of_needle_2a: But that tome suggested Almire was destroyed over a thousand years ago...
item.properties|f.stoic_buster: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it, you sense the quiet passing of the wind and can call upon the rumbling storm that follows.
item.properties|f.helm_brow: An accessory that can be attached to the brow of select helmets.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_min: Gather minerals for Chief Geo Knight Wegner's research.
item.properties|f.prize_box_guildhall: Contains random furnishings.  No key is required to open.
dungeon.properties|m.sleeper_sanctuary: The Sanctuary|A Calm in the Storm
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_3: You will find ore deposits in all levels of the Clockworks, and you must attack them in order to break them down into a size you can carry. You can only pick up one at a time, but you can swap them by picking up another. Look for the biggest, shiniest one you can find. They are the most valuable.
item.properties|f.flare_popper: While never intended to be used in a party, Recon Rangers like to shoot signal flares into the air to celebrate missions where everyone comes back alive. Sadly, any Ranger will tell you that far too few of them are ever sent burning into the sky.
item.properties|f.rock_jelly_helm: A tough topper tailored from jagged jelly.
item.properties|f.obsidian_obelisk: A jet-black stele of unnatural stone from the realm of the Apocrea. As you gaze upon it the stone seems to writhe and pulse with an eternal energy that is simultaneously alluring and sinister in a most grotesque manner.
conversation.properties|r.lab_biscotti_3: How do I feed my battle sprite?
item.properties|f.nodeslime_sword: This calloused carving crusher cascades fury upon fatigued foes.
item.properties|f.potocrowns: An unlucky thing for your foes to find, it explodes in a painful blow.
guild.properties|m.formation:
You may form a new guild for {0} crowns and {1} energy. The crowns will be seeded into the guild's treasury. By creating a guild you will become the Guild Master and will have the ability to invite new members into your guild. Guild features include\:

Guild Member chat channel

Guild Member rankings
Guild Member status updates
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research: By now you have likely collected a few material samples from your early expeditions into the Clockworks.  Spiral HQ is requesting some of those materials for their ongoing research of the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.celestial_saber: A special saber said to resemble Isoran spacefarers of old as they sliced across the night sky. With this equipped, your foes are sure to see stars.
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_w: Glorp\! Glorp\! Winterfest is saved and one thing is clear\: all hearts now sing with holiday cheer\!
item.properties|f.lite_infantry: Tread lightly or lavish in the limelight, those that follow will benefit from hindsight.
mission.properties|m.built_to_destroy_2b:
Transmission\: 

'They continue to advance and thwart our schemes\!  How could they have discovered Project R?  Why was there no advance warning of the attack?' 

'Herex and his minions were supposed to be spying on them but they have all vanished like cowards.' 

'To defy the Iron Law is to defy the Order\!  Track the traitor down.  Herex will answer for this setback.'
item.properties|f.savage_tortofist: A handgun alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. While wielding it you can feel the primal energy of a rampaging wolver pack within waiting to be unleashed.
mission.properties|o.p_tortodrone_r6: Investigate the Ancient Grove and put a stop to a Fiendish plot.
item.properties|f.warmaster_bomb_2: A refined version of the shadowy bomb that Warmaster Seerus engineered with the sole purpose of eliminating other gremlins that stood in his way.
item.properties|f.jalovec: A shivery sword for knights who think it'd be cool to inflict an avalanche of pain upon their foes.
item.properties|f.harlequin_suit: A costume for those who juggle, tumble, or have the gift of mischief.
item.properties|f.armor_back: An accessory that can be attached to the back of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
exchange.properties|m.trade4crowns_toolt: Click here to accept the listed trade, and buy crowns with energy.
uplink.properties|e.unvalidated: Your email address has not been validated. An email has been sent. Please follow the link in the email and once validated, return here and try again.
mission.properties|b.in_cold_blood: Something has really riled up the chromalisks in the levels below the town of Emberlight.  Spiral HQ sent a squad in to investigate and they quickly fell off the radar. Now they've sent out a distress signal stating that they're cornered at depth 21 by chromalisks of all varieties. \n\nBiotechs speculate these chromalisks are agitated due to their proximity to the Core. Others believe it may be mating season.  Regardless of the reason, the squad needs saving before they meet their end to the likes of these lizards\!
item.properties|f.jelly_shield: A strange looking shield created from jelly matter. Like many slime monsters themselves, it provides the user with exceptional defense against piercing damage.
mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!
dungeon.properties|m.ironclaw_munitions_: The Ironclaw Munitions Factory is a gremlin-operated weapons factory that specializes in the production of high-calibur explosives.  Intel has revealed that it is developing a secret weapon known as 'Project Roarmulus' designed with the sole purpose of destroying Haven\!
conversation.properties|m.fc_bridge_1: Few make it across the bridge traveler. Perhaps you stand a chance of surviving, or perhaps... no, even the good sprites below will be swallowed by Vanaduke's flames. It is hopeless.
mission.properties|b.mission_sprite_2: Rhendon is waiting for you in an area of the Clockworks known as the Restless Railroad where reconnaissance has located a cache of missing battle sprites. Secure the sprites and clear the area of hostiles. You are authorized to utilize any sprites you secure in order to complete the mission.
conversation.properties|m.rc_injured_b: One of those mechanical monsters got me.  The cursed thing's claws tore right through my armor\!
mission.properties|m.first_contact_2a:
You're eager, that's good.  Your current mission is to reach the town of Haven where Spiral HQ has set up base.  Spend the time you need within the Rescue Camp to prepare yourself for your journey to come. 

Make use of any traveling merchants as well as the knowledge of other knights in the camp to learn how to survive in this new world.  I will contact you again once you reach Haven. 

Good luck to you.
item.properties|f.jelly_mail: A squishy set of armor made from slippery slimes that simply oozes with style.
conversation.properties|r.och_leader_4_2: It's been an honor to aid you.
mission.properties|b.go_shopping: The Haven Bazaar is a place where all manners of item-related goods and services can be found.  Whether you're in the market for a more powerful sword or just want to make your armor stand out in a crowd, it's got what you need\!
item.properties|f.guild_members_150: Allows your guild to recruit up to 150 members\!
sprites.properties|d.seraphic_aura: Party members within the protective aura gain increased shield regen.

item.properties|f.holiday_present: A perfectly wrapped pile of presents that is sure to please anyone who opens it.

It seems that Biscotti commissioned him to do some baking on her behalf but the responsibility may have gone to his head.  He disappeared into the Clockworks soon after Biscotti delivered the last crate of batter. With the Anniversary celebrations at stake once again, Biscotti needs some culinary champions to help her sort out this mix-up\!

mission.properties|m.intro_prestige_lock: Complete Rank Missions to gain access to Prestige Missions\!
item.properties|f.valiance: This high-performance handgun is a symbol of the Spiral Order, and is proudly worn by veteran members. As it is often said, a knight need not have courage\: just Valiance.

item.properties|f.tailed_helm: An expressive helm proving that two plumes are always better than one.

These are the deepest and most dangerous depths of the Clockworks, delve any further and you will reach the Core itself. \n\nPerhaps if you make it that far, you can locate the Alpha Squad, I just don't know.
item.properties|f.luminite_shard: A shard of Luminite that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
item.properties|f.justifier_hat: A finely-made hat for handgun experts who think nothing of spending a few crowns more on a high-quality piece of gear.

item.properties|f.polar_day_warden_coat: An insulated coat that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The fur-lined armor plating makes it ideal for hours of daytime watch duty.
item.properties|f.spiral_flak_jacket: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.storm_driver: The latent charge running through this supreme sidearm is strong enough to cause discomfort to anyone wielding it, and extreme discomfort to anyone shot by it.
item.properties|f.permafroster: Tech Knights are not yet sure if targets of this deep-freezing handgun ever actually defrost. So far, 'no.' Permafroster shots become more powerful the further they travel.
item.properties|f.love_puppy_mask_foreve: A special mask that proves that a love puppy's love lasts forever and ever. Some would argue they're just programmed that way, others would say 'to heck with you, Science.'
mission.properties|m.elig_not: You are not eligible for this mission.
item.properties|f.battle_chef_coat: A coat worn by the knights who work in the Skylark's galley. Not to be trifled with, these chefs are blade masters on and off the battlefield.

Since I work here in the Bazaar, Spiral HQ has asked me to show new arrivals around this fabulous epicenter of commerce and let them know everything it has to offer. \n\nSo let's go on a quick tour shall we?  Try and keep up, I walk fast.
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_c: Can you believe this?  This entire chasm is filled with a giant machine of some kind.  It seems to go down forever. \n\nI wonder if the entire planet is like this?
conversation.properties|m.rc_soil_1a: I'm collecting geological samples for Spiral HQ. So far my tests are identifying hundreds of unique soil samples within every inch of the ground below our feet. This can't be possible, I must have miscalculated...

mission.properties|r.delved_too_deep_2a: (Tell Kora about The Swarm, The Sleeper, and the Alpha Squad)

item.properties|f.mercurial_helm: A sublime silver helmet that'll let you move as swiftly as water, though perhaps not quite so swiftly *through* it.
conversation.properties|m.core_resting_3: I hope those supplies come soon.

mission.properties|m.advanced_alchemy_3a: You'll figure it out as you go along, trust me.  Take this Brandish for example.  It has within it the potential to become three different types of elemental blades that deliver powerful status conditions, or even a shadowy sword of darkness\! \n\nYou just need to discover the recipes that require a brandish and get crafting to find out. Here, you can even keep this Brandish I've got.  Transmute it into something amazing.
item.properties|f.gold_dragon_armor: Armor once worn by a member of the 'Gold Dragons,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
mission.properties|m.expansion_purchase_:
By purchasing an Expansion, you will unlock the missions included in the Expansion to play as often as you like. 

Unlocking an Expansion unlocks it for all knights on the account. 

Only players who have unlocked an Expansion Mission may join an Expansion Mission. 

Expansion Mission rewards cannot be sold, dropped or traded.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_weap_1: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
item.properties|f.exp_east_5f: An expansion that adds two rooms to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
conversation.properties|m.fc_greeter_1: Heed my warning traveler; this is a dangerous and terrible realm. You stand before the gates of the Firestorm Citadel, the former heart of the great kingdom of Almire, now a dominion twisted by fire and malice.\n\nLeave this place if you want to live.
item.properties|f.gunslinger_sash: Clothing worn by pistol-packing warriors from a forgotten time. They smell of rawhide, gun smoke and action.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_6a:
Wow, this thing is a massive tower of everfrost.  I've only ever seen little handfuls of the stuff, nothing close to what we're seeing here. 

The intel we've collected so far suggests that fiends utilize large deposits of the stuff to trap the souls of the lost within it, like some kind of icy prison. 

It would seem that Maulos, that horrible arch-fiend you just took down, had a different use in mind and was actually destroying this everfrost to unleash swarms of angry, frozen souls into the Clockworks.  Had he finished the job, well, I don't even want to think about how many sweaters we would all be needing right now...
mission.properties|b.delved_too_deep: The truth has been revealed. It's time to update Intel Agent Kora and Spiral HQ about what you and Lieutenant Vaelyn have learned.
guild.properties|m.rename_too_soon: You have renamed your guild too recently.
conversation.properties|m.core_lead_4: I'm saying that we know this entire world isn't natural, and I for one don't believe that those hordes of miserable gremlins, no matter how industrious, could have built an entire world.  They had to have been aided by something far beyond their measure and perhaps whatever that is lies within the Core. \n\nThe same goes for the Alpha Squad.  They wouldn't just disappear, even within the furthest depths of the Clockworks.  They were our very best.  It was this Core that swallowed them.

item.properties|f.ancient_plate_mail: A suit of artifact armor that is said to have been worn by titans. Though it offers amazing protection, its incredible weight makes it cumbersome to wear.
uplink.properties|i.crystal: The amount of energy to attach.
item.properties|f.deadly_candy_poker: A toothache will be the least of their worries when you're armed with this perforating present.
uplink.properties|d.battle_pack: A Battle Pack is the ultimate resource for facing the challenges of King Krogmo's Coliseum.  Gift it to a friend who is brave enough to enter the arena with you\!
chat.properties|m.usage_party: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message to all party members.
item.properties|f.heavenly_guardian_armo: Brilliant, white armor worn by those who defend the heavenly realms.
item.properties|f.vial_sleep_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing a drowsy draught. It can be used to inflict enemies with Sleep.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be snoring in seconds\!
item.properties|f.furni_spiralorder_fiel: A sturdy Spiral scanner that assembles in minutes, provides hours of intel, and lasts for years.
mission.properties|o.shadow_knows: Learn about monsters that inflict shadow damage
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
helptips.properties|m.atg_vials: Inflict a variety of status effects on enemies by throwing VIALS at them\!
item.properties|f.heavy_plate_mail: Thick armor reinforced with more metal plates than a Clockworks vending machine. It's a little uncomfortable.
item.properties|f.shadowsun_slicker: An evil duster that is said to harbor a great power that feeds off of the unforgiven sins of its owners.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_4: At any given time a sprite has a 'favored item', a special material that it enjoys eating the most. Feeding one of these to your sprite is a great treat and grants the sprite a lot of heat.
item.properties|f.token_primal: A small wisp of the essential spirit of nature. It is of extreme value to the Spiral Order. Take it to the Token Trader in the Haven Bazaar\!
item.properties|f.black_kat_cloak: A crudely crafted cloak made to resemble a shadowy sapper of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
item.properties|f.prize_box_hunter: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Hunter style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_gr: A short torch filled with ghastly green fire.
item.properties|f.stranger_robe: A robe once worn by one of the enigmatic Strangers.  Local Snipes seem to be drawn to the wearer.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: Tell me about the other battle sprites.
helptips.properties|m.lost_knights: You have discovered the missing knights...
projectx.properties|m.region_mismatched: Note\: this place is hosted in "{1}", there was a temporary problem finding a place in "{0}".
projectx.properties|i.full_inspect: Allow other knights to inspect all your equipped items.
item.properties|f.faust: A powerful, cursed sword forged in the Underworld. Its powerful charge attacks can sometimes curse the one that wields it.
item.properties|f.frenzy_avenger_helm: A helm worn by heavenly guardians who watch over a kingdom hidden atop a wind-swept mountain.
mission.properties|o.reporting_duty: Report to Lieutenant Feron in the Haven Arcade
conversation.properties|m.mission_surviv: The watcher of the Wildwoods...the horrible Snarbolax\!
item.properties|f.fire_raider_tunic: Treasure is at your fingertips and ash in your wake with this soot laden coat.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_weap_4: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
dungeon.properties|m.training_1_desc: Explore this derelict portion of the Clockworks and learn the basics required for survival.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_fiendbook: 5 Ways to Appease Your Pit Boss
mission.properties|o.frostifur_fandango: Hunt down the ferocious Snowclaw Pack
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_1a: Hi there {0}\!  Wow, you've made Soldier already?  You're really moving up fast in the ranks. \n\nAnyway, I'm here to give you a tour of some of the Bazaar's more advanced services. To start, do you want to learn how to even further power up that gear of yours?
conversation.properties|r.och_leader_2_2: The gates are as good as opened, Lieutenant\!
item.properties|f.bucket_of_flawed_snowb: This bucket seems to have an endless supply of Flawed Snowballs. Unfortunately, they will start to melt when exposed, so you better use them fast\!
mission.properties|b.vicious_viscous: Spiral HQ would like you to investigate levels of the Clockworks where the most powerful slime and beast monsters reside.  By exploring these levels and transferring your combat data back to Spiral HQ, all knights would ultimately benefit from your dangerous experience. \n\nIt is highly recommended that you equip yourself with piercing resistant gear with piercing and shadow damage weapons\!
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
item.properties|f.skelly_suit: A bone-chilling outfit that naturally wards off shadowy attacks.
item.properties|f.flamberge: A fiery foil that burns through as it runs through.
conversation.properties|m.af_chat_fiend_: I've got a case of the Mondays.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
item.properties|f.soul_dust: The dust of the departed. Whether it still retains any shred of a soul remains to be seen.
item.properties|f.heavenly_guardian_helm: A brilliant, white helm belonging to a heavenly warrior.
item.properties|f.fiery_diskgun: A handgun powered by an infernal engine that launches molten disks in rapid succession. Diskgun shots return once reaching their apogee.
mission.properties|r.apocrea_1_1a: What is this place and what are you talking about?
item.properties|f.master_blast_bomb: An incredibly powerful explosive typically used in mining, now issued somewhat recklessly for use in combat.
item.properties|f.super_fire_barrier: Surrounds you with potent fiery orbs that can set hostiles ablaze
mission.properties|r.shadow_knows_2a: Yes, I see that we're already back to-
logon.properties|m.non_public_server: The game is not currently open to the public.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_mat_1: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: I'm either here celebrating or downing my sorrows.
chat.properties|m.usage_sprite_level: Usage\: /{0} [level]\nSets the battle sprite to that level.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_8a: Yes.  It would seem as though we have much to learn of this place. \n\nRhendon's report noted that many of the sprites were missing from the site. He suggested foul play.
uplink.properties|m.newsletter_resub: If you had previously subscribed to the newsletter, just confirm your email address and resubscribe to claim your Proto Crest accessory\!
helptips.properties|m.wolver_den: Wolvers are a highly adaptable pack beast whose predatory instincts are only matched by their quick reflexes.  They play with their prey by dancing about and finally striking from behind.  Keep a blade handy.
mission.properties|o.minerals_rock: Report to Chief Geo Knight Wegner in the Haven Arcade
item.properties|f.obsidian_shard: A jet-black shard of unnatural stone. Holding it fills your head with imagery of a distant shore where waves crash against rocks that seem to writhe in the chill of the water.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogmas: Think you can just open the front door and walk in?\! You will suffer for this\!
mission.properties|m.advanced_alchemy_2a: Basically it comes down to 'branching.'  You see, most of the alchemy you have likely seen up to this point follows a linear evolution path.  It simply improves over time and each upgrade is better than the last. \n\nBut not all items are like that.  Many of them can become multiple, completely different types of items than their original\!
helptips.properties|m.event_locked_modul:
Warning\! An unidentified place of interest lies beyond this gate. By entering you will not be able to turn back until you complete the challenges within.

However, should you manage to come out victorious you will be rewarded for your bravery. Enter at your own risk\! 

This room offers a bonus chance at the treasures within.
item.properties|f.almire_table: A table transplanted from the hallowed halls of Almire to adorn your abode.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_11a: Oh my\!  What is the connection between these gremlins and that Artifact anyway?
mission.properties|b.first_contact_b: With the power restored to the Rescue Camp, you can now use your comlink to contact Spiral HQ and find out where they have located after the crash of the Skylark.  Once you have made contact with Spiral HQ you will hopefully find out what caused the crash and the nature of this alien world you now inhabit.
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_11b: I think I've got it Bechamel, thanks\!
projectx.properties|i.limit_fps: Limit the frame rate to avoid overtaxing your video card, especially if offscreen.
sprites.properties|d.frenzied_firestorm: For every monster caught in the blaze, you and your party have a chance of receiving an attack power and speed bonus.
projectx.properties|e.not_enough_appetit: Not enough appetite to consume this item.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Well, I won't dishonor them by giving up now. We've come so far after all. 'Time to be a hero again\!' Right, {0}?
item.properties|f.proto_shield: A small shield issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.hazardous_hedge_coat: A battle-ravaged coat worn by the squad leaders of the Scarlet Scouts, nicknamed 'hedges.' The name was likely coined due to their incredible flanking abilities or perhaps it is a reference to the spikes that adorn their armor.
mission.properties|b.scarlet_fortress: Entirely different from the Aurora Isles, recon knights have discovered another geo-globe containing the remains of a seemingly ancient castle.  Dubbed the 'Scarlet Fortress,' this crumbling castle is also the home to a horde of restless spirits. Proceed with caution when exploring its twisting passages.
chat.properties|m.usage_item: Usage\: /{0} name attr value attr value...\nCreates an item and adds it to your inventory.
item.properties|f.ticket_variants_1: Use this ticket at the Variant Forge to reset an item's variants to 1 random variant.
item.properties|f.virulisk_suit: A thick set of gear crafted from the carcass of a Virulisk. Wearers will inherit some of the Virulisk's poison resistance, as well as its taste for flan.
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch: Then scour the Clockworks for those wretched kats and destroy them\! Even if they ate the books you will be able to recover the Ancient Pages. These pages can be given to Montague in exchange for rewards. Help us and we'll help you\! \n\nBlack kats can be found randomly when encountering spookats in Tier 2 and Tier 3 (Arcade Gates and Missions). There is also a daily Prestige Mission that likely leads to a black kat nest.
pvp.properties|m.lockdown-info: Battle for domination of control points utilizing special class mods that completely alter your Knight's abilities\!  Lockdown participants can be divided by tier or play an open match. Check today's game modes\!
item.properties|f.nightshade: A hazardous herb that's bad for most beasts, but tasty to a teeming variety of toxic creatures.
item.properties|f.flawed_snowball: A hard-packed snowball that is unfortunately too flawed for use in alchemy. It would be best to simply throw it away... at someone's head.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
mission.properties|o.p_r3_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
item.properties|f.gm_armor: Impressive indigo armor that's the indisputable indication of one of the Spiral Order's incredible Game Masters.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
social.properties|m.pvp_played: become the new Coliseum Champion, having played {0} games of {1} in the past 7 days\!
uplink.properties|m.retgift: The attached Spark of Life is a gift, sent from the Skylark straight to you\! Please use it with our compliments.
pvp.properties|e.late_playagain: You are too late to play again.
mission.properties|b.blades_fallen:
Not every knight who enters the Clockworks returns to feel the sun on their face once more.  Within the perilous depths of the Clockworks, those that brave its dangers always face the reality that every expedition may be their last.  Sometimes their bodies can be recovered and other times all that is left is remnants of their gear. 

Just outside of Haven, Spiral HQ has built a soldier's graveyard where fallen knights can lay to rest.  As a Spiral Knight, you must face the reality of death in order to understand its gravity. 

Deliver the remains of an unknown knight, a sword, to a memorial within the graveyard.  But stay alert- dark energies resonate from the graveyard, attracted to the countless souls it houses.
item.properties|f.elemental_blaster: An enhanced blaster modified to fire elemental rounds.
mission.properties|m.shadow_knows_4a:
Perhaps Geo-Science has no place in this conversation?  You are correct, {0}. 

Moving on, shadow damage is produced by fiend and undead family monsters.  Additionally, fiend monsters tend to be weak to piercing damage and the undead to elemental damage. Keep this in mind. 

Now then, is there anything else you require?
projectx.properties|x.rename_desc3: The renaming item will be consumed.
item.properties|f.arcane_salamander_mask: A Salamander Mask imbued with magical power.  It is thought to be made from the familiars of powerful witches.
item.properties|e.not_use_snow_bucket: Can't use this item now. It can only be used in town or in a guild hall. There can only be 10 in use at once.
conversation.properties|m.npc_supplies_a: Those supplies came just in time.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_b_3a: Whew, well that was much faster with you lending a hand, {0}. Listen, if you ever need a guided tour around the bazaar, just come talk to me. I can tell you anything you need to know about the shops and services here. \n\nHave a look around\! I'm sure you'll find plenty of interesting items. Thanks again\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_end_1a: This is it, recruit. This is the final gate that leads out of the Rescue Camp, through the chasm and into Haven. Once you pass through, you will never need to return here. You can buy everything found in the Rescue Camp and much more in Haven. \n\nAny questions?
sprites.properties|d.angelic_aura: Creates protective aura around you that also protects any party members within it.
conversation.properties|m.hunter_4a: That's the spirit\! Give those monsters what for\!
item.properties|f.industrial_hard_hat: Normally worn by construction workers, this hat doesn't offer much defense but grants the wearer high stun resistance.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_mat_1: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.guild_members_200: Allows your guild to recruit up to 200 members\!
guild.properties|x.rename_desc2: The renaming item will be consumed.
mission.properties|r.time_enough_at_last: Yes, you must be Edger.  Your squadmates requested that I come find you.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: The maskeraith is a battle sprite that embodies deception and debilitation. Its skills focus on subterfuge\: caustic quills fire poisonous quills that explode when followed with an attack, shadow cloak allows a knight to become invisible to monsters, and hexing haze allows the knight to inflict monsters with a timed damage blast. \n\nThe maskeraith is best suited for knights who wish to lurk in the shadows and strike the enemy with sneak attacks.
item.properties|f.prismatech_alchemer_mk: An upgraded Alchemer that fires bolts of photonic liquid at an increased rate.
item.properties|f.galactic_guardian_vest: Wearing this stunningly stellar vest allows you to guide others to safety in even the darkest corners of space.
item.properties|f.spiral_draped_armor: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_773357: Defeat the Roarmulus Twins in the dangerous depths of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Good luck in there, we know you can do it\!
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_3c: Please take the elevator behind me in order to complete your mission.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_or: A short torch filled with otherworldly orange fire.
conversation.properties|m.npc_captainkni: Take cover if you get overwhelmed\!
item.properties|f.arthro_pod: A streamlined helmet fashioned after the tough chitin of a beetle's carapace.
conversation.properties|m.rc_instruct_1a: Greetings, recruit.  Always good to see another knight make it to the Rescue Camp.  I imagine you're looking to prepare for your journey to Haven.  A good place to start is the gate here into the Clockworks.  Simply approach the control panel at the north end of the lift and press the action button ([[?ACTION]]).\n\nAny questions?
sprites.properties|d.dark_veil: Increases the defensive power of the shadow cloak.
item.properties|f.ticket_unbind_0: Use this ticket at the Unbinding Forge to unbind a 0 star item.
helptips.properties|m.atg_togswitch: Switches can open AND close doors.
conversation.properties|r.fc_court_compl: This will greatly aid me, thank you.
conversation.properties|m.rc_end_3a: No, you won't be able to return. Once you reach Haven your training is complete and your new objective will be to aid the Spiral Knights who are now based in Haven.
mission.properties|m.darkest_forces_1a:
{0}, still holding it together I see and earning the rank of Defender Elite no less.  Bravo. 

I've had a chance to analyze your combat data from your last mission and it's proving quite interesting.  The mecha knights in particular appear to actually be reacting to your attacks as if improvising.  But I can't say just yet. 

In any case, that's not relevant to today's data that I'm presenting.
conversation.properties|m.ritual_4a: Well, that was unexpected. I'll get it right next time\!
auction.properties|m.no_search: Your search did not match any auctions.
mission.properties|m.target_acquired_3a: We have pinpointed its location to be in the deepest level of a gremlin facility known as the 'Ironclaw Munitions Factory.'  The factory is used for the production of all manners of gremlin weaponry and is highly dangerous, even to the gremlins working there. \n\nYou must prepare yourself for heavy resistance from shock-powered constructs and gremlins.
item.properties|f.token_forge: A small wisp of the essential spirit of technology and progress. It is of extreme value to the Spiral Order. Take it to the Token Trader in the Haven Bazaar\!
item.properties|f.gh_env_default: The default environment that really captures the stale air of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.celestial_orbitgun: This planetoid projecting pistol conjures images of the birth of stellar systems. Opponents caught within its blazing maelstrom are sure to see the light.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_1a: Well met, {0}. I'm Lieutenant Barrus, Warden of the Hall of Heroes. \n\nYou are here because Spiral HQ has marked you as having potential to become a Vanguard of the Spiral Knights.  The Hall of Heroes is now at your disposal.  As you move up in rank, you will receive new missions to visit and have access to more recipes from the veteran knights in this hall.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_slime: Deliver a shipment of rock salt to the research team stationed in the lichenous lair\!
mission.properties|b.p_r4_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
item.properties|f.prize_box_chess: Contains one randomly-chosen Chess Mini liftable statue furniture.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.wild_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_4b: Skill points are gained regularly as a sprite levels up. They can be applied to skills within the battle sprite interface. \n\nWhen applying a skill point, you must choose an augment to increase, such as the cooldown rate or overall damage.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_b631f6: Power up a derelict Mecha Knight.
item.properties|f.venom_fiend_mask: A mask said to be crafted in the visage of a venomous fiend.  It is infused with a vile essence that is sure to frighten your foes.
item.properties|f.obsidian_mantle_of_inf: 'Speak with the one, true voice and they will listen. Quiet as a child's whisper, roaring like the death of this world.'
item.properties|f.omega_tortofist: A handgun empowered by the limitless fury of a tortodrone. While wielding it you are capable of unleashing the energy of a legion of tortodrones upon your foes.
item.properties|f.grim_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a corrupted tortodrone. Shadows seem to lengthen and cling to it whenever it is brought to bear.
pvp.properties|m.no_guild: You are not a member of a guild.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_overgrown_2: Looks like you know how to handle yourself. That's good, because the final area is just ahead.
item.properties|f.luminite_deposit_1: A small mineral deposit that will generate a single unit of luminite.
item.properties|f.driftwood: A peculiar piece of wood that just won't stay put.
mission.properties|b.shopping_again: Bechamel has already given you a tour of the Haven Bazaar that included where to acquire new weapons, armor and recipes.  Now it's time to pay him another visit and learn about some of the more advanced services the Bazaar offers. \n\nYou will pay a visit to Punch and Vise, Brinks and even visit Bechamel's own shop\!
item.properties|f.emberbreak_shield: A Proto Shield modified to provide some protection against fire.
item.properties|f.enamorock: A strange stone that makes you have warm and fuzzy feelings inside just by holding it.
item.properties|f.pith_helm: A simple but effective helm favored by Spiral Knight recruits.
mission.properties|r.honor_duty_2a: I hope her findings produce something meaningful.
uplink.properties|t.newsletter: Subscribe to the Spiral Knights Newsletter\!
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: You... I... What was that? Did you say something?
item.properties|f.razor_ribbon: Remember\: when handling Grinchlin giftboxes, always wear your plate mail gauntlets.
social.properties|m.autofriend_single_to: Your {0} friend {1} just started playing Spiral Knights as {2}\! You already have the maximum number of friends, so you were unable to be auto-friended.
item.properties|f.adv_evo_catalyst: A contained charge of highly unstable energy that can be synthesized by battle sprites. In doing so, sprites can evolve into even more advanced forms with even more powerful skills.
pvp.properties|e.no_withdraw: You have signed up to play again, you cannot withdraw unless your game is delayed.
conversation.properties|m.casino_royalje: I just flew in from Moorcroft and boy are my royal cores drained.
item.properties|f.plated_shade_armor: A suit of fiendish fabric interlaced with dark matter to conceal its wearer while they creep in camoflauged corners.
item.properties|f.snarbostuffing: A dense, fluffy stuffing made from a special polymer that doesn't break down when exposed to the cursed fur of the Snarbolax. It's perfect for creating trophies or adorable, cursed, stuffed toys.
logon.properties|m.downtime: Gremlins have knocked the game out of service. Please check back soon.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: The drakon is a battle sprite that embodies fiery destruction. Its skills focus on direct assault\: firebolt creates an explosive projectile, flame barrier surrounds its knight with protective fireballs, and firestorm creates a massive wave of flames. \n\nThe drakon is best suited for fearless knights who prefer frontline, destructive combat.
helptips.properties|m.tut_breakable: Some blocks like these can be broken. Attack them to clear the path.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_2_7a: Are you saying these sprites learned magic spells from an old book?
helptips.properties|m.tut_chromalisks: Those chroma whelps up ahead can lash you with their tongues from afar. Avoid facing them when they get ready to strike.
logon.properties|m.network_error: Either there is a temporary network outage or the server is not yet fully operational. Please wait a moment before reconnecting.
mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r4: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
mission.properties|m.best_of_beast_1a: Hello {0}, good to see you still standing.  While normally not the concern of a Chief Biotech, I specifically requested the opportunity to inform you about the dangers that lie ahead for you in Tier 3 of the Clockworks.  Can't have you winding up dead as a result of some junior Biotech's misinformation.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Then it sounds like we narrowly avoided a horrible catastrophe. If we had opened the Core and unleashed The Swarm all of Cradle might have been destroyed. Perhaps even the universe\!
logon.properties|m.steam_error: We experienced a problem authenticating with Steam. Please ensure that the Steam client is running and that you are not logged in elsewhere.
mission.properties|b.shadow_knows: Biotech Hahn has suggested that given your recent promotion, you are ready to learn about the nefarious monsters within the Clockworks that inflict shadow damage. Contact him via comlink and see what he has to say.
item.properties|f.helm_back: An accessory that can be attached to the back of select helmets.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_311da7: Hit the Whammie playing the Golden Prize Wheel.
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_5a: It seemed like the world itself tried to trap you back there, what a close call\! \n\nKeep your wits about you when you go off exploring the Ancient Generator below.  If the surface of this world is crawling with monsters and rigged with traps, who knows what you'll find down there in the dark\!
item.properties|f.furni_pet_flying_snipe: A snipe that happily hovers through the air.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_87eae7: Revive a downed party member, giving them only half a pip of health.
item.properties|f.eye_pack_suited: Contains a suite of suitable eye shapes for your style kit\: Club, Diamond, Heart, and Spade.
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_3a: Let's put it to good use right away. \n\nYou can accept Missions by clicking the 'Mission' button at the top of the screen and accept the mission I've given you.
prologue.properties|m.helmsman_arrive: Captain Ozlo, the Skylark has identified the source of the powerful energy signature.
item.properties|f.reaper_rib: A bone stained black by the wickedness of its former possessor.
mission.properties|o.p_fiend_test_t2: Help us test this new content.
item.properties|f.gremlin_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a gremlin.  It's so convincing, you just might receive an invitation to the Colony\!
item.properties|f.gsc_vip: A non-transferrable membership in the Golden Slime Casino C.U.B.E. Club. Membership benefits are subject to change.
item.properties|f.trinket_slot_upgrade: Once used, this upgrade opens a trinket slot for {0} days.
item.properties|f.wild_hunting_blade: A legendary cutter feared by even the mightiest of Wolvers and Chromalisks.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_1a: Thought you could just walk away with the artifact did you?  Hand it over now or I'll light this fuse and turn you into a million, tiny, smoldering bits\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_greet3_1a: You've restored the power and saved us all, {0}\!  I can't thank you enough, all these recruits owe you their lives. \n\nYou should now try to contact Spiral HQ via your comlink.
helptips.properties|m.loading9: If you become stunned you will move and attack slower than usual. This can leave you as a prime target for larger monsters that you can normally outrun, so watch out\!
mission.properties|m.toxic_plant_2b: All traces of Compound 42 should be eliminated, along with the facility and any engineers not part of the inner fold. Remind the scorchers who find these orders uncomfortable that those who disobey shall soon hear my whisper in their ears. \n\nSeal the doors and burn everything to the ground.
item.properties|f.furni_wardrobe_sklocke: A locked cabinet containing currently unequipped clothing and armor.
mission.properties|o.p_halloween_r9: Seek an audience with the Punkin King.
item.properties|f.exp_west_3f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the western side of the Guild Hall.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_1aa: More questions about battle sprites? How can I assist you?
item.properties|f.spiral_hood: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.thwacker_shield: A shield repurposed by gremlins and worn by Darkfang Thwackers. Similar to the gremlins themselves, it is resistant to fire and shock attacks. Knights who use these shields report that is impossible to completely remove all the fur stuck to it.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: {0}, you've already done so much for all of us but I must now ask you to make one final sacrifice. We might never have a chance to return home to Isora, but right now Cradle needs us. I would like you to spearhead our Operations on Cradle.
conversation.properties|m.mission_crimso: The Nine see all, hear all.
item.properties|m.hatch_egg_prompt: The Battle Sprite inside will bind to you upon opening.
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_cardho: Please enter your entire name as it appears on your credit card.
uplink.properties|m.love_rejected: Sorry, your Crucible level was rejected\: {0}
item.properties|f.exp_east_4f: An expansion that adds three rooms and a small overlook to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
chat.properties|m.usage_away: Usage\: /{0} message\nNotes that you have left the keyboard.
mission.properties|m.toxic_plant_1a:
Alright Rangers, listen up - we've got orders to infiltrate a gremlin bioweapons facility lead by a member of their 'Crimson Order,' known as 'Herex.'  This is just a fancy way of saying that one of the craziest of the crazy gremlins likes to load his gun with unconventional bullets. 

We don't know what he has cooking down there so arm yourself and don't forget to wear a mask. If Herex is anything like Seerus you're liable to catch more than a cold down there. 

Let's ride, Rangers\!
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_3b: Thanks for the info tall guy, see you around town.
item.properties|f.snarble_barb: A bestial blade that can shoot slithy spines at those who would oppose its wielder.
uplink.properties|m.bid_outbid: Visit the Auction House for another chance at this item\!
sprites.properties|d.crystal_harness_eli: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal elemental damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 10% \nCan be used by\: Drakon, Seraphynx
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_1a: Greetings, {0}. I imagine you have some questions about battle sprites. How can I assist you?
mission.properties|m.silent_legion_1a: Have they sent you for me?  To bring me back?  No, I am where I belong now. I no longer serve the Spiral Order and will remain here. \n\nLeave this place and never come back.  Leave me be.
item.properties|f.furni_spiralorder_sund: Supply canisters containing everything a Spiral Knight needs to get going in the morning.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_2_1: Well done, {0}\!  That was quite a fireworks show\!  Thanks to you we've been able to clear that accursed landing zone and move our base of operations up to inner gates\!
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: The Alpha Squad's sacrifice will not be in vain. I will immediately order our forces to undertake special Operations Missions all over Cradle. If there are forces trying to free The Swarm, we'll have to stop them.
conversation.properties|m.rc_bomb_1a: Had a chance to try out bombs yet? Unlike other weapon types, bombs can only be used as a charge attack. Doing anything else just causes it to fizzle out. But if you do charge them up... BOOM\! They can put a serious hurt on multiple monsters at once\!
mission.properties|r.eye_of_needle_4a: I take it the only way to the Core is through the Firestorm Citadel?
monster.properties|m.overtime_2: I'm not saying to work this weekend, but everyone else is, so...
projectx.properties|d.achievement_64d528: Deposit a single mineral into a gate.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_gre: A tall torch filled with ghastly green fire.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
mission.properties|r.anniversary_start_3: Though my training never included confectionery combat, I'm in\!
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: I'm not ready to choose yet.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_r3: Meet with Biscotti in her kitchen and provide 'baking assistance.'
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_7: On very rare occasions I've found jellies that haven't attacked us on sight. I'm removing the barbs off this one now. They're kind of cute when they aren't trying to impale you\!
item.properties|f.cold_iron_vanquisher: A powerful cold iron blade forged for the singular purpose of hunting down and destroying the undead.
chat.properties|m.usage_salute: {0} [player name]\nCauses your tech knight to salute.
item.properties|f.charged_quicksilver_ma: An enhanced set of Quicksilver Mail that'll get you all charged up for battle.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_6a: From what I've heard, if anyone can do it, it's you, {0}\!  Good luck\!
sprites.properties|d.heavy_smoke: Increases the defensive power and duration of the flame barrier.
item.properties|f.guild_members_300: Allows your guild to recruit up to 300 members\!
exchange.properties|m.billing_success: Thank you for your purchase\! ${0} has been charged to your credit card. {1} Energy will be delivered to your energy supply momentarily.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_min: Gather minerals for Chief Geo Knight Wegner's research.
projectx.properties|m.check_email: Check your email in the Uplink panel.
item.properties|f.shadow_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who gain their powers using forbidden, dark arts.
arena.properties|m.chat_all: Spectators may now chat with players.
mission.properties|b.faith_armor:
An apprentice named Wilks who had just arrived from a Rescue Camp has found himself in what Spiral HQ calls a 'Trap Chamber.'  These levels of most likely gremlin design seem to be specifically built to trap and ultimately eliminate those attempting to explore the Clockworks. 

Wilks probably didn't know what he had got himself into until it was too late.  Now he's stuck somewhere in the chamber and needs your help. 

Some traps can be avoided and sometimes you may find that you just have to take the hit. In saving Wilks, you will no doubt learn the true value of strong armor.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_wandering_ro: A festive new years snipe that will explore its surroundings.
mission.properties|m.intro_reward_rank: Select a mission card to receive a mission briefing, see the available rewards and enable options for starting the mission\!
item.properties|f.furni_chest_spiralfoot: A sealed locker filled with important Spiral Order equipment, like socks.
conversation.properties|m.emberlight_vis: None know for sure. Tinkinzar not seen for many many years. Crimson Order carries out Tinkinzar's plans for Cradle. Emberlight was blight on master plan because built by outcasts. Haven probably the same, founded by non-gremlins. Not part of plan\!
mission.properties|b.from_below: A squad of Desna's Recon Rangers is trapped somewhere in the depths of the Clockworks by a mysterious force. Judging from the severity of the reports and panicked communications from the squad, Spiral HQ believes that only someone with your experience is capable of handling whatever deadly force has trapped them.
item.properties|f.surge_breaker_armor: A reliable set of armor adept at weathering the most shocking of revelations. It's not bad at resisting electric attacks, either.
dungeon.properties|m.royal_jelly_desc: The Royal Jelly Palace is an ancient castle overtaken by a legion of slime monsters. It is unclear what purpose the castle serves, though it is rumored to house a Royal Jelly, said to be nobility within the slime kingdoms. If true then the purpose of the castle is likely to serve the Royal Jelly, and nothing more.
item.properties|f.grey_owlite_shield: A resplendent replica of the shield thought to have been issued to the most eminent of Owlite wizards. Wielding it fills you with righteous vengeance.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_weap_3: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
guild.properties|m.confirm_leave: Are you sure you no longer want to be a member of {0}?
chat.properties|m.usage_revoke_gift: Usage\: /{0} <account name> name attr value attr value...\nRevokes a gift from the identified account.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_7542da: Forge an item up to level 10.
chat.properties|m.usage_action: Usage\: /{0} command argument\nPosts an action to the scene controller.
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_2a: I bet. I guess you'll have to fill me in for once\!
guild.properties|log.upkeep_paid: Upkeep paid\! {0} crowns removed from the guild treasury.
item.properties|f.chess_room: An empty room with an 8x8 chess board in the corner and a row for spectators.
item.properties|f.prize_box_owlite: Contains unique Owlite costumes and accessories, recreated from the latest archaeological evidence. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|b.plan_of_attack: Deep within a toxic cavern lies a hidden test lab that gremlins have been using as a testing ground for components of Project R.  One of these components still in development is reported to have schematics for the project close by. \n\nIf this is true there will likely be a terminal of some kind close to one of Project R's components.  Locate the terminal and recover the schematics for analysis.  It should shed light on the exact nature of Project R.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_fiendnoti: Due to continual under-performance, there will be no paid holidays or free coffee in the break room.
logon.properties|m.too_many_attempts: You have made too many login attempts. Please wait a few minutes before trying again.
helptips.properties|m.loading5: You can see what your friends are up to by clicking on the social button in the bottom left corner of your screen. You can even instantly join them if there is room in their party.
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_h:
You see that shimmery aurora? 

We have no idea what that is\! 

And while it's pretty from here, we're reading intense energy spikes in some regions down below\!
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_coba: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_3: Do you have any more questions about feeding and caring for your sprite?
monster.properties|m.vanaduke_1: What's this? More wolves hungry for the blood of Almire? Our great kingdom shall never fall to the likes of beasts\!
item.properties|f.token_cake: A slice of cake that serves as a trophy from victory over a horde of Creep Cakes.  Head Chef Biscotti affirms that both these trophies and the incident that created them never officially occurred.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_battlesta: A fine display commemorating a knight's full acceptance into the Spiral Order.
item.properties|f.exp_east_2f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
prologue.properties|m.preface3: What we discovered was beyond imagination. We discovered Cradle.
support.properties|m.option_1_2: 3. If you meant to send a message to {0}, click here.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_3b:
Additionally, HR is still waiting on the requested updated org chart. Please note that 'All fall under the freezing corruption of the great Maulos' is not an acceptable description of current executive hierarchy. 

Cheers, 
Morgral'm 
Assistant Supervisor of Resource Allocations, Undercorp
conversation.properties|m.npc_lostknight: Thanks for "rescuing" me but I feel fine.
item.properties|f.ash_tail_coat: This well-made hide coat is self-heating, protecting the wearer from freeze attacks. The secret? A tiny pinch of blaze pepper.
help.properties|m.monster_gremlin: Deal ELEMENTAL - Weak to SHADOW - Strong against ELEMENTAL
mission.properties|b.go_shopping_b: The Haven Bazaar is a place where all manners of item-related goods and services can be found. However, there seems to be some kind of commotion just outside the normally bustling marketplace. It looks like there is no time to waste; there is trouble brewing\!
board.properties|m.auto_create_party: Sorry, we could not find you an available party. Do you want to start your own party?
projectx.properties|m.please_relaunch: Please quit and re-run the game to check your new options.
support.properties|m.option_200_1: Be aware that what you consider offensive and personal may not generally be considered offensive. So please consider carefully if everyone would find that chat offensive. If you have read and understood all this and still wish to send the complaint then click here.
mission.properties|b.pumping_up: You are free to use the Advanced Training Hall whenever you like in order to practice with new weapons or learn about other unique features of the Clockworks.  Check it out and see what it has to offer\!
dungeon.properties|m.tutorial_b: The Crash Site|Waking in a New World
item.properties|f.prize_box_rooster: Contains various unique items to celebrate the year of the Rooster\! Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.power_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.
mission.properties|r.true_champion_3a: If there's a way, we'll find it.
mission.properties|o.skies_under_cradle: Chart an expedition through the Aurora Isles
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeresea: Thanks for your help collecting spikes\!
conversation.properties|m.casino_yesman_: Everyjelly is a winner at the Golden Slime\!
item.properties|f.luminite_deposit_3: A large lump of minerals that will generate a great many units of luminite.
item.properties|f.electron_bomb: Adapted from several unconventional Gremlin theories on physics, anyone unlucky enough to be dragged into this bomb's blast is in for a shock.
item.properties|f.steamvalve_mask: Though now outdated by more sophisticated devices, these special pressurized masks were once used by soldiers in environments with extreme atmospheres. The pressure valve on the back would have to be turned just so or the soldier's head would, well, implode.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.volcanic_salamander_su: A Salamander Suit reinforced with sturdy plates of volcanic iron. Extremely protective, and usable as a makeshift stove during long deployments.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
guild.properties|e.already_withdrew: You have already withdrawn from an energy well today and must wait 24 hours.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_4a: Remember to accept that mission and be careful down there\!
auction.properties|e.selected_updated: The selected auction has been updated.
item.properties|f.beast_scale: A relatively intact scale recovered from a Clockworks creature.
item.properties|f.token_grim: A small wisp of the essential spirit of darkness and decay. It is of extreme value to the Spiral Order. Take it to the Token Trader in the Haven Bazaar\!
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_1: No problem, from the top then...
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Warmaster Seerus is crazy\!  I should escape to Emberlight.
conversation.properties|m.energy_info_3a: Energy is a very special power that is constantly emanating from the core of this world. It is totally stable and will never be lost unless traded or spent. (You can see how much energy you have on the energy module in your arsenal.)
item.properties|f.prize_box_extraordinar: Contains various unique costumes and items sure to revitalize your vigor and bring the pep back into your stride\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_mat_1: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.exp_west_1f: An expansion that adds two rooms to the western side of the Guild Hall.
chat.properties|m.usage_force_bug_report: Usage\: /{0} <knight name> [description]\nForces a bug report to be submitted from the player's client.
item.properties|f.gh_theme_poison: A very unique theme that gives your Guild Hall all the beauty and ambiance of a sewage system.
mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_3: These shelters will offer you two choices\: exit the mountain and claim some Grinchlin treasure, or press on further up the mountain. \n\nShould you press on, you pass on the loot in that shelter, but will find even more treasures at the next shelter.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_2_2a: Well met, {0}. It is good to see you once more. \n\nNow then {0}, for your 3 Star Certification you must be currently equipped with a 3 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_4: I mean that the Core isn't a big battery that runs this world, but rather it and the whole of this world is a massive prison designed to keep something from ever leaving. \n\nThink about our geo-scans of Cradle just before the crash- they show it as being composed of hundreds of massive slabs of other worlds, almost like plates of armor.  Then you have the Clockworks, the most unnatural thing I've ever seen.  An entire world whose sole purpose seems to be stopping anyone from ever reaching its Core.
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_mon_1: SITUATION RESOLVED. PLEASE EXIT THE FACILITY.
mission.properties|b.the_gauntlet: One final battle stands in your way before reaching the Firestorm Citadel. Thought to be devised by Lord Vanaduke himself, this unrelenting gauntlet is teeming with all manners of dark creatures and culminates in a nightmarish battle arena that must be conquered in order to gain access to the gates of the Firestorm Citadel. \n\nThis mission will take everything you've got and requires a full arsenal of powerful weapons and gear.  If Lord Vanaduke is testing you, give him the fight that he's asking for and show him what a true Champion can do\!
item.properties|f.furni_crate_toughbox_s: It's a rough and tumble security container used for a variety of purposes.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_3a: Punch and Vise are gremlin smiths that can change the properties of your weapons and gear.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
mission.properties|m.built_to_destroy_1a: "The Nine see all, hear all. Obey the Iron Law."
item.properties|f.iron_wolf_coat: Armor once worn by a member of the 'Iron Wolves,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
guild.properties|l.gl_save_progress: Saving guild log to the desktop...
item.properties|f.pollinator_plate: Styled after the unsung heroes of the hive. Fashionable, functional, and a little fuzzy.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_barrier: If you start feeling overwhelmed, use the force barriers like the one to your right to take a breather. Monsters and projectiles cannot pass through them.
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r4: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
item.properties|f.sacred_hex_armor: A phantasmal suit of armor for those who are aiming for the infernal.
mission.properties|o.aggressive_assembly: Rescue the lost squad and decommission the factory foreman
mission.properties|b.p_apocrea_r6: Several capable knights have gone missing in a seemingly normal area of the Clockwork Tunnels. Spiral HQ suspects foul play and has assigned you to investigate the level.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_11a: Well, that about covers the basics of the Bazaar.  It's a really fantastic place to find just about anything you need. \n\nDo you want me to go over it all again or do you think you've got it?
item.properties|f.raptor: An ancient pistol imbued with enchantments designed to smite the fiendish creatures of the Underworld. Like its namesake, its bullets fly fast and strike with deadly force.
projectx.properties|m.equip_loadout_lock: There are unbound items in {0}. Equipping this loadout will automatically bind them. Are you sure?
helptips.properties|m.tg2_vials_2: The room ahead will give you a chance to try out using vials. Simply press the number key (1 through 5) to the corresponding pickup in your belt at the top of the screen. Doing so will load a vial. Press attack to throw it.
item.properties|f.arctic_rogue_mask: A mask said to be crafted by an arctic rogue. The shattered ice will conceal your identity during clandestine arctic expeditions.
item.properties|f.thwack_hammer: A spirited spanner specially suited to scrapping mechanical enemies.
mission.properties|o.hall_of_heroes_3: Visit the Hall of Heroes wearing at least 4 Star gear and receive certification
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_5a: We all sensed the moment you defeated Vanaduke. The entire citadel shook as he fell and for a moment we thought that this realm would be destroyed along with its ruler. You must be careful wandering these halls with the place coming apart like this\!
mission.properties|o.terminal_meltdown: Destroy the fiery monsters in the fuel depot and prevent an explosive disaster
item.properties|f.ionized_salt_bomb: A solid chunk of rock salt with an explosive surprise inside. Jellies hate surprises.
item.properties|f.bolted_blade: An upgraded Proto Sword reinforced with bronze bolts scavenged from the Clockworks.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_mastery_1a: Hello again, {0}.  I understand you're well on your way to reaching the Core and need an arsenal that will keep you alive.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_14: You can find accessory tickets inside lockboxes or at the Auction House if another Knight happens to be selling them.
mission.properties|r.shadow_knows_4a: I'm going to need you to go over that-
projectx.properties|p.use_style_kit: Spend 1,000 crowns to modify your style?
uplink.properties|m.confirm_att_account: This is an account-wide mail, you can read it with any of your knights but the attachment can only be accepted once.\n\nAccept the attachment now?
item.properties|f.woven_sentinel_helm: A helm imbued with interwoven wolver hair to protect against even the harshest elements.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Royal Jelly \nThis massive gelatinous cube has a short fuse and loves to throw his weight around. When his royal tasters are absent a poisoned parfait would be a royal pain.
craft.properties|m.moved_treasury: Item moved to your Guild Treasury
exchange.properties|m.offertobuy_tooltip: Enter the amount of energy you want to buy, in multiples of 100.
item.properties|f.rocket_hammer_2: Designed by Warmaster Seerus himself, this nefarious gremlin weapon is equipped with a rocket engine that can launch the wielder forward with a powerful hammer smash.  This particular model is a more stable version that blew up gremlin test subjects far fewer times than the prototype.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_1: Hello there, {0}\!  My name is Bosco and I'm here to give you a rundown on the basics of alchemy. \n\nIt's pretty simple stuff really, thanks to these Alchemy Stations.  They do all the heavy lifting for ya\!
shop.properties|m.cart_costume_own: Warning\! You already own this exact costume.
item.properties|f.wildfire: An elite handgun that can offer a tremendous surprise for the enemy on the battlefield as its small charges of energy transform into raging wildfires. Wildfire shots become more powerful the further they travel.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Right.  Spiral HQ has informed me you'll likely be facing hordes of gremlins and constructs on this next go around.  Keep in mind that in Tier 3, these monsters can inflict pure elemental damage.  Do be sure to gear up appropriately.
item.properties|m.no_activate: You must wait for other upgrades to expire before activating.
item.properties|f.fencing_jacket: A loose-fitting frock favored by fledgling fencers.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_3a: The Apocrea are stuff of nightmares\: a terrible legion of otherworldly phantasms whose only ambition seems to be trapping and devouring the souls of all life. \n\nThough you may venture beyond this nexus, you will undoubtedly fall into one of their traps along the way.
mission.properties|r.first_contact_b_1a: This is {0} of the Skylark.  I read you loud and clear Kora.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: So far, we haven't recovered Seerus's body, but there's no way anyone could have survived that explosion.
conversation.properties|m.rc_greet2_2a:
In short, this camp has no power and the sun is setting soon. Last night all manners of horrible monsters came after us in the dark.  We couldn't see and had no power for our defensive turrets. 

...we lost a lot of recruits. 

We need to channel power to the Rescue Camp so that we can set up a defensive perimeter before night falls\!
item.properties|f.fang_of_vog: A sword said to be created from the fang of the fire beast, Vog.
dungeon.properties|m.no_revive: Your revive effort is no longer necessary.
guild.properties|e.item_treasury_limit: Sorry, an item you're trying to add is already at the limit for how many can be placed in a guild hall.
item.properties|f.var_slime_lockbox: An extra-special lockbox exuded from a normal Slime Lockbox.  It requires a Slime Key or Silver Key to open, but is guaranteed to contain a rare color slime gear, costume, or accessory.
mission.properties|o.delved_too_deep: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
item.properties|f.sunset_stetson: A sturdy hat for gunslingers that shouldn't cost you much more than a fistful of crowns.
help.properties|m.monster_beast: Deal PIERCING - Weak to PIERCING - Strong against ELEMENTAL

mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_danger:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

On behalf of Impostoclaus, Spiral HQ has located the base of operations of the nefarious Grinchlins. It's time to take the fight to them and end their Winterfest terrorism once and for all. But it won't be an easy task. 

Those who accept this mission must climb Mount Krampus, a perilous trek filled with Grinchlin ambushes and icy deathtraps. Along the way you will find shelters that allow you to collect Grinchlin treasures and escape the mountain, or press on toward the summit for even greater rewards\! Just be warned\: Grinchlins and their allies are a stingy lot and will not drop ANY loot. All the treasures to be found on Mount Krampus are at the shelters. And should you pass on them for greater rewards ahead, you risk losing everything if you fail\! 

Some say that on the very summit of Mount Krampus lies a stash of Grinchlin loot that may contain treasures none have ever seen before...

Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. support.properties|m.subheader_step209:
Sometimes we make a mistake when trading with players. This happens to all of us.

But Game Masters can't know what the agreement with the trade was. One player could claim this wasn't what was agreed on, while the other could claim it was. And we can't just blindly pick a side. So we have to rely on players double checking what they're trading before they click to confirm.

So if you just made a trade you didn't really mean to, then I'm afraid Game Masters won't be able to assist you. Instead you'll want to talk to the other player and see if the player is nice enough to reverse the trade.

Also remember never to trade anything away "as a loan" unless you are OK with this player not returning the item. Game Masters won't be able to recover it for you.
